jobs.description:
## **About the Role:**

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

10

**Latin America Biofuels Analyst**

**The Role**: We are seeking a biofuels specialist able to support our customer base on decarbonization strategies to successfully transition into sustainable fuel. These include researching, gathering data and developing insights on current market trends, regulatory frameworks, risks and opportunities for the industry. Biofuels is the most relevant low carbon fuel having an impact in the road transportation sector and have been used to reduce greenhouse gas emissions for decades. Over the past few years, the biofuels industry has seen tremendous growth amid increasing efforts to decarbonize the energy sector.

**Responsibilities:** We are searching for people who would like to join an international team of like-minded people, driven to deliver excellence. You are applying for a dynamic career path within a passionate and fast paced environment.

More specifically, responsibilities include:

- Take a key role in furthering biofuels research focused in Latin America, including policy and trade developments, forecasting biofuels prices, supply & demand.
- Act as a subject matter expert for the biofuels market, contributing to a wide range of S&P Global Commodity Insights publications covering topics such as biofuels prices, supply & demand, margins, mandates, trade and other pertinent issues.
- Manage, maintain and enhance pertinent models and databases.
- Create charts, graphs and other visual content that illustrates the trends SPGCI customers need to follow.
- Articulate expertise and thought leadership through a variety of media including podcasts, webinars, video, and speaking engagements.
- Customer oriented mindset, maintain and further develop meaningful business relationships with stakeholders in the global biofuels markets.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

- **An S&P Global employee at this level would typically have 2-3 years of relevant experience in biofuels, energy, agricultural commodities, refined products, or market-related analysis.**
- Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate across a wide range of groups and personalities internally and externally.
- Experience in modelling, forecasting and quantitative analysis would be advantageous.
- Innovative thinking and proactive behavior, able to work effectively and efficiently within a flexible global team environment.

At S&P Global Energy, our comprehensive view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make superior decisions and create long-term, sustainable value. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration.

S&P Global Energy is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global enables businesses, governments, and individuals with trusted data, expertise, and technology to make decisions with conviction. We are Advancing Essential Intelligence through world-leading benchmarks, data, and insights that customers need in order to plan confidently, act decisively, and thrive economically in a rapidly changing global landscape. Learn more at [www.spglobal.com/energy](http://www.spglobal.com/energy).

**Our Mission:**

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

**Our People:**

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

**Our Values:**

**Integrity, Discovery, Partnership**

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Realtime
jobs.description:
### **About Supabase**

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

### **About the Role**

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Realtime team at Supabase. Realtime lets developers send low-latency messages between clients, track and synchronize user state, and listen to database changes. Those three features are Broadcast, Presence and Postgres Changes. Broadcast also sends from the database and over HTTP, and clients can replay recent messages.

Realtime is a globally distributed Elixir cluster built on Phoenix. The team balances low latency, fair limits between projects, and the cost of running the service. Customers expect connections to stay up, so reliability matters as much as new features.

The Engineering Manager is a people, delivery and technical role. We don't expect you to write production code, but you you will lead a team of experienced engineers. We do expect you to join design discussions and help set the bar for engineering quality, testing and operations.

### What You’ll Be Responsible For

**Team & People**

- Build a healthy, high-trust team culture in a remote-first, globally distributed environment.

- Run 1:1s, performance management, career development, and onboarding for your direct reports.

- Handle people admin (leave, time off, etc.) for your team.


**Hiring**

- Own the hiring plan for your team and act as Hiring Manager. First round of interviewer for all roles on the team.

- Partner with Talent Acquisition to source, interview, and close strong candidates.

- Contribute to headcount planning, org design, and the evolution of engineering leadership at Supabase.


**Delivery & Roadmap**

- Own the team's roadmap and project management (Linear), driving accountability and clear milestones.

- Manage workflow intake and Slack triage. These are the team’s primary inboxes for cross-team requests. You decide what gets routed where, prioritized, or pushed back on.

- Own the team's weekly updates and keep stakeholders aligned without creating overhead.

- Organize effort against support tickets and maintain the team's SLO.

- Surface risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early and clearly to leadership.


**Incident Commander**

- Train as an Incident Commander. Drive coordination, resolution, and post-incident follow-up.

- Lead blameless post-incident reviews


### **You Might Be a Good Fit If You**

- Have 5+ years of engineering background, with enough depth to be credible with engineers building complex systems.

- Have 3+ years managing remote engineering teams.

- Have managed a team that built and ran a low-latency, high-connection service. Examples are WebSockets, pub/sub, messaging, presence or streaming systems.

- Have strong technical credibility in distributed systems. We look for clustering, rate limiting, backpressure and capacity planning.

- Have led a team through production incidents on a customer-facing service. You ran the follow-up work and kept the review blameless.

- Understand what developers need from a real-time API or SDK, and have shipped one to customers outside your company.

- Have experience with Elixir, Erlang or BEAM (not required but a plus).

- Have experience with Postgres logical replication and Row Level Security (not required but a plus).

- Have managed remote, globally distributed teams that work asynchronously across disparate time zones.

- Are technical enough to be credible with strong engineers, but genuinely passionate about people management. This is the work you want to do, not a track you're settling for.

- Build psychological safety and a feedback culture. You give feedback often and in the moment, ask for it back, and create space for the team to do the same.

- Operate as a multiplier. You help individuals achieve more than they could alone, and you don't need to be the best technical voice in the room.

- Coach rather than direct. You remove blockers, connect people to context, and trust your engineers to own how the work gets done.

- Have a real track record of performance management and can speak to specific examples of difficult conversations.

- Are comfortable with ambiguity and can build structure where there isn't much.

- Communicate clearly and write well. You default to async and written, set context early, and surface risks early.

- Are collaborative, low-ego and adaptable. You thrive with high-autonomy senior engineers who don't need you to be the smartest person in the room.


#### **What We Offer**

- **Fully Remote**

  We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- **ESOP**

  Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- **Tech Allowance**

  Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- **Health Benefits**

  Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- **Annual Off-Sites**

  Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- **Flexible Work**

  We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- **Professional Development**

  Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.


#### **About the Team**

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members


We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

### **About the Role**

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Pipelines team at Supabase. Supabase Pipelines is a managed change data capture product. It copies the tables you select from Supabase Postgres to other systems, then streams later changes. The product is in public alpha, with BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckLake and Snowflake destinations.

Pipelines uses Postgres logical replication and Supabase ETL, our open source replication engine written in Rust. The team works close to the database. That means replication slots, WAL retention, initial table syncs, and the load they place on a customer's source database. The team also builds and runs the destination connectors. jobs.title: Junior Credit Controller
jobs.description:
**Purpose of Position**

The Credit Control team is part of Awin’s Group Finance team and plays a key role in supporting healthy cash flow through the effective collection of outstanding receivables.

As a Junior Credit Controller, you will be responsible for supporting the collection of overdue balances across an assigned portfolio of customer accounts. This involves engaging with customers to secure payment, investigating and resolving payment-related queries, maintaining accurate collection records, and supporting the management of third-party collection cases.

The successful candidate will be organized, detail-oriented, and confident communicating with both customers and internal stakeholders to achieve positive collection outcomes.

_Please note: As this position sits on a global team, not everyone is able to communicate in Portuguese. To be fully considered, please submit your CV in English._

**Key Tasks**

- - Proactively monitor customer accounts to support timely payment collection and reduce overdue balances.
- - Escalate high-risk or long-overdue accounts in accordance with Credit Control policies and procedures
- - Investigate billing discrepancies, payment disputes, and account queries, working with internal stakeholders to support resolution.
- - Maintain accurate records of customer communications, payment status, and collection activities.
- - Support the management of third-party collection cases, including case submissions and agency follow-up.
- - Contribute to process improvements to enhance collection effectiveness and customer experience.

**Skills & Experience**

- - 1-2 years of experience in Credit Control, Accounts Receivable, Cash Collection, or a similar finance role.
- - Understanding of collection strategies, payment negotiation techniques, and customer communication best practices.
- - Strong communication skills, with the ability to build positive relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.
- - Fluency in English, both written and spoken is essential.

- - Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- - Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage workload effectively in a fast-paced environment.
- - Basic understanding of credit control, accounts receivable, and cash collection processes.
- - Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
- - Understanding of debt recovery principles and customer account management.
- - Ability to communicate professionally with customers and internal stakeholders in a multicultural environment.
- - Experience working with financial systems and ERP platforms, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365.
- - Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM/ticketing systems to manage customer queries and collection-related activities.
- **Desirable Skills & Experiences**
- - Experience working in an international business environment.
- - Ability to manage difficult collection conversations professionally while maintaining customer relationships.
- - Experience managing customer accounts, payment follow-up, and dispute resolution.
- - Experience supporting third-party collection activities.
- - Knowledge of Power BI.
- - Additional language skills

**Our Offer**

- **Flexi-Week**: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.

- **Flexi-Office**: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid working model, designed to foster collaboration, trust, and autonomy.

- **Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture**: You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace at home.

- **Meal Vouchers:** we offer you meal vouchers for lunch

- **Public Transportation**: you are entitled to a transportation voucher or card to commute to the office


_In addition, you’ll benefit from our global offering, including health and wellbeing initiatives, learning and development via Awin Academy, and peer-to-peer recognition programmes._

Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.

Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.

Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

Awin is part of the Axel Springer group.Learn more at [axelspringer.com/en/](https://www.axelspringer.com/en/), and explore the Axel Springer Essentials here: [axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why](https://www.axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why)

**About FreedUp**

FreedUp places talented Executive Assistants with founders and executives at growing US companies. We free leaders up by saving them time and effort so they can focus on the work only they can do. For our EAs, we aim to be one of the best US companies for LATAM and Filipino talent, with a supportive environment and real room to grow.

**About the role**

We’re looking for a sharp, proactive Executive Assistant to support a US-based real estate investor and operator. He owns and operates apartment buildings, manages them in-house with his own staff, and has a development project underway. His work spans acquisitions, property analysis, financing, lenders, lawyers, insurance claims, accounting and tenant escalations. His staff handles day-to-day property issues, and he steps in when things escalate.

His inbox and calendar are the bottleneck. He receives a high volume of email across every part of the business, and no one manages his calendar today. You’ll take ownership of both: triaging his email, responding where appropriate, routing what needs his attention, and building his scheduling system from scratch.

This is not a task-taker role. He needs someone with strong judgment who can quickly learn who’s who and what matters, decide what’s urgent, and keep things moving without waiting to be told. Your first 30 days will focus on fixing his top three time-killers, and by 90 days you should be running his inbox and calendar with confidence.

This is a part-time, remote position. It requires excellent written communication, sound judgment and complete discretion.

**Compensation:** 600 to 800 USD per month (depends on experience)

**Location:** Remote, Philippines

**Job Type:** Part-time

**What you'll do**

_Email triage and responsiveness (main priority)_

- Review all incoming email daily, then sort, prioritize and act on it.
- Respond directly to routine and administrative emails on his behalf, in his voice.
- Draft replies for messages that need his input or approval.
- Track open threads and follow up so nothing falls through the cracks.

_Judgment-based routing_

- Decide what’s urgent, what goes straight to him, and what goes to his staff with him cc’d.
- Learn his key contacts (lenders, lawyers, brokers, insurers, accountants, staff) and how each should be handled.
- Flag time-sensitive items, such as financing deadlines, legal matters and insurance claims, before they become problems.

_Calendar and scheduling_

- Set up and manage his calendar from scratch, including a booking link and scheduling rules.
- Schedule calls and meetings with lenders, lawyers, brokers, contractors and internal staff.
- Protect his time so his calendar reflects his real priorities.

_Process and partnership_

- Hold regular check-ins with him to review open items, routing decisions and what to adjust.
- Build and maintain a living playbook of routing rules, key contacts and recurring processes.
- Spot recurring time drains and propose practical fixes.

**Our hiring process**

1. Apply online
2. Record a short Loom video introducing yourself, then a prescreen call with a recruiter
3. Final Interview with our Recruiting Lead
4. Complete a work evaluation
5. Final interview with the client

jobs.title: Senior Growth Analyst
jobs.description:
#### Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company that empowers people and businesses around the world. We operate in diverse markets, such as financial services, healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, among others. Experian invests in people and in new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 employees in 32 countries.

Our uniqueness is valuing yours. Experian's culture, centered on people, inclusive and driven by purpose, is recognized by various awards — including World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25) and Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries, among others. Check out Experian Life on social media or explore our careers site to understand why. Experian also takes pride in being an employer that promotes equal opportunity and affirmative action.

#### Job Description

We are looking for a person with strong business vision and an analytical profile to work on the growth strategy of digital products. You will be responsible for identifying opportunities, conducting experiments, analyzing user behavior and turning data into actions that create a direct impact on growth and revenue indicators.

**Main responsibilities**

- Conduct data analysis and database cross-referencing to identify growth opportunities.
- Develop, execute and validate A/B tests.
- Analyze user behavior and journeys within digital products.
- Create dashboards and reports to track business indicators.
- Prepare projections and product performance analyses.
- Transform data into actionable insights for decision-making.
- Work in partnership with Product, Business and BizDev areas.
- Monitor growth, engagement, conversion and revenue metrics.

#### Qualifications

- Prior experience in Growth, Product, Performance or related areas.
- Intermediate SQL, with the ability to build queries and develop analytical logic.
- Knowledge of tools such as Python, Power BI and Databricks.
- Experience with A/B testing and hypothesis validation.
- Knowledge of user behavior analysis and product metrics.
- Experience with digital products will be a differentiator.
- Knowledge of acquiring, payment methods or the financial market will be considered a differentiator.

#### Additional Information

Serasa Experian is much more than you imagine. With the purpose of creating a better future, expanding opportunities for people and businesses, in Brazil we are more than 4 thousand people working across various teams and specialties. Here, every skill and diversity complements each other, and you can work on what you love most. We are committed to building an inclusive culture and an environment where people can balance their career with their personal commitments and interests, valuing well-being.

We are truly dedicated to being one of the best and most innovative companies to work for in the country, enabling incredible experiences and careers for our people. Our strong people-first approach is externally recognized through various market certifications: we were awarded by Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries and the international Top Employers certification, and we are recognized as one of the best companies for young professionals and have a 4.6 rating on Glassdoor. Each recognition tells us we are on the right path, providing an increasingly better work environment for our talent.

Experian Careers - Creating a better tomorrow together

[Find out what it's like to work for Experian by clicking here](https://www.experian.com/careers/)

jobs.title: Shopper Insights Client Associate
jobs.description:
**About dunnhumby**

dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca-Cola, Meijer, Procter & Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Shopper Insights Client Associate (Junior Analyst) who is eager to advance their career by becoming a trusted partner to key clients. You’ll support the delivery of dunnhumby’s customer-first insights and solutions, helping retailers and suppliers build a stronger shared understanding of their customers and unlock mutual growth. You’ll combine data, insights and strong client relationships to turn business questions into actionable recommendations and measurable value.

**What You'll Be Doing**

You’ll work closely with clients and colleagues across Shopper Insights, Retail and Media to turn customer data into action.

- Develop and nurture relationships with new and existing client stakeholders, establishing trust and partnership.
- Translate complex data into actionable insights and clear recommendations for client growth, using dunnhumby tools and analysis to develop compelling presentations and solutions.
- Communicate effectively and impactfully with clients to drive business outcomes, supporting high-quality deliverables and measurable customer-first value.
- Employ a consultative approach to identify client needs, build knowledge of their business and categories, and propose relevant solutions.
- Collaborate with solutions and media colleagues to deliver high-impact projects, while contributing to commercial opportunities including upselling, cross-selling and account growth.

**What We're Looking For**

You’ll bring curiosity, strong analytical thinking and the confidence to build trusted client relationships. This is a G1 Associate opportunity, so we’re looking for someone keen to learn and develop while making an impact from the start.

- Analytical mindset and interest in problem solving, with a willingness to learn how to turn data into relevant insights.
- Good communication and interpersonal skills, with an interest in developing presentation and client relationship skills.
- Strong organisation, attention to detail and accountability for day-to-day activities and deadlines.
- Ownership of key team routines, including organising and maintaining materials and templates, coordinating accesses, and keeping process documentation clear and up to date.
- Interest in developing skills in data analysis, visualisation and insight storytelling.
- Advanced English skills and an interest in the Retail/CPG industry, with a willingness to develop capabilities in client management, consulting and insight delivery.

**Brazil benefits**

- **Healthcare & protection:** CarePlus medical cover for employees and dependants, with 100% of premiums paid by dunnhumby. For G1 colleagues, the medical level is Especial II. Dental cover is also 100% paid by dunnhumby, and life assurance provides 24x monthly basic salary for accidental death, natural causes and total permanet disability.
- **Pension:** CLT employees can contribute between 1–5% of annual gross salary through BrasilPrev, with dunnhumby matching 120% of contributions, subject to the applicable vesting schedule.
- **Everyday benefits:** Meal Voucher through Edenred of R$52.40 per day and an Internet Allowance of R$113.40 per month.
- **Time off:** Permanent CLT employees receive 10 discretionary dunnhumby days in their first year, alongside 30 days of holiday per year and an additional 1/3 of one month’s salary as a vacation bonus.
- **Family & personal leave:** 180 days maternity leave, 120 days adoption leave and 20 days paternity leave, all with 100% pay, plus loyalty days and a day off for your birthday.

**What You Can Expect From Us**

We won’t just meet your expectations. We’ll defy them. So you’ll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you’d expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

You’ll also benefit from an investment in cutting-edge technology that reflects our global ambition. But with a nimble, small-business feel that gives you the freedom to play, experiment and learn.

And we don’t just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. Please let us know how we can make this process work best for you.

**Our approach to Flexible Working**

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work. We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process. For further information about how we collect and use your personal information please see our Privacy Notice which can be found **[(here)](https://www.dunnhumby.com/recruitment-privacy-notice/)**

jobs.title: Senior Salesforce Engineer
jobs.description:
**Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.**

**GET TO KNOW US**

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

**Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!**

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We are hiring a Senior Salesforce Engineerin our Resellers Team in Brazil! This is a **Remote – Brazil** position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

As a Senior Salesforce Software Engineer, you will be responsible for analyzing and developing high-quality, scalable solutions tailored to our reseller partners. You will own the software lifecycle end-to-end, creating technical documentation, developing features, supporting UAT/homologation, and maintaining stable live operations. Additionally, you will assist partners with technical inquiries and issue resolution, driving incident analysis and root-cause fixes to ensure a robust and reliable product.

In this role, you will work in close alignment with Product Managers to translate business rules into scalable technical solutions, support the Tech Lead in key architectural decisions, and collaborate cross-functionally with other squads. By balancing trade-offs between speed and quality, you will actively contribute to fostering a healthy, collaborative, and high-performing engineering environment.

**YOUR IMPACT**

- Own the architecture and development of solutions within our Salesforce platform for the Resellers squad, making design decisions that balance scalability, maintainability, and high performance.
- Lead RFCs and PRDs, creating detailed technical documentation, setting standards, and acting as a technical reference in code and design reviews.
- Drive end-to-end incident resolution and root-cause analysis (post-mortems) for reseller operations, converting lessons learned into long-term system stability and quality.
- Support homologation, deployment, and live operations, actively assisting reseller partners with technical queries, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
- Partner closely with Product Managers and Tech Leads to align business requirements, evaluate technical trade-offs, and guide architectural choices across squads.
- Proactively manage technical debt across the team's codebase, ensuring a clean, scalable architecture and removing roadblocks autonomously.
- Build solutions through both declarative programming (Flows, Approval Processes) and code (Apex, LWC, Aura), adhering to SOLID principles and leveraging GitHub CI/CD pipelines.
- Support hiring by interviewing candidates and helping spot structural inefficiencies or roadblocks within the team.
- Roll up your sleeves and help when needed. Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

**WHO YOU ARE**

- Hands-on experience with Salesforce development (Apex, JavaScript), with a proven track record of designing, building, and maintaining scalable solutions end-to-end.
- Strong expertise in Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura, and Salesforce declarative automation tools (Flows, Approval Processes), alongside solid knowledge of SOLID design patterns and Git-based CI/CD pipelines.
- Experienced in creating complete technical documentation, analyzing architectural trade-offs, and acting as a technical guide to support Tech Leads and Product Managers.
- A collaborative team player with strong problem-solving skills, comfortable driving incident resolution, root-cause analysis, and supporting partners with complex queries to maintain product stability.
- Proven ability to work autonomously in agile, cross-functional environments, fostering a healthy, inclusive, and collaborative team culture.
- Strong verbal and written communicator with fluent/advanced English skills, capable of influencing technical decisions and presenting complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience with Salesforce development (Apex, JavaScript) are mandatory requirements**.**

**WHAT WE OFFER YOU**

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

**Our benefits include:**

**WELLHUB:** Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

**WELLZ:** A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

**HEALTHCARE:** Health, dental, and life insurance.

**FLEXIBLE WORK:** As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

**FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:** Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

**PAID TIME OFF:** It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

**PAID PARENTAL LEAVE:** Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

**CAREER GROWTH:** Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

**CULTURE:** You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. [Learn more about our shared culture and values here.](https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/our-values/)

**Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on** [**Instagram**](https://www.instagram.com/lifeatwellhub/) **@lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on** [**YouTube**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZgIPiszTVm4) **!**

**Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub**

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. [Read more about it here.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/wellhub_fairpay-syndio-activity-7407826561531363328-wbN_?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAAzHQWABKsRqcpvxy4QpDCJNe_szRdC4hgY)

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our [Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos.](https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/job-applicant-privacy-notice/#:~:text=Aviso%20de%20Privacidade%20para%20Candidatos)

jobs.description:
**About the company**

Trust Wallet is the secure, self-custody Web3 wallet that empowers people to own and control their digital assets. Whether you're new to crypto or an experienced user, Trust Wallet makes it easier, safer, and more convenient to explore Web3, securely access dApps, manage your crypto, and buy and sell digital assets, all in one place.

**About the role**

We’re looking for a proactive Business Operations Associate to keep the team running smoothly. You’ll manage vendors, contracts, payments and tool access, help test our product, and improve how we work.

**What you’ll do**

- Vendors and contracts: own the vendor inventory (contracts, pricing, owners), track renewals, route NDAs and agreements for signature, and flag unused subscriptions so we can cut costs

- Payments and finance: process vendor payments, collect invoices and reimbursements, follow up on refunds, and support reconciliation

- Access management: map our tools, owners and admins, centralize billing, and support access reviews

- Product support: test new features, report and re-test bugs, triage user feedback, and research vendors and competitors

- Process and documentation: keep Notion and Google Drive organized, maintain SOPs, automate repetitive tasks, and run meeting logistics

- Events and travel: plan team offsites and organize travel for trips and industry events


**What we’re looking for**

- 3 years in business operations, procurement or finance operations, ideally at a startup or tech company

- Experience with vendor management, invoices and payments

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, with strong follow-through

- Comfortable administering SaaS tools (Google Workspace, Notion, Slack)


**Nice to have:** a Web3 or fintech background, experience with automation tools (Zapier, Apps Script), AI tools or event-planning experience.

### **Additional Information**

This is a global and fully remote role. You must have the right to work for the country you are based.

### **Why work at Trust Wallet?**

- Be a part of the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem that continues to grow.

- Excellent learning and career development opportunities.

- Work alongside diverse, world-class talent, in an environment where learning and growth opportunities are endless.

- Tackle fast-paced, challenging and unique projects.

- Work in a truly global organization, with international teams and a flat organizational structure.

- Work fully remotely with flexible working hours.

- Enjoy competitive salary and benefits.


Apply today to join our team in building the world’s most trusted and secure crypto wallet and enable a decentralized future for everyone.

Trust Wallet is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

_*Due to the large amount of the applications, please consider your application as unsuccessful should you not be contacted within 4 weeks from your application date._

jobs.title: Paid Ads Specialist
jobs.description:
**About us:** At Remote Talent LATAM, we connect top Latin American talent with leading U.S. marketing agencies. We guide businesses and candidates through every step of the hiring process, ensuring the perfect match in skills, culture, and goals. While we’re not direct employers, we act as a trusted partner, bridging the gap between exceptional talent and growing opportunities **Our Client:**

Our client is an e-commerce business specializing in diesel truck performance parts, automotive upgrades, and accessories. The company focuses on helping customers find the right products through a streamlined shopping experience, backed by knowledgeable customer support and specialized services. They are looking for a proactive paid advertising professional to take ownership of their campaigns, improve performance, and support profitable growth.

**What you will do:**

We’re looking for a hands-on, analytical Paid Ads Specialist to manage and optimize our client’s paid advertising campaigns across multiple platforms. This role is ideal for someone who understands e-commerce performance marketing, takes initiative in identifying opportunities, and can translate campaign data into actionable recommendations that drive business results.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Paid Advertising Management**

- Own and manage paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), and Microsoft Ads (Bing).
- Manage monthly advertising budgets of up to $100,000, ensuring spend is strategically allocated toward the highest-performing channels and campaigns.
- Develop, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns to maximize ROAS, revenue, and profitability.
- Manage Google Shopping, Performance Max, Search, Display, and remarketing campaigns.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant - Inbox and Calendar Management
jobs.description:
**About FreedUp**

FreedUp places talented Executive Assistants with founders and executives at growing US companies. We free leaders up by saving them time and effort so they can focus on the work only they can do. For our EAs, we aim to be one of the best US companies for LATAM and Filipino talent, with a supportive environment and real room to grow.

**About the role**

We’re looking for a sharp, proactive Executive Assistant to support a US-based real estate investor and operator. He owns and operates apartment buildings, manages them in-house with his own staff, and has a development project underway. His work spans acquisitions, property analysis, financing, lenders, lawyers, insurance claims, accounting and tenant escalations. His staff handles day-to-day property issues, and he steps in when things escalate.

His inbox and calendar are the bottleneck. He receives a high volume of email across every part of the business, and no one manages his calendar today. You’ll take ownership of both: triaging his email, responding where appropriate, routing what needs his attention, and building his scheduling system from scratch.

This is not a task-taker role. He needs someone with strong judgment who can quickly learn who’s who and what matters, decide what’s urgent, and keep things moving without waiting to be told. Your first 30 days will focus on fixing his top three time-killers, and by 90 days you should be running his inbox and calendar with confidence.

This is a part-time, remote position. It requires excellent written communication, sound judgment and complete discretion.

**Compensation:** 600 to 800 USD per month (depends on experience)

**Location:** Remote, LATAM

**Job Type:** Part-time

**What you'll do**

_Email triage and responsiveness (main priority)_

- Review all incoming email daily, then sort, prioritize and act on it.
- Respond directly to routine and administrative emails on his behalf, in his voice.
- Draft replies for messages that need his input or approval.
- Track open threads and follow up so nothing falls through the cracks.

_Judgment-based routing_

- Decide what’s urgent, what goes straight to him, and what goes to his staff with him cc’d.
- Learn his key contacts (lenders, lawyers, brokers, insurers, accountants, staff) and how each should be handled.
- Flag time-sensitive items, such as financing deadlines, legal matters and insurance claims, before they become problems.

_Calendar and scheduling_

- Set up and manage his calendar from scratch, including a booking link and scheduling rules.
- Schedule calls and meetings with lenders, lawyers, brokers, contractors and internal staff.
- Protect his time so his calendar reflects his real priorities.

_Process and partnership_

- Hold regular check-ins with him to review open items, routing decisions and what to adjust.
- Build and maintain a living playbook of routing rules, key contacts and recurring processes.
- Spot recurring time drains and propose practical fixes.

**Our hiring process**

1. Apply online
2. Record a short Loom video introducing yourself, then a prescreen call with a recruiter
3. Final Interview with our Recruiting Lead
4. Complete a work evaluation
5. Final interview with the client

jobs.description:

#### Location: Remote (EST preferred)  Reports To: Associate Director, AI Marketing  Department: AI Marketing

**About Darkroom**

**Darkroom** is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by **Matter**, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: **billions in attributable revenue** driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the **fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000)** and among the **most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos)**. Our founders were recognized by **Forbes 30 Under 30** for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising.

### **About the Role**

The way consumers discover, evaluate, and choose brands is being rewritten in real time. LLM-powered search, AI agents, and generative experiences are replacing the decade-old playbook of keywords and blue links. Darkroom is building a new AI Marketing division to own this space, and we need an SEO Specialist who can operate at the intersection of traditional organic search and the emerging world of AI-mediated discovery.

As an SEO Specialist within the AI Marketing division, you will manage all aspects of SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) strategy and execution for a portfolio of high-growth consumer brands. This is not a traditional SEO role. You will be responsible for ensuring that Darkroom clients are discoverable, recommended, and cited by both traditional search engines and LLM-powered platforms like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Gemini.

You will report to the Associate Director of AI Marketing and work closely with content, creative, paid media, and data teams to deliver integrated organic growth strategies. This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment for someone who is curious about AI, obsessed with search, and ready to help define a category that is still being written.

### **What You’ll Do**

#### **SEO Strategy & Execution**

- Develop and implement comprehensive SEO strategies aligned with client business objectives across e-commerce, DTC, and consumer brands.

- Conduct keyword research, site audits, and competitor analyses to identify growth opportunities in both traditional and AI-powered search environments.

- Continuously analyze and report on SEO performance metrics, providing actionable insights and clear recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders.

- Monitor rankings, organic traffic, and AI citation frequency, adjusting tactics based on performance data.


#### **AI Search & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**

- Optimize client content and digital properties for visibility within LLM-powered search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude).

- Develop and execute strategies to increase how often and how favorably client brands are referenced in AI-generated answers and recommendations.

- Monitor the rapidly shifting landscape of how LLMs source, rank, and cite information, and translate changes into actionable client strategies.

- Build and maintain frameworks for tracking “AI share of voice” across generative search platforms.


#### **On-Page & Technical SEO**

- Optimize website content, meta tags, structured data, and internal linking structures to improve visibility in both traditional and AI search.

- Perform technical audits to identify crawl issues, indexation bottlenecks, site performance concerns, and schema markup opportunities.

- Architect technical SEO, knowledge graphs, and entity-based optimization to maximize machine readability and AI citation potential.

- Collaborate with development teams to recommend and implement SEO-friendly site structures and code enhancements.


#### **Content Strategy & Off-Page**

- Collaborate with content teams to build strategies that serve dual purposes: ranking in traditional search AND being surfaced by AI systems as authoritative, trustworthy sources.

- Build and maintain effective link-building campaigns to enhance domain authority and AI discoverability.

- Identify high-value external partnership opportunities, guest posting placements, and relevant industry directories.

- Monitor and manage backlink profiles to maintain a strong online reputation.

- Create and manage content briefs, oversee article creation, and perform QA to ensure premium quality outputs across all content deliverables.


#### **Collaboration & Communication**

- Partner with cross-functional teams (Content, Creative, Paid Media, Marketplaces, Retention) to deliver integrated marketing campaigns.

- Present complex SEO and GEO insights to clients and stakeholders in clear, accessible language.

- Support the Associate Director in developing proprietary methodologies, playbooks, and reporting frameworks for AI marketing services.

- Foster a culture of continuous learning and experimentation, sharing AI search best practices across the broader Darkroom organization.


### **What You’ll Need**

#### **Experience**

- 2–4 years of experience managing SEO strategies for e-commerce, consumer, or digital-first brands.

- Proven track record in driving organic traffic growth, keyword ranking improvements, and ROI-focused SEO campaigns.

- Familiarity with SEO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or Moz.

- Agency experience is a strong plus.


#### **Skills**

- Deep understanding of on-page SEO, link-building, technical SEO, and structured data best practices.

- Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data into actionable insights and client-ready reports.

- Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, or JavaScript is a plus.

- Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to present complex ideas clearly.

- Adaptability to stay ahead of ever-changing search engine algorithms and emerging AI search platforms.


### **Nice to Have**

- Background in local SEO, multi-location brands, or programmatic SEO.

- Knowledge of PR and digital authority-building strategies that support LLM trust signals.

- Experience in e-commerce SEO or product discovery optimization.


### **What Sets You Apart**

- You’re already experimenting with GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), LLM-SEO, or AI search strategies — even if those terms barely existed a year ago.

- You understand how ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews decide what to cite, and why that matters for brands.

- You’re obsessed with AI and LLMs — not just “interested.” You’ve played with the APIs, tested prompts, and you have opinions about structured vs. unstructured content for machine readability.

- You think about search as a broader ecosystem that includes AI assistants, voice search, agentic browsing, and recommendation engines — not just Google page one.

- You see what’s happening in AI search not as a threat to SEO, but as the biggest opportunity in a decade.


### **Working at Darkroom**

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

- **Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

- **Remote-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.

- **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

- **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.


### **Equal Opportunity Statement**

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace — we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Tooling
jobs.description:
### **About Supabase**

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

### **About the Role**

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our AI Tooling team and help shape how developers and agents build with Supabase. You'll build and own our AI tooling, including agents, the MCP server, agent skills and the dashboard assistant, and as the space moves you'll build the tooling for new technologies too. You'll build it all eval-first: every tool ships with evals and metrics, so we know, with evidence, that it makes agents better rather than worse.

You'll work closely with the Docs, CLI, Frontend and SDK teams, and with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers who run these services in production. Other teams contribute to AI Tooling to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities, and you'll help them do that while keeping the quality bar high.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

### What You’ll Be Responsible For

- Build and improve the AI tooling we run today, including the MCP server, agent skills, agents and the Assistant.

- Make new Supabase products usable by agents from day one: tools, skills and evals for new product surfaces. Also build tooling for new AI technologies as they emerge: prototype quickly, evaluate honestly, and decide with the team what is worth taking to production.

- Drive an eval-first approach: build and improve evals, instrumentation and feedback loops, measure tools against a no-tool baseline, and help define the quality KPIs and gates that stop regressions shipping.

- Understand how customers and agents actually use what we ship, and turn that into improvements to our tooling, interfaces and documentation.

- Design how documentation and product knowledge are exposed to agents, and measure whether it works.

- Build patterns and tools that help customers add AI to their own apps, such as MCP on Edge Functions, vector embeddings and agents running on Edge Functions.

- Enable teams to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities through contributions to AI Tooling: clear contribution paths, templates, documentation and review practice.

- Centralise shared AI logic so teams reuse it rather than duplicate it.

- Ship tools that are battle-tested, with strong tests, benchmarking and stress testing where it counts.

- Work with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers on reliability, auth and hosting.

- Work across Docs, CLI, Frontend, SDK and other teams to deliver one coherent developer experience, and stay close to the fast-moving AI ecosystem.


### **You Might Be a Good Fit If You**

#### Must have:

- Have 5+ years of experience in professional software engineering experience.

- Write strong **TypeScript** and know the JavaScript ecosystem well: npm, ES modules, bundlers, compatibility.

- Are deeply familiar with the AI ecosystem: current tools, agent patterns and practical trade-offs. You can tell a durable pattern from hype.

- Have built developer tools, product interfaces or platform primitives used by other engineers.

- Have designed or used evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, reliability and task success, and understand baselines, variance and cost.

- Have strong judgement about where AI improves workflows and how to avoid fragile or gimmicky experiences.

- Write tests and validate reliability in real-world conditions.

- Know Postgres and relational database practice.

- Communicate clearly in writing, work across product, engineering and docs, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams.

- Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly.


#### Nice to have:

- Experience with vector databases and embeddings, ideally pgvector.

- Examples of customer-facing AI features or agents you've shipped.

- Examples of documentation or structured knowledge designed for developers or agents.

- Experience with Braintrust or a similar eval and tracing platform, or setting up CI quality gates.

- Open-source contributions or developer tooling you've maintained.

- Experience across several product surfaces or teams.


#### **What We Offer**

- **Fully Remote**

  We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- **ESOP**

  Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- **Tech Allowance**

  Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- **Health Benefits**

  Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- **Annual Off-Sites**

  Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- **Flexible Work**

  We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- **Professional Development**

  Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.


#### **About the Team**

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members


We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

**About Us**

Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.

We are a team of 600+ fully remote people in 60+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 250M+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community!

We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team.

**About The Role**

The Cloud Engineer role is critical to scaling Chess.com's infrastructure to support millions of daily chess games and serve global users. This position combines site reliability engineering expertise with cloud infrastructure management, directly impacting system performance, reliability, and scalability across Chess.com's multi-regional distributed architecture. The role requires deep technical expertise in both infrastructure automation and application optimization to maintain Chess.com's position as a high-traffic gaming platform while enabling rapid feature development and deployment.

- **Collaborate with development teams** to implement cloud service integration best practices and optimize application deployment architectures
- **Implement Infrastructure as Code practices** using Terraform to manage all cloud resources, ensuring consistent, automated, and scalable deployment processes
- **Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines** with GitOps approaches using tools like ArgoCD to enable rapid, reliable software delivery
- **Monitor and enhance system observability** through implementation of modern monitoring stacks including Prometheus, Mimir, ES, Vector and Tempo

**Qualifications**

- **7+ years of experience managing large-scale, cloud-native distributed systems** with proven ability to handle high-traffic production environments
- **Expert-level proficiency with Kubernetes** including cluster deployment, management, and advanced orchestration patterns
- **Advanced Infrastructure as Code experience** with Terraform for managing complex cloud and Kubernetes resources in production
- **Strong programming skills in Golang** with demonstrated ability to optimize high-performance services and troubleshoot complex codebases
- **Deep understanding of distributed systems design** including failure modes, architectural principles, and data modeling strategies

- **Proficiency with GitOps and CI/CD methodologies** using modern deployment automation and continuous integration practices
- **Hands-on experience with observability tools** including metrics, logging, and distributed tracing systems for high-scale environments
- **Strong Linux systems administration skills** with deep knowledge of system internals and performance optimization
- **Excellent collaboration and communication skills** for working effectively in globally distributed teams

**Preferred Skills and Qualifications**

- **Chess programming and optimization experience** including bit-level manipulations and performance tuning for gaming applications
- **TypeScript development experience** for full-stack infrastructure and tooling development
- **Service mesh implementation experience** particularly in hybrid multi-cloud and bare-metal environments
- **Message broker expertise** with systems like Kafka, PubSub, and Redis for event-driven architectures
- **Gaming industry experience** with understanding of real-time systems and high-concurrency requirements
- **Experience with Google Cloud partnerships** and direct collaboration with cloud provider engineering teams
- **C/C++ programming experience** for low-level system optimizations
- **Advanced networking knowledge** for multi-regional infrastructure and hybrid cloud connectivity
- **Experience managing bare-metal infrastructure** and integrating with cloud-native services
- **Database performance optimization** experience with large-scale data systems and indexing strategies

**About the Opportunity**

- This is a full-time opportunity
- We are 100% remote (work from anywhere!)

- [Our Values](https://www.chess.com/jobs#values)

### **About Supabase**

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

### **About the Role**

We're hiring a Product Manager to own Postgres itself at Supabase. Every Supabase project is a full Postgres database, and Postgres is the foundation that Auth, Storage, Realtime and Edge Functions run on. You'll own the product experience of the database: Postgres versions and upgrades, maintenance, observability, extensions and security.

You'll work closely with our Postgres engineering teams and with the PM lead for Databases, who leads [Multigres](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PxlZssDNrws). You'll define the Postgres requirements that architecture must meet, and own how customers experience their database through that transition.

This role is ideal for someone who loves Postgres, sweats the details that make a database trustworthy, and is excited about improving the experience for millions of developers. Small improvements here compound across every project on the platform.

### What You’ll Be Responsible For

- **You'll own Postgres versions, upgrades and end-of-life.** Which major and minor versions we support, how and when customers upgrade, and how we retire old versions. Your goal is to make upgrades routine rather than risky.

- **You'll make maintenance predictable.** You'll design how we schedule, communicate and run maintenance windows so customers stay informed and in control, and disruption is rare and expected.

- **You'll help developers understand their database.** Query performance, metrics, logs and advisors: you'll own the path from "my database is slow" to the fix.

- **You'll own our extension ecosystem.** Which extensions we offer, how we evaluate and support new ones, and how we keep them working across versions.

- **You'll own Postgres security.** Roles and permissions, Row Level Security ergonomics, secure defaults, and how we respond to Postgres and extension CVEs.

- **You'll talk to developers across the full spectrum**, from indie developers on their first project to enterprises running critical workloads, and bring what you learn into every prioritization call.

- **You'll own the problem definition, requirements and success metrics** for what we ship, such as upgrade success rate, the share of the fleet on supported versions, and time-to-diagnose for performance problems. You'll set the metric before the team builds, then track it after launch.

- **You'll keep Engineering, Support and GTM aligned.** You'll own the plan of record for what's coming, why, and in what order, and communicate version changes and deprecations clearly to customers.

- **Have shipped products where reliability and trust are the experience.** You treat downtime and breaking changes as product problems, not just operational ones.

- **Write clearly.** Your specs, announcements and deprecation notices leave little room for confusion.

- **Build with what you own.** You run queries, test upgrades and try extensions yourself, and form opinions through first-hand use.

- **Use AI to move faster.** You use AI tools to compress research, drafting and feedback synthesis so you spend more time on judgment calls.

- **Work async by default.** Supabase is fully remote. You make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings.


#### Strong signal

- Worked on a managed database service.

- Ran Postgres in production: upgrades, tuning, incident response.

- Worked on database observability, performance tooling, or security and compliance products.

- Contributed to Postgres, its extensions, or the wider open-source community.

- Shipped something using Supabase.

jobs.title: IT & Security Support Analyst
jobs.description:
#### **About us**

OpenZeppelin is the security standard onchain finance is built on. Founded in 2015, our mission is to accelerate the world's transition to an open financial system, built on open standards and secured by rigorous research.

Our open-source Contract Libraries have facilitated over $35 trillion in onchain value and are used by 10 of the top 10 tokenized money market funds and 9 of the top 10 stablecoins by market cap.

We combine AI-native security tooling with deep research and a decade of audit expertise to support leading institutions and crypto-native teams shaping the next generation of digital assets like DTCC, Fidelity, Coinbase, Uniswap, Aave, the Ethereum Foundation, and many more across the full secure development lifecycle.

**Please note:** Always refer to OpenZeppelin's official job page for the most accurate information about our open roles, as we have seen multiple third party job sites posting inaccurate information.

#### **The IT & Security Team**

OpenZeppelin is a leader in blockchain security, providing cutting-edge security audits and services to top Web3 organizations. Our Security and IT team plays a critical role in safeguarding our infrastructure, ensuring compliance, and enabling our distributed team with secure and efficient IT solutions.

#### **What you'll be doing**

**Security & Compliance Support:**

- Assist in managing security tools, including endpoint security (e.g., MDM solutions like Jamf or Intune).
- Support implementation of security policies and procedures.
- Help with internal security audits and compliance documentation.
- Monitor system access and assist in enforcing security controls.
- Participate in incident response activities and learn best practices for handling security incidents.

**IT Operations & Support:**

- Help with onboarding and offboarding processes, including provisioning accounts and setting up workstations.
- Provide technical support for remote employees, troubleshooting basic IT and security issues.
- Maintain IT assets and document configurations.
- Assist with integrations, automations, and basic scripting tasks where applicable.

**Growth & Learning Opportunities:**

- Work closely with senior engineers to gain hands-on experience in IT security and compliance.
- Receive mentorship and training in security best practices, cloud security, and compliance frameworks.
- Contribute to internal security awareness initiatives.

#### **You have**

- 1-3 years of experience in IT or security-related roles (help desk, IT support, sysadmin, security analyst, etc.).
- Basic knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Google Workspace) and security tools.
- Basic knowledge on security and configuration controls of AI tools ( claude/claude code, chatgpt/codex etc..)
- Some experience with IT administration, endpoint security, or identity/access management.
- Understanding of security best practices and a willingness to learn more about SOC 2, ISO 27001, and compliance frameworks.
- Good problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a remote-first team.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

#### **Nice to have**

- Hands-on experience with MDM solutions (e.g., Jamf, Intune or others).
- Understanding of networking fundamentals (firewalls, VPNs, DNS).
- Certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Google IT Support, or AWS Cloud Practitioner.
- Exposure to security tools such as SIEM, EDR, or vulnerability scanners.
- Passion for cybersecurity and an eagerness to grow into a more senior role.

#### **Logistics:**

Our interview process takes place on Google Meet and tends to consist of the following stages:

- Recruiter Interview (30 minutes)
- Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)
- Team Interview (30 minutes)
- Leadership Interview (30 minutes)
- Paid work trial (up to 20 hours of paid work)
- Reference checks

#### **Benefits**

- Meet your teammates at company gatherings around the world 😎
- Enjoy the flexibility of fully remote work 🌎
- Take the time you need with flexible time off 🏝
- Grow your family with 8 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks for secondary caregivers, and a one-time $3,600 baby bonus 💙
- Build your ideal home office with up to $500 in equipment support 🪑
- Stay covered with medical insurance 🏥
- Keep growing with learning and development opportunities 🧠
- Get a monthly stipend for your preferred co-working space 💻

At **OpenZeppelin**, we are an equal opportunity employer and we value different perspectives. We are committed to building a diverse workforce. This includes but is not limited to gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, national origin and other characteristics that make each one of us unique. In this uniqueness, we find the most value. Come join us!

#### Use of AI as part of the recruiting process

As part of OpenZeppelin’s recruitment process, we may use automated tools, including artificial intelligence, to assist in reviewing applications and assessing candidate qualifications. These tools are used to support our People team by identifying relevant skills and experience, and are not used to make decisions solely by automated means. All hiring decisions involve human review. Any personal data provided as part of your application will be processed in accordance with OpenZeppelin’s [Data Privacy Notice](https://www.openzeppelin.com/privacy).

If you have questions about this recruitment process or would like to request human review of your application, please contact us at talent@openzeppelin.com.

## **LocalStack - the Local Cloud Sandbox for Developers and AI Agents**

We are a fast-growing Series A startup building cutting-edge technology to revolutionize cloud development processes and support highly efficient dev&test feedback loops. LocalStack is a local cloud development platform. LocalStack makes it easier, faster, and less expensive for software teams to ship reliable, high-quality applications to the cloud.

The cloud was built to run software, not to support AI-native development workflows. As the world's leading local cloud development platform, LocalStack provides secure local sandboxes that simulate cloud environments, enabling AI agents and software developers to find and fix risks faster and more effectively than they can in the cloud.

Our customer base ranges from SMBs to Global Fortune 500 companies. Our clients include companies like NASA, Harness, IBM, Workday, Comcast, Apple, 3M, Block and many more.
