jobs.description:
**Company Description**

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: [pro.doctoralia.es](http://pro.doctoralia.es)

**Why join us?**

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now _and_ build for long-term success.

**Key Job responsibilities:**

- Design, automate, and run QA workflows — sampling, metrics, quality dashboards, and throughput reporting — so we can measure quality in numbers for all our projects.

- Support in building and maintaining labelling interfaces in Label Studio when needed: configure new projects, refine layouts, and make annotation faster, specific and less error-prone.

- Write clear, testable annotation guidelines for new projects, and keep the growing library of guidelines and project docs organised and current.

- Source, onboard and coordinate our freelance annotators alongside the AI Annotations Lead: track deadlines, chase deliverables, answer their questions, and keep projects moving.

- When needed, turn annotation output and project data into simple, decision-useful summaries for the Lead or stakeholders.

- Support the area of data analysis and reporting: the quantitative side of how we track project health and quality.

- Leading the programs to validate the quality of AI systems.


**Requirements:**

- Previous experience in project coordination (especially within AI/ tech area)

- Comfort working with data: you can build a spreadsheet model, calculate and interpret quality or agreement metrics, and are eager to (or already do) use light Python / pandas to automate checks.

- Strong written communication and structured thinking, essential for writing guidelines that annotators actually follow.

- Proven follow-through coordinating people or projects to deadlines (freelancers, vendors, cross functional partners, or similar).

- Self-directed: you can own an area and run it largely independently.

- Fluent English, plus working fluency in at least one of: Italian, Portuguese or Polish.


**What to Expect from Our Hiring Process**

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ **Intro Chat**– A first call with our Talent Partner [Mariam Bokuchava](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mariam-b-ba8bba82/) to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

**2️⃣Hiring Manager Interview** – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with your potential manager in this role **.** Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

**3️⃣Business Case –** 45 Min Live-case study session

4️⃣ **Additional/ Final Interview (Optional)** – A final conversation with another **[senior leader/stakeholder/peer]** from our Global Team.

**5️⃣ References & Offer!**

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

**💙 Global Benefits –** No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

- Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.

- Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.

- Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.


**📍 Local Perks –** Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

**🚀 Career Growth –** We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

**🌎 A Truly Global Team –** Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

**⏳ Flexibility That Works for You –** Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

_Please note:_ At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

**What We Believe In**

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

**📊 Focus on results –** we're here to make an impact.

**🧠 Think like an owner –** take responsibility, drive outcomes.

**✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean –** smart solutions over complexity.

**🔊 Be respectful and radically honest –** openness builds trust.

**📚 Learn and be curious –** growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our [Glassdoor](https://www.glassdoor.com.br/Avalia%C3%A7%C3%B5es/DocPlanner-Avalia%C3%A7%C3%B5es-E1071394.htm?countryRedirect=true) to hear what our people say!

We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: [pro.doctoralia.es](http://pro.doctoralia.es)

**Why join us?**

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now _and_ build for long-term success.

**Job Description**

Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline.

You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap.

We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on!

**How will you make an impact?**

**Creative Strategy**

- Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals

- Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs

- Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements


**Asset Preparation & Coordination**

- Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking

- Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable

- Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework


**Creative Intelligence & Testing**

- Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence

- Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results

- Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs


**Tracking & Measurement**

- Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately

- Monitor creative fatigue and flag refresh cycles proactively, before performance declines


**Team Flexibility**

- Step into hands-on campaign management when needed - covering colleagues' absences or supporting new market initiatives.


**What We're Looking For**

- 4+ years in performance marketing with a proven track record in creative strategy, or a media buying background with hands-on experience in paid social creative (Meta Ads required; TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, or Bing a plus)

- Hands-on experience in paid media performance, including campaign set-up and management - able to step into hands-on campaign management when team capacity is stretched

- Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale

- Strong analytical skills - comfortable pulling and interpreting creative performance data independently, not relying on assumptions

- Experience designing and running structured creative tests, not ad hoc experimentation

- Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams

- Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese a strong plus given our market footprint

- Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously


**Nice to Have**

- Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools

- Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools

- Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models


**What to Expect from Our Hiring Process**

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ **Intro Chat**– A first call with our Talent Partner,to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

**2️⃣TestGorilla –**(SHL numerical reasoning assessment).

**3️⃣Hiring Manager Interview** – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with the hiring manager and your potential manager in this role **.** Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

**5️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview (Optional)** – A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team.

**6️⃣ References & Offer!**

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

**💙 Global Benefits –** No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

- Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.

- Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.

- Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.


**📍 Local Perks –** Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

**🚀 Career Growth –** We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

**🌎 A Truly Global Team –** Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

**⏳ Flexibility That Works for You –** Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

**✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean –** smart solutions over complexity.

**🔊 Be respectful and radically honest –** openness builds trust.

**📚 Learn and be curious –** growth is part of the job.

We’re a tight-knit team of creative and analytical thinkers, building performance-first creative systems and partnering with some of the world’s largest brands.

We value great work with talented, innovative & driven people, making meaningful connections with like-minded creatives along the way!

### What you'll do

- Own 4–7 open roles at once, start to finish (mostly individual contributor hires, occasionally stepping up to team lead).

- Lead intake conversations with hiring managers to nail down what "great" looks like.

- Run the full hiring journey: sourcing, screening, scheduling, offers.

- Keep Ashby clean and your pipeline metrics sharp on every role you own.

- Partner with hiring managers on what a strong scorecard looks like, and lead debriefs that actually move things forward..

- Run offer conversations solo for individual contributor hires.


### Who you are

- 2+ years in recruiting, ideally at a marketing/advertising agency, in services, or at a remote-first tech company.

- You've hired individual contributors and first-time managers, and you know the difference.

- You can tell a senior hiring manager something they don't want to hear (and they thank you for it after).

- You have strong opinions about what "great" looks like, and you can defend them.


### Success metrics (90 days):

- Time-to-fill on assigned roles at or below team baseline.

- Offer acceptance rate above 80%.

- Hiring manager NPS positive on every loop closed.

- Zero level/compensation miscalibration on closed offers.


### **What we offer**

- A fast-growing agency with tier-one clients

- A culture built on autonomy, transparency, and high performance

- Unlimited Time Off & Sick Days

- Flexible working hours

- Fully remote (with the possibility to work from anywhere)

- High opportunity for growth!

You’ll work closely with the creative team to align on content direction and with project managers to keep timelines on track. You’ll also support and guide UGC Coordinators by delegating tasks and stepping in when needed.

We’re looking for someone who is organized, proactive, a strong communicator, and comfortable owning outcomes, not just tasks.

This is a full-time, **fully remote position**, with **EST working hours** overlap required.

**What you’ll do**

- Own end-to-end execution of UGC campaigns for key accounts, from creator sourcing to final delivery

- Identify, vet, and secure creators based on campaign needs and brand fit

- Manage all creator communication, including outreach, follow-ups, and issue resolution

- Ensure creators deliver content on time and according to the brief

- Collaborate with project managers to ensure smooth execution and timely delivery

- Work closely with and manage UGC Coordinators to ensure high-quality execution, strong campaign outcomes, and timely delivery

- Keep internal systems clean and up to date

- Oversee creator payments and agreements to ensure accuracy and completion


**What we’re looking for:**

- At least 2 years of experience owning UGC or influencer marketing campaigns end-to-end

- Solid understanding of UGC best practices and creator content

- Hands-on experience with ClickUp or a similar project management tool

- Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills

- Highly organized and able to manage multiple tasks and campaigns at once in a fast-paced environment

- Tech-savvy and quick to adapt to new tools and platforms

- Proactive, self-motivated, and able to work independently

- Strong team player with excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills

- Strong attention to detail, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks

- Available to work during EST business hours.


**While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:**

- Familiarity with tools like Airtable, [Frame.io](http://Frame.io), Mailshake, and Smartlead

- Experience in fast-paced agency or startup environments.


**Why join us?**

- Full campaign ownership for top global brands

- Global and supportive team

- Unlimited Time Off & Sick Days

- Flexible hours (EST overlap required)

- Fully remote

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payouts - gift cards and money - to anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Google, GitHub, and Notion, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that matters - and for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the 80s.

### About the role

**What we work on:** Customers can send thousands of payouts in a few clicks, but making that simple takes complex engineering. We move billions of dollars through our platform, manage a catalog of 2,500+ redemption options, and deliver to recipients in 200+ countries. Our work spans the whole experience: helping businesses get started, giving large organizations the tools to manage their payouts, expanding what customers and recipients can do with Tremendous, and building the platform that supports it all.

**How we build:** Engineers drive projects end to end, from helping shape what gets built to measuring whether it worked. We work async, so writing is how work gets done here. Projects start with a tech brief, and we document decisions so teammates can catch up without another meeting. We use AI throughout to write and review code, explore unfamiliar parts of the codebase, and pressure-test ideas.

**What we value:** We’re deliberate about which tech debt we tackle and when, prioritizing work that unblocks development and strengthens our infrastructure. When incidents happen, we respond, conduct a blameless post-mortem, and address the underlying causes - whether they’re in our systems, processes, or application security. We work through problems openly, seek input from people who know the problem best, and change our minds when someone has a better answer.

### **What you’ll do**

- Architect, build, and test substantial features across the stack. Choose technical approaches that balance delivery speed, reliability, and maintainability.

- Work with PMs and designers to scope projects, estimate effort, surface complexity and tradeoffs early, and keep everyone in the loop as things change.

- Make the team around you faster and better through documentation, tooling, code review, and mentorship.

- Own what you ship in production: monitor releases and debug what breaks.


### **What you’ll bring**

- **Experience building complex web applications** with demonstrated ownership across the stack. You write correct, maintainable, secure code and choose solutions that fit the problem.

- **Deep expertise with a modern web framework, ideally Ruby on Rails or React.** Our stack also includes TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Google Cloud.

- **Independence.** You thrive with autonomy. You break big, ambiguous problems into shippable pieces, unblock yourself, and adapt to whatever a project needs.

- **Product sense.** You care about why you’re building something, not just how. You ask questions that clarify the user’s problem and use that understanding to make sensible tradeoffs.

- **Strong written communication.** You write concise, constructive technical briefs, code reviews, and project updates.

- **Curiosity.** You enjoy digging into unfamiliar domains and figuring out problems without an obvious playbook. You seek feedback and use what you learn to become a better engineer.

- **Effective use of AI.** You use AI heavily to accelerate your work while remaining accountable for every line you ship. You review, test, and refine AI output with the judgment of an experienced engineer building a product we’ll maintain for years.


### **What's cool about the role**

- **Competitive pay and equity.** Base salary for this role: $100,000 - $200,000.

- **Fully remote.** Work from anywhere in the Americas.

- **Great culture.** Read more about how we work in our [public handbook](https://handbook.tremendous.com/).

jobs.title: Information Security Manager
jobs.description:
**About us:**

BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.

We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.

Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.

Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.

By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.

We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.

**We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:**

- CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)
- FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)
- Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)
- LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)

**Location**: We offer a Hybrid/Remote working policy.

**FUNCTION**: Engineering

We are seeking an experienced **Information Security Manager** to join our Security team.

The Information Security Manager at BVNK is instrumental in establishing and maintaining a robust framework for managing operational risks related to information security with a strong emphasis on compliance with Brazilian financial regulations. The primary focus will be the establishment and implementation of the necessary changes to the global frameworks, documentation and workflows to ensure compliance with local regulations. This involves identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks across business processes, technology platforms, third-party engagements, and regulatory compliance requirements. The Manager will collaborate across the organization, ensuring operational resilience and alignment with the overall risk appetite and security strategy.

**Key Areas of Responsibilities:**

**Brazil License & Regulatory Compliance**

- Oversee the modification and implementation of changes to the global information security operational risk and ICT control framework required to support the application for and maintenance of the **Brazilian VASP financial license under BCB Resolution 520/25.**
- Coordinate with local legal representatives, external counsel, and regulatory authorities (including the Central Bank of Brazil) to ensure information security policies and operational resilience mechanisms remain fully compliant with Brazilian regulatory standards.
- Oversee the creation of the necessary technical controls, their implementation and continuous operation, including reporting and monitoring.

**Risk Identification and Assessment**

- Update and manage the information security operational risk register, ensuring accurate classification, measurement, and reporting of identified risks.
- Conduct regular operational ICT risk assessments across critical business processes, IT systems, and applications to identify control weaknesses and potential impact scenarios.
- Collaborate with business process owners to integrate ICT risk controls and ensure adherence to the 'three lines of defense' model.
- Integrate and monitor internal fraud controls specifically related to IT systems, processes, and privileged access, establishing necessary detection and prevention mechanisms.

**Audits and Compliance Management**

- Support internal and external audit processes, including collecting evidence, managing audit requests, and ensuring continuous compliance with regulatory standards.

**Risk Mitigation and Control Management**

- Design, implement, and monitor key risk indicators (KRIs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) for IT security controls and processes.
- Facilitate the control self-assessment process, verifying the existence and effectiveness of security controls across the organization.

**Investigations, Policies, and Training**

- Investigate and create comprehensive reports regarding fraud cases, security incidents, and privacy violations, ensuring timely follow-up on remediation measures.
- Conduct operational risk reviews of client processes and tools, presenting recommendations on identified security gaps and creating initiatives for fraud prevention.
- Develop new documents for Security Related Policies and update current policies.
- Create new documents for other departments related to Security or information security topics.

**What we need from you:**

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
- Demonstrated experience in operational risk management, IT risk, IT audit, or information security governance roles.
- Professional certifications such as CRISC, CISSP, CISM, or similar are highly desirable.
- Experience with SOC 1 and Vanta will be considered a strong plus.
- **Experience and deep knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory standards related to information security in the financial sector.**
- Demonstrated ability to develop, implement, and maintain an operational risk framework, ideally within an information security context.
- **Strong understanding of security controls, governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) principles.**
- Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on translating technical risks into business context.
- Excellent collaboration and communication skills, capable of influencing stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams.
- Proficiency in utilising GRC tools and platforms for risk and control management.

**What you can expect from us:**

- Fair and **competitive salary** at every stage of your growth
- **Flexible** working hours, with hybrid working at its heart
- A **culture** built on passionate, growth-minded people
- A **flexible** approach to holiday
- Opportunities to travel to our **offices around the world**
- An **open and creative environment** where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets

_At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we’d encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team._

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights. Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and [many more](https://www.riskified.com/customers/).

We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day.

### **About the Role**

At Riskified, we succeed when our merchants succeed. As a Presales Solutions Architect for Latin America, you'll be the technical lead in our sales process, partnering with Account Executives and Account Managers to win new merchants and expand existing ones. Before a contract is signed, you'll scope how Riskified fits into each prospect's checkout, payments, and order-management stack, and you'll project-manage the technical side of the deal, keeping the prospect's teams and ours aligned through discovery, evaluation, proofs of concept, and pilots. You'll also lead product positioning, demos, ROI analyses, and RFP responses for the region. Because the integration plan is built and agreed during the sale, merchants know exactly what to expect, and our Implementation team starts every project from a solid plan.

### **What you'll be doing**

**Integration scoping and deal project management**

- Lead technical discovery with prospects to map their checkout, payments, order-management, and fulfillment flows, and scope how Riskified's products fit into them before contract signature.
- Build integration plans as part of the sales process, covering solution design, data and API requirements, effort estimates, timelines, and owners, so scope and expectations are agreed before the deal closes.
- Act as the project manager for the technical side of each opportunity, both internally and with the prospect: run technical workstreams and evaluation plans, track milestones and dependencies, and keep stakeholders aligned through to signature.
- Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Security during the sales cycle to answer technical requirements, close gaps, and remove blockers to a technical win.
- Design and run proofs of concept and pilots, including success criteria, data validation, and results readouts.

jobs.title: Incident Manager II
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Braze is at an inflection point in our maturity, where a key focus of our work is on Scalability, Observability, and Reusability. Reporting to our Head of Incident Management, you’ll focus on major incident management, process management, program management, and release management. The Technology Operations Team is focused on ensuring that Braze is operating as a technology-first business, with process, policy, and support in place to manage growth and scale. You’ll ensure programs and processes that span or are required by multiple engineering departments are standardized, followed, and improved over time.

Main responsibilities:

- Creating, communicating, and executing the incident response strategy and actions for low-level incidents and release regressions (spanning Security, IT, DevOps, and Product Engineering)
- Incident commanding: driving incident resolution by partnering closely with Engineering, Technical Support, and Customer Success.
- Lead and contribute to projects to improve tools and processes related to manageability, observability, and resiliency
- Overseeing the incident management process and team members involved in resolving the incident
- Prioritizing incidents according to their urgency and influence on the business
- Contribute to our blameless post-mortem process, driving prioritization of action items related to site reliability and resiliency
- Understand and translate technical information and issues into business cases, impacts, and risks that can easily be interpreted by the customer
- Leads the daily release process as part of a release management team
- Escalate and manage release-related issues through to resolution

**WHO YOU ARE**

- Experience in incident management, operations, or technical support experience
- Able to effectively communicate critical issue status (both verbally and in writing) to executive staff, go-to-market teams, and other involved parties
- Are able to effectively build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across the business
- Ability to lead, make decisions, problem-solve, and work within teams. Can demonstrate flexibility and agility to move between role types within teams
- Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment
- Experience leading technical incidents and driving them to resolution, whether as part of an on-call team or as an incident manager
- A strong technical background and experience with specific tools for reporting, documentation, and observability (Jira, Confluence, Datadog, or the equivalent)
- A good foundational understanding of release management concepts, DevOps, and SRE
- You have a high degree of operational excellence, use data-driven decision-making to minimize risk, and love building and managing against reports and data

## Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

**_Disclaimer:_** We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication.

#### **A day in the life:**

As a Creator Strategist, you’ll be at the center of our UGC services and internal creator operations. Your day will involve managing creator campaigns from start to finish—briefing, communication, and deadline management—while also supporting the growth of our internal creator database. You’ll collaborate closely with clients, social strategists, and creators to bring content concepts to life, keeping everything on track and running smoothly.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- **Enhance and optimize business operations through the deployment of AI technologies**
- **Utilize and leverage Power Digital’s nova ecosystem to benefit your department’s objectives**
- **Creator & Strategist Communication:** Lead communication with creators throughout UGC campaigns, keeping them informed, engaged, and on track from onboarding through content delivery. Proactive communication and tracking with your lead strategists for alignment.
- **Client Communication & Collaboration:** Serve as a client-facing partner for UGC campaigns, actively participating in client calls and communications to align on creative direction, campaign needs, feedback, and deliverables while ensuring clear communication and a strong client experience.
- **Campaign Workflow Ownership:** Own the campaign workflow by building and maintaining creative briefs in partnership with social strategists and clients, ensuring the vision is clear and actionable.
- **Deliverables Oversight:** Oversee all deliverables for UGC services, ensuring deadlines are met and content aligns with client expectations and free of errors
- **Creator List Building & Management:** Own recruitment and management of internal creator lists, including sourcing, outreach, onboarding, and relationship management across a diverse roster of talent and industries
- **Creator Vetting and Casting:** Cast creators that are an ideal fit for campaigns by thoughtfully matching talent to brand needs and campaign goals; ensuring you are QAing for language, brief alignment, and skillset.
- **Creator Enablement:** Ensure internal creators have the guidance, tools, and resources needed to produce high-quality content
- **Process Improvement:** Proactively identify opportunities to improve how we work with creators, including refining processes and testing new content formats, campaign structures, or workflows
- Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
- Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
- Ensure daily use of our proprietary technology (Iris and nova), Pulse (client performance and sentiment tool) cadence at 100%

#### **Role Requirements:**

- 1+ years experience managing creator or influencer campaigns end-to-end, from onboarding through final content delivery; agency experience preferred
- **Creative Brief Development:** Proven ability to build, edit, and manage creative briefs that clearly communicate objectives, deliverables, and expectations.
- **UGC Strategy:** Working knowledge of UGC and its role within broader digital and social marketing strategies.
- **Project Management:** Ability to autonomously manage multiple campaigns, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, without errors
- **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Confident working cross-functionally with creators, clients, and internal teams to drive successful campaign execution.
- **Process Innovation:** Ability to identify, test, and implement process improvements that enhance how UGC is delivered and scaled.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

- Personal RPE: $15K
- Submission of on-time creator briefs: 100%

  - 90%+ of creator deliverables submitted on time per campaign; not accounting for client delays outside of your control

- Sufficient QA process ownership that results in no errors that yield a negative impact to revenue or retention of all clients within your book
- Upkeep of Campaign Trackers (Asana and Sheet): 100% completion of weekly updating

**Most Important Things (MITs)**

- Reliable and clear communication with creators and internal teams.
- Ability to manage multiple deadlines without dropping the ball.
- Understanding of what makes compelling, on-brand UGC.

_Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility._

These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at [https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/](https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/)_ _[.](https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/) If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at_ [_recruiting@powerdigital.com_](mailto:recruiting@powerdigital.com) _before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence._

jobs.title: RevOps Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Paired**

Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that specializes in pairing remote work with top-tier talent!

We are dedicated to connecting talented individuals with remarkable companies in need of their skills. Our goal is to create fulfilling job opportunities for professionals around the world.

**The client**

Advertising and consultancy services company working with RevOps infrastructure for B2B teams. They build the systems that make growth work.

The founder has reached the point most agency founders reach eventually. Their days are full of client emails, chasing the team, managing delivery risk and keeping projects from slipping. None of it is optional and all of it is in their head. The problem is not only the hours it eats. It is that managing risk and creating growth are opposite modes of thinking, and they cannot do both well in the same week.

They're hiring the person who takes operations off them.

**Why this role is part-time, and what it becomes**

Right now there genuinely is not forty hours a week of work here. We are coming out of a contraction and back into expansion, and they would rather hire someone part-time and pay them properly than hire full-time and have them sitting idle, which is unfair to both of us.

The plan is that this grows. Part-time now, full-time as the client base expands, then Head of Operations. They're not dangling that vaguely: they'll will set out the milestones, what hitting them does to your compensation, and roughly when they expect each step. You should hold them to it.

What they're asking for in return is commitment. If you take this and a full-time offer appears a month later and you disappear, it damages us. If you are doing one other part-time role alongside this, that is fine and I understand it. What I do not want is someone juggling five clients who gives this one the leftovers. I have seen fractional done badly and I would rather pay for focus.

**What you will own**

**Client and stakeholder management**

- Be the operational point of contact for our clients, so that I am not
- Keep every client informed, handle the back and forth, and escalate to me only what genuinely needs me
- We currently run around four clients at once, a mix of large and small projects. Six is the most we have ever carried. As we scale, the model is roughly one project manager per five clients

**Project delivery**

- Own timelines, scope and deliverables across those accounts
- Know the status of everything without being asked, and chase it when it slips
- Spot delivery risk early and bring me a proposed fix rather than a problem

**Team coordination**

- Keep the team pointed at the right work and hold them to what they committed to
- Run the follow-up so that nothing dies in a thread

**Revenue operations**

- Keep our pipeline, CRM and reporting accurate and current
- Build and tidy the systems and automations that hold delivery together
- Turn what is currently in my head into documented, repeatable process

jobs.title: Business Insights and Analytics Partner
jobs.description:
Job Description

**Role Summary**

**The Senior Specialist, Business Insights & Analytics Partner (BIA)** is part of the Digital Human Health organization and acts as a strategic business partner for Brazil, helping translate priority business opportunities into the right questions, evidence, insights and actions. Working cross-functionally with commercial, marketing, therapeutic area, technology and broader international teams, the role connects brand and customer strategy with data, analytics, AI and digital capabilities to improve decision-making, accelerate insight generation and drive measurable business impact.

Acting as a data and business translator, the BIA Partner combines therapeutic area understanding, analytical judgment and stakeholder partnership to shape better business questions, synthesize internal and external evidence, and convert insights into practical recommendations for the business. The role also contributes to a stronger data-driven culture and to the international BIA community.

**Role boundary: Accountable for business framing, insight generation, recommendations, adoption and value tracking. The role does not own technical platform execution, data engineering or formal data stewardship, but partners with the accountable expert teams on data availability, quality and governance.**

**Primary Responsibilities**

**1. Business Partnership and Commercial Insights**

·       Partner with commercial, marketing and sales stakeholders to frame priority business questions, expected outcomes and analytical requirements.

·       Translate business opportunities into key business questions that can be addressed through data, AI, digital and technology-enabled solutions.

·       Analyze performance to identify trends, opportunities and risks across brands, customers, campaigns and channels.

·       Deliver fact-based recommendations supporting brand and customer strategy, forecasting, launch readiness and omnichannel effectiveness.

·       Translate complex analysis into concise narratives and recommendations for senior and non-technical stakeholders.

**2. Performance Measurement and Decision Support**

·       Contribute to dashboards, scorecards and standard reports covering brand performance, customer engagement and omnichannel outcomes.

·       Help define consistent, accurate and decision-relevant KPIs across therapeutic areas and functions.

·       Monitor performance, surface exceptions and opportunities, and connect insights to actions and decision forums.

·       Improve the repeatability and efficiency of recurring reporting and insight generation with technology and analytics teams.

**3. Advanced Analytics and Synthesis**

·       Use and interpret outputs such as segmentation, forecasting, scenario analysis, predictive models and resource or spend optimization.

·       Integrate evidence from data science, market research and forecasting into a coherent business perspective.

·       Identify relevant internal and external data sources and assess fitness for the business question.

·       Apply analytical judgment and data storytelling to convert outputs into recommendations, trade-offs and next actions.

**4. Cross-functional Collaboration and Enablement**

·       Act as the translation point between business stakeholders and expert teams, providing a clear brief, requirements and business context.

·       Collaborate with Data Enablement, Data Strategy, Data Science, Market Research, Forecasting, Omnichannel and Business Technology Partners.

·       Flag data gaps or quality issues to accountable owners and stewards, supporting compliant data use.

·       Share methods and reusable assets through the international BIA community; support data literacy and mentor junior colleagues where applicable.

**5. Adoption, Value and Continuous Improvement**

·       Drive integration of insights into business routines and decision forums, tracking usage and impact where appropriate.

·       Explore approved uses of AI, machine learning, GenAI and agent-based solutions to accelerate high-quality insight generation in a fast and scalable manner.

·       Continuously improve analytical methods, documentation and reusable insight assets.

**Qualifications and Experience**

·       Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science or a related discipline; a master's degree or other relevant advanced degree is preferred.

·       Experience in business analytics, commercial analytics, market insights, data analysis, strategy consulting or a related field. Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare or another complex, regulated industry is beneficial but not required.

·       Life sciences, healthcare, pharmaceutical or therapeutic area background combined with strong analytical capability is highly valued.

·       Experience supporting commercial, marketing or sales decisions in a complex environment.

·       Strong analytical and visualization skills using Excel, Power BI; Python or R knowledge is beneficial.

·       AI literacy and practical experience, or strong ability to build or configure AI-supported agents and workflows that accelerate insight generation, synthesis and business recommendations.

·       Ability to structure ambiguous questions, interpret complex data and translate findings into practical recommendations.

·       Strong problem-solving, structured thinking, communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to translate ambiguity and complex analysis into clear recommendations that influence decisions and drive alignment across senior business and technical stakeholders.

·       Ability to collaborate and influence across business and technical teams without formal authority; curiosity and learning agility.

·       Fluency in the local language and professional English for international collaboration. Spanish fluency is a plus.

**Measures of Success**

·       Business decisions are demonstrably informed by relevant evidence, insights and recommendations.

·       Analyses, dashboards and insight products are timely, high quality and used in decision forums.

·       Stakeholders recognize the clarity, relevance and actionability of recommendations.

·       Recurring reporting and insight generation become more repeatable, efficient and reusable.

·       Insights are adopted into business routines, with usage and impact tracked where appropriate.

·       Effective collaboration is established across business stakeholders, BTPs and enterprise analytics teams.

·       Data quality, documentation, compliance and governance requirements are respected.

jobs.title: Business Insights and Analytics Partner
jobs.description:
Job Description

**Role Summary**

**The Senior Specialist, Business Insights & Analytics Partner (BIA)** is part of the Digital Human Health organization and acts as a strategic business partner for Brazil, helping translate priority business opportunities into the right questions, evidence, insights and actions. Working cross-functionally with commercial, marketing, therapeutic area, technology and broader international teams, the role connects brand and customer strategy with data, analytics, AI and digital capabilities to improve decision-making, accelerate insight generation and drive measurable business impact.

Acting as a data and business translator, the BIA Partner combines therapeutic area understanding, analytical judgment and stakeholder partnership to shape better business questions, synthesize internal and external evidence, and convert insights into practical recommendations for the business. The role also contributes to a stronger data-driven culture and to the international BIA community.

**Role boundary: Accountable for business framing, insight generation, recommendations, adoption and value tracking. The role does not own technical platform execution, data engineering or formal data stewardship, but partners with the accountable expert teams on data availability, quality and governance.**

**Primary Responsibilities**

**1. Business Partnership and Commercial Insights**

·       Partner with commercial, marketing and sales stakeholders to frame priority business questions, expected outcomes and analytical requirements.

·       Translate business opportunities into key business questions that can be addressed through data, AI, digital and technology-enabled solutions.

·       Analyze performance to identify trends, opportunities and risks across brands, customers, campaigns and channels.

·       Deliver fact-based recommendations supporting brand and customer strategy, forecasting, launch readiness and omnichannel effectiveness.

·       Translate complex analysis into concise narratives and recommendations for senior and non-technical stakeholders.

**2. Performance Measurement and Decision Support**

·       Contribute to dashboards, scorecards and standard reports covering brand performance, customer engagement and omnichannel outcomes.

·       Help define consistent, accurate and decision-relevant KPIs across therapeutic areas and functions.

·       Monitor performance, surface exceptions and opportunities, and connect insights to actions and decision forums.

·       Improve the repeatability and efficiency of recurring reporting and insight generation with technology and analytics teams.

**3. Advanced Analytics and Synthesis**

·       Use and interpret outputs such as segmentation, forecasting, scenario analysis, predictive models and resource or spend optimization.

·       Integrate evidence from data science, market research and forecasting into a coherent business perspective.

·       Identify relevant internal and external data sources and assess fitness for the business question.

·       Apply analytical judgment and data storytelling to convert outputs into recommendations, trade-offs and next actions.

**4. Cross-functional Collaboration and Enablement**

·       Act as the translation point between business stakeholders and expert teams, providing a clear brief, requirements and business context.

·       Collaborate with Data Enablement, Data Strategy, Data Science, Market Research, Forecasting, Omnichannel and Business Technology Partners.

·       Flag data gaps or quality issues to accountable owners and stewards, supporting compliant data use.

·       Share methods and reusable assets through the international BIA community; support data literacy and mentor junior colleagues where applicable.

**5. Adoption, Value and Continuous Improvement**

·       Drive integration of insights into business routines and decision forums, tracking usage and impact where appropriate.

·       Explore approved uses of AI, machine learning, GenAI and agent-based solutions to accelerate high-quality insight generation in a fast and scalable manner.

·       Continuously improve analytical methods, documentation and reusable insight assets.

**Qualifications and Experience**

·       Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science or a related discipline; a master's degree or other relevant advanced degree is preferred.

·       Experience in business analytics, commercial analytics, market insights, data analysis, strategy consulting or a related field. Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare or another complex, regulated industry is beneficial but not required.

·       Life sciences, healthcare, pharmaceutical or therapeutic area background combined with strong analytical capability is highly valued.

·       Experience supporting commercial, marketing or sales decisions in a complex environment.

·       Strong analytical and visualization skills using Excel, Power BI; Python or R knowledge is beneficial.

·       AI literacy and practical experience, or strong ability to build or configure AI-supported agents and workflows that accelerate insight generation, synthesis and business recommendations.

·       Ability to structure ambiguous questions, interpret complex data and translate findings into practical recommendations.

·       Strong problem-solving, structured thinking, communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to translate ambiguity and complex analysis into clear recommendations that influence decisions and drive alignment across senior business and technical stakeholders.

·       Ability to collaborate and influence across business and technical teams without formal authority; curiosity and learning agility.

·       Fluency in the local language and professional English for international collaboration. Spanish fluency is a plus.

**Measures of Success**

·       Business decisions are demonstrably informed by relevant evidence, insights and recommendations.

·       Analyses, dashboards and insight products are timely, high quality and used in decision forums.

·       Stakeholders recognize the clarity, relevance and actionability of recommendations.

·       Recurring reporting and insight generation become more repeatable, efficient and reusable.

·       Insights are adopted into business routines, with usage and impact tracked where appropriate.

·       Effective collaboration is established across business stakeholders, BTPs and enterprise analytics teams.

·       Data quality, documentation, compliance and governance requirements are respected.

**Key Working Relationships**

Commercial, Marketing and Sales leaders and teams; Market Engagement & Insights leadership; Business Technology Partners and DHH capability teams; Data Science, Data Enablement, Data Strategy and Data Stewardship; Market Research, Forecasting and Omnichannel teams; international and global BIA communities.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. jobs.title: Operations Analyst I - Disability Inclusion Opportunity
Engineering Manager, Growth
jobs.description:
### About Buffer

We create social media and brand-building software for small businesses, creators, and individuals. Our mission is to provide essential tools to help small businesses get off the ground and grow. Through exceptional customer service and uplifting content, we help our customers believe they can succeed and do good along the way.

Buffer is a fully distributed team, and we’ve always aimed to do things a little differently. Since the early days, we’ve focused on building one of the most unique and fulfilling workplaces by rethinking a lot of traditional practices. We also default to transparency, so you can read all about our metrics, and our successes and failures along the way on our [Transparency Dashboard](https://buffer.com/open).

We're united by Buffer's [values](https://buffer.com/about#values), and we hire and work from all over the world. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive work environment, and we are building a culture where underrepresented groups are welcome and can flourish. Please note that we do travel to work together in person once or twice per year, and those events are highly encouraged to build deeper connections among our small team.

As you get to know Buffer and consider joining the journey, you can learn more about Buffer on our [Journey](https://buffer.com/journey) page. Still curious to learn more about the experience on the Buffer team? Feel free to read more from [Kirsti](https://buffer.com/resources/first-30-days-buffer/) and [Sabreen](https://buffer.com/resources/joined-3-days-before-the-retreat/) as they share their first experiences with Buffer, as well as from [Hailley](https://buffer.com/resources/8-years-at-buffer/), who captured why she still calls Buffer home after 8+ years.

### About the role

You’ll lead engineering for Growth at Buffer across both product and marketing surfaces. The work spans acquisition, activation, and retention. You’ll connect how people discover Buffer and decide to sign up and whether they stay.

We’re looking for someone who wants to stay close to the details, from where a customer gets stuck in a flow to the technical decisions that shape how it works. You’ll help the team decide which problems to solve, what to try first, and how to tell if we made things better for customers.

You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Marketing and Data to shape technical direction, create space for engineers to do their best work, and build a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.

### What you'll do

- Support engineers through regular coaching, clear feedback, and meaningful career conversations.

- Shape priorities with Product, Design, and Marketing, bringing your own point of view and grounding decisions in customer needs & data.

- Stay close to technical decisions and product details. Help the team build clear, accessible, responsive experiences, and help judge when to keep refining and when to ship and learn.

- Help connect customer insights, product changes, and measurement so we understand whether our work is helping.

- We're also changing how we build with AI. You'll have room to help shape that, through your own experiments and by helping the team develop good judgment and systems to work with AI effectively.

- Contribute to the wider Engineering team through hiring, shared practices, and improvements to how we work.


### What we're looking for

- You've managed engineers and can talk concretely about helping people grow, giving feedback, and addressing performance concerns.

- You care about how software feels to use. You notice unnecessary steps, unclear interactions, and details that get in someone's way. You could walk through something you helped build and explain the choices, compromises, and things you left out.

- You have a strong engineering background and remain comfortable getting into technical details. That might mean reviewing code, exploring an architecture, building a prototype, or helping someone work through a difficult trade-off.

- You’re ambitious about what you can build with AI. You use it in your own engineering work to take on bigger problems, and you know how to steer it, check its work, and make the calls that need your judgment. You help the engineers you lead do the same.

- You communicate clearly in writing, take ownership, and work well with people across different disciplines and time zones.

- You understand how a product helps a business grow, from how customers find it to why they pay for it and keep using it. You might have learned that through growth work and experimentation, or by growing a product as a founder or on an early-stage team. You use that understanding to decide what’s worth building and help engineers build it well.

- You have a personal connection to making and sharing things. Maybe you've written a newsletter, shared your work online, built a side project, or run a small business. You understand something of the effort it takes to put your work out there and find an audience. You don't need a big following; we're interested in that connection and what it's taught you.


### Our hiring process

- Please express your interest below by sharing your LinkedIn profile and resume, and a short note about what interests you in the role and why you think it could be a good match. ( _If you choose to use AI while writing your message, please limit usage to light edits or research. We'd love to hear your own voice come through_.)

- If we'd like to explore the fit further, we'll reach out to learn more about you.

- Our interview process includes a conversation with a member of our hiring team ( [Sara](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sara-almeida-b1a78012b/) or [Caro](https://www.linkedin.com/in/carolynkopprasch/)), meeting the hiring manager for this role ( [Kateryna](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kporshnieva/)), getting to know some teammates and peers (varies based on schedules), and meeting our CEO, [Joel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joelgascoigne/).

- Our final stage is a two-day-long paid collaboration period. This is designed to mimic a real work project, so that we can each see what it's like to work together.


### **Privacy Policy**

_By submitting the application, you consent to Buffer collecting and processing your personal data for recruiting purposes. Find more details in our_ [_Privacy Policy_](https://buffer.notion.site/Privacy-Policy-for-Applicants-230a7f5a00fd80e48478f09171d18a24?pvs=143) _._

jobs.title: Revenue Systems & Operations
jobs.description:
**Revenue Systems & Operations**

**About Duda**

Duda is a leading website platform for professionals, helping agencies, SaaS companies, and web teams build and manage high-quality websites at scale. Our flexible platform combines powerful design, collaboration, automation, and AI capabilities to help customers work faster and grow smarter. With teams across the US, Israel, Canada, Brazil, and the UK, we are building a collaborative, forward-thinking company focused on innovation, growth, and impact.

At our core, we embrace a collaborative and innovative culture that empowers teamwork, creativity, and ongoing learning. In Colorado, we provide a flexible hybrid work environment and are proud to have received multiple “Best Places to Work” awards.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for someone with solid experience in software, technology, and revenue operations who wants to own how GTM systems, data, AI, and business processes work together.

This is a Revenue Operations generalist role with a strong systems orientation. You’ll own work across Salesforce and our broader GTM technology stack, improve workflows, build with AI, troubleshoot systems, analyze revenue data, and help Sales and other GTM teams work more effectively.

You’ll also play a hands-on role across broader Revenue Operations work, including revenue planning, quota and target setting, performance analysis, forecasting, churn analysis, data modeling, enablement, and leadership reporting.

You don’t need to know every system we use. We care much more about how you think, how quickly you learn, and whether you spot problems and opportunities before someone has to point them out. We expect you to take a problem from investigation to recommendation to fix with minimal direction.

**What you’ll work on**

**Systems, workflows, and automation**

- Own and improve workflows across Salesforce and our broader GTM systems
- Identify inefficient, manual, or fragile processes and design better ways of working
- Troubleshoot system, workflow, integration, and data issues to find root causes and resolve them
- Build and maintain AI agents and automation that support Sales and other GTM teams
- Evaluate new software, functionality, and processes, and make recommendations on what to adopt
- Understand how our GTM systems connect and proactively flag risks, gaps, and downstream impacts

**Revenue operations, planning, and analysis**

- Drive analysis for quota setting, revenue targets, forecasting, and capacity planning
- Build and maintain data models used for revenue planning and decision-making
- Analyze pipeline, conversion, performance, churn risk, and other revenue trends
- Investigate changes in performance, identify the underlying drivers, and recommend what to do about them
- Contribute to leadership and board reporting, as well as broader revenue planning and operational analysis

**Enablement and GTM partnership**

- Partner with Sales, Marketing, Account Management, Customer Success, and Finance on revenue operations projects
- Lead the rollout and adoption of new tools, workflows, processes, and AI capabilities
- Translate operational changes into clear, usable processes and resources for GTM teams

**Minimum qualifications**

- 4+ years of experience in a professional business environment, including time in revenue operations, sales operations, business operations, analytics, or another quantitative business function
- Hands-on Salesforce experience, including reporting, workflows, Flow, or CRM configuration
- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including complex formulas, lookups, conditional logic, pivot tables, and working with larger datasets
- Strong quantitative skills and comfort working with percentages, growth rates, conversion rates, targets, averages, and financial or operational metrics
- A track record of using data to analyze a problem, identify trends, and drive a recommendation or decision
- Demonstrated experience using AI tools to solve business problems, improve workflows, analyze information, or reduce manual work
- Experience building, owning, or improving a structured process, workflow, model, or analysis
- Ability to independently investigate an issue, validate your findings, and clearly explain what you found and what should happen next
- Strong written and verbal communication skills

**What will make you successful here**

- You’re naturally curious and like understanding how systems, data, and processes work together
- You’re a proactive problem solver who catches issues and inefficiencies before they become bigger problems
- You’re comfortable with ambiguity and can break an unfamiliar problem into something you can work through
- You learn new tools quickly, do the initial digging yourself, and ask good questions when you need help
- You can move between technical, analytical, and operational work while keeping the broader business goal in mind

**Nice to have, not required**

- Experience with GTM platforms such as Apollo, Gong, HubSpot, or similar software
- Familiarity with quota setting, revenue targets, pipeline analysis, forecasting, churn, capacity planning, performance reporting, or financial modeling
- Experience using AI tools to build workflows, agents, automations, or repeatable processes
- SQL, Python, JavaScript, APIs, integrations, or other technical experience that helps you understand how systems and data connect

**Growth in the role**

You’ll come in owning work across GTM systems, AI workflows, automation, revenue analysis, forecasting, quota and target setting, data modeling, and cross-functional planning. Over time, you’ll take on broader ownership across Revenue Operations and help shape how the function operates.

**Location & Work Model**

Candidates must reside in Florianópolis to align with our team collaboration needs and occasional in-person meetings.

**Application Instructions**

Please submit an English version of your resume when applying. Interviews will be conducted in English to align with our global communication standards.

**Why Duda?**

At Duda, we value creativity, innovation, and collaboration. You’ll have the opportunity to work with a dynamic, talented team, contributing directly to the success of our global support organization. We believe in empowering our people to achieve their best work and create exceptional customer experiences.

Duda is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage diversity in the workplace regardless of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other personal characteristic. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our careers site or to complete the application process, please contact accommodations@duda.co.

Want to learn more about Duda? Check us out [here!](https://www.duda.co/about)
