jobs.title: Senior Developer Relations, Twitter Brand Rep
jobs.description:
### **About Supabase**

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers: Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search, all deeply integrated.

### **About the Role**

Developers decide what to build with by listening to people they trust, much of it on Twitter, where Supabase's community, launches, and competitors are all discussed in public. We want a senior DevRel leader who is already a known, trusted voice there, to be a brand ambassador for Supabase. You'll work alongside our New Media and DevRel teams and help shape how Supabase shows up in these conversations. We hire for the voice and following you already have.

### **What you'll do**

- Be a visible, trusted voice for Supabase on Twitter: post, reply, and join developer conversations daily.

- Share sharp, useful content, from launches and tips to opinions on where building is going.

- Represent Supabase at events, on podcasts, and in the wider developer community.

- Bring developer feedback to engineering and product, and work with New Media, DevRel, and PMM on launches.


### **You Might Be A Good Fit If**

- You have an existing, engaged Twitter following. We'll look at who you talk to and how people respond, as well as follower count.

- You have senior experience in DevRel, developer advocacy, or a similar developer-facing role.

- You're credible with a technical audience and a strong writer with a distinctive voice.

- You're comfortable representing a company publicly, on camera, on stage, and online.

- High agency and self-directed.


#### **What We Offer**

- **Fully Remote**

  We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- **ESOP**

  Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- **Tech Allowance**

  Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- **Health Benefits**

  Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- **Annual Off-Sites**

  Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- **Flexible Work**

  We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- **Professional Development**

  Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.


#### **About the Team**

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members


We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: Law Enforcement Engagement Lead - LATAM
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

**The Community You Will Join:**

The Global Safety & Risk Management (GSRM) organization protects Airbnb's global community through proactive risk management, investigations, and real-time response to critical safety incidents. GSRM's 24/7 operations span Global Threat and Law Enforcement Operations, Global Investigations (GI), and Insider Threat Investigations (ITI).

**The Difference You Will Make:**

The Law Enforcement Engagement Regional Lead for Latin America (LATAM), covering Mexico, Central America, the Caribbean, and South America, is responsible for driving strategic bilateral and multilateral communication, cooperation, and collaboration efforts with law enforcement entities and domestic security services located and/or operating in LATAM to protect Airbnb equities and stakeholders from criminal and serious safety-related threats  in close coordination with other Airbnb GSRM teams.

**A Typical Day:**

- Lead, develop, and manage Airbnb efforts to cultivate trusted and reliable relationships with law enforcement partners in the LATAM region to safeguard the Airbnb platform and community.
- Lead and promote effective information exchange and collaboration with regional law enforcement on criminal threat and life safety matters that endanger the Airbnb community.
- Lead, develop, and maintain effective working relationships with law enforcement and government authorities in LATAM by building partnerships and coalitions through liaison with international law enforcement organizations (e.g., UNODC, INTERPOL, AMERIPOL, OAS, the Alliance for Security, Justice and Development, IACP, etc.)
- Lead regional and contribute to global efforts to develop programs, events, and presentations to educate key external bilateral and multilateral partner agencies and entities to promote Airbnb’s trust and safety capabilities and priorities.
- Provide expertise and conduct cross-functional collaboration with internal teams and fellow Airbnb stakeholders on law enforcement engagement matters in LATAM.
- Lead and/or contribute to law enforcement communication and correspondence during crisis response and/or high-risk law enforcement operations in LATAM.
- Identify market segments and external partnership opportunities to improve Airbnb law enforcement liaison, communication, and liaison in LATAM.
- Investigate and overcome barriers to successful, collaborative law enforcement operations and data exchange in LATAM.
- Collaborate with Airbnb legal, community support, and public policy teams to achieve effective engagement with law enforcement authorities, regulators, and legislators on online safety, security, and law enforcement issues in LATAM.
- Develop, analyze, and communicate data, metrics, and performance measures to inform and evaluate the effectiveness of law enforcement engagement in LATAM.
- Manage logistics of projects from start to finish, including identifying and scoping opportunities, aligning with different teams and functions, advancing contractual agreements, coordinating rollouts, and managing budgets.

**Your Expertise:**

- 10+ years of experience as a law enforcement or domestic security service officer with demonstrated expertise in investigating and preventing serious and organized crime, acts of violence, and threats to public safety.
- Law enforcement expertise and experience in conducting complex investigations involving criminal acts and/or national security matters.
- Experience working collaboratively with law enforcement managing/addressing law enforcement requests for information, production/judicial orders, emergency disclosure requests, Mutual Legal Assistant Treaty (MLAT) requests, and emergencies-in-progress from a range of varied and legal systems common to LATAM.
- Professional working knowledge of legal frameworks associated with individual data privacy rights, including the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
- Law enforcement awareness training, expertise, and experience in crisis planning and management and critical incident response.
- Ability to work effectively in a global environment, including an understanding of cultural differences.
- Demonstrated maintenance of a highly developed network of resources, cultivated through building relationships with global law enforcement and security services, ensuring liaison effectiveness in varied regions with complex geopolitical, cultural, and business environments.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, including an ability to deliver clear and concise executive presentations.
- Excellent organizational and analytical skills, and a demonstrated record of cross-functional collaboration.
- Willingness to travel routinely throughout LATAM, and periodically to other regions.
- Fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish languages is required.

**Your Location:**

Due to the nature of this position, the successful applicant will need to be based in Brazil to be able to conduct their work.

**Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:**

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

**How We'll Take Care of You:**

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is monthly, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Brazil Monthly Pay Range

R$30.666,67—R$38.333,33 BRL

**Reasonable Accommodations:** We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

**A Note on Recruiting Scams:** Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ [airbnb.com](http://airbnb.com) or @ [ext.airbnb.com](http://ext.airbnb.com) email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

jobs.title: CPG Marketing Account Director
jobs.description:
## Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

*****Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.**

**A day in the life:**

You'll own a portfolio of 4-6 CPG accounts, primarily beauty, personal care, wellness, or food and beverage brands. This role centers on a comprehensive diagnosis of core business constraints impacting client growth, leveraging a deep understanding of the competitive landscape to identify and formulate strategic solutions. This includes pinpointing challenges across all points of sale - DTC/ecommerce acquisition, retail execution, Amazon market share erosion, or upstream strategic barriers like brand positioning - and developing a unified, data-backed strategy to overcome them.

CPG accounts tend to have opinions about their channels that predate the data. Part of this job is having the product, competitive, and retail fluency to challenge those assumptions with credibility.

**Responsibilities:**

- Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
- Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
- Run quarterly Power Circuit reviews — diagnose growth constraints across Business, Audience, Product, Messaging, Channels, and Measurement, with particular attention to how the client's retail and DTC performance interact
- Own the senior client relationship
- QBRs should drive decisions, not report history
- Consult on channel mix across DTC, Amazon, and retail — understand how they cannibalize or reinforce each other and make a recommendation
- Coordinate paid, SEO, content, influencer, and creative teams around a single account strategy
- Manage retention and expansion; lead renewals; grow MRR in your portfolio
- Build multi-threaded relationships with multiple layers of client contacts so no single point of contact departure puts an account at risk
- Ensure daily use of our proprietary technology (Iris and nova), Pulse (client performance and sentiment tool) cadence at 100%, and Power Circuit (our proprietary diagnostic system) compliance across managed ADs
- Manage and develop 1–2 direct reports — run regular 1:1s, build development plans, and own their performance reviews
- Coach analysts and specialists; give specific, timely feedback

**Role Requirements:**

- 6+ years in CPG marketing, ideally with both DTC and retail brand experience
- Understands how Amazon fits into a CPG growth strategy — share of search, ASIN architecture, buy box, sponsored vs. organic balance
- Familiar with the retailer relationship layer: how Target, Ulta, Sephora, Whole Foods, or similar partners shape media investment decisions
- Has an opinion on CPG measurement — MMM, incrementality testing, in-store vs. digital attribution
- Fluent in upper-funnel channel strategy — content, SEO, YouTube, programmatic
- Comfortable with creative-heavy accounts where briefs, asset velocity, and influencer strategy are as important as media optimization
- Track record of retaining and growing accounts
- Has managed senior clients who have strong brand opinions and needs to be met with confidence

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

- Expansion to Churn Ratio (ETCR)
- Net MRR across portfolio
- Client NPS (8+ avg)
- Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
- Power Circuit Certification (annual)

**Most Important Things (MITs)**

- Team Coaching and Development
- Marketing Strategy, Development and Execution
- Client Retention and Client Revenue Growth

**Benefits & Perks:**

- Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities
- Unlimited Time Off available on day one
- Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
- Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs
- National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year
- Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
- Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
- Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
- Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

_Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility._

_Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at [https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/](https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/)_ _[.](https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/) If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at_ [_recruiting@powerdigital.com_](mailto:recruiting@powerdigital.com) _before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence._

You will sit on the Revenue Operations AI team and work directly with sellers, sales leaders, deal desk, forecasting, partner operations, and IT. You will build agents, reusable skills, and data connections across multiple vendor platforms, connecting internal systems (CRM, CPQ, data warehouse, knowledge bases, collaboration tools) with external data sources. You will be measured by working software in users' hands and the time it saves the revenue organization, not by slide decks.

**Your role**

Your core job is to take a revenue use case from a conversation to a working prototype within days, prove its value with real users and data, and then either harden it or retire it.

**Rapid prototyping of AI use cases**

- Work closely with our AI Product Manager to engage with our sales org, to scope use cases, define the success metric, and ship a working prototype within days.

**Agents and reusable skills across platforms**

- Design and build agents and reusable skills on multiple vendor platforms, choosing the right tool per use case.

- Package recurring workflows as reusable skills, prompts, and templates that sellers and other builders can run themselves.

**Data connectivity, internal and external**

- Connect agents to internal systems of record such as CRM, CPQ, billing and bookings, the data warehouse, product telemetry, support cases, and knowledge bases.

- Work with MCP servers, APIs, and connectors that provide agents governed, permission-aware access to revenue data.

- Integrate external sources such as intent and enrichment providers, firmographic data, earnings filings, and news, and reconcile them with internal account records.

**Required qualifications**

- **5** + years in software engineering, data engineering, solutions engineering, or a similar hands-on technical role, 2 years building LLM-powered applications or agents.

- Shipped at least **five** AI agents or LLM workflows used by real business users on real data, not demos only. Be ready to walk us through one end to end.

- Strong Python and SQL. Comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, JSON, and at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

- Hands-on experience with at least 3 agentic or skill-building platforms: Salesforce Agentforce, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Google Gemini Enterprise, Anthropic Claude (Skills, MCP, Claude Code), OpenAI (Agents SDK, custom GPTs), or open frameworks such as LangGraph.

- Experience connecting AI systems to enterprise data: CRM, data warehouses (Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery), document stores, and third-party APIs, including retrieval design (chunking, embeddings, vector search).

- Practical understanding of evaluation, prompt and context design, tool calling, and the security issues specific to agents, such as prompt injection and over-permissioned tools.

- Ability to translate a sales or operations problem into a scoped technical build, and to explain trade-offs to non-technical leaders in plain language.

- Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred qualifications**

- Experience in or alongside a Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Systems team at an enterprise software company.

- Working knowledge of Salesforce data models (opportunities, accounts, quotes, forecasts) and CPQ or quote-to-cash processes.

- Work with and operated an MCP server or comparable tool layer that gives agents governed access to a business system.

- Experience with integration and automation platforms such as Workato, MuleSoft, n8n, or Power Automate.

- Experience with conversation intelligence (Gong or similar), enrichment providers (ZoomInfo, 6sense, Clay), and enterprise search (Glean or similar)

- Built a lightweight front end (Streamlit, React, or Slack and Teams apps) so non-technical users can run agents without training.

- Familiarity with hybrid cloud and infrastructure concepts, which helps in understanding Nutanix products and customers.

This position is primarily **remote**. There is no specific in-office requirement, however, there may be circumstances where you may be required to come into a local office for a specific purpose, and/or to travel to other locations based on business needs.

**Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.**

**GET TO KNOW US**

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

**Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!**

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We are hiring a **Senior Business Operations Analyst** in our **Revenue Assurance** area in **Brazil**! This is a **Remote – Brazil** position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

This role is part of the **Revenue Assurance team** within GPS, responsible for protecting the accuracy and integrity of Wellhub's billing and revenue flows. As a Business Operations Analyst, you'll dig into incidents across Billing, Payments, Invoicing, Identity, Notification and Fraud, tracing them back to their root cause before they turn into real revenue loss. You'll work closely with Finance, IT, and Operations, and own the day-to-day operation of our RAID tool — running discrepancy analyses and supporting other teams with it. This is a great opportunity to join a growing team that sits at the core of how Wellhub safeguards its revenue, with real visibility into cross-functional decisions and a direct, measurable impact on the business.

**YOUR IMPACT**

- **Incident Analysis:** Conduct in-depth analysis over incidents addressed to Billing, Payments, Invoicing, Identity, Fraud & Client Master Data, identifying anomalies, providing clarifications, issue root-causes, and potential revenue estimation losses;
- Follow up and address potential changes to the root cause of identified issues. Track the implementation of recommendations to ensure the correctness of the revenue flow and that corrective actions are executed;
- **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Collaborate across Billing, Payments, Invoicing, Identity, and Fraud, and leverage relationships with Finance, IT, and Operations teams to address potential revenue assurance issues;
- **Documentation:** Ensure that services and billing processes are comprehensively documented. Ensure that processes, findings, analysis, and resolutions are documented for later tracking and potential pattern analysis;
- Ensure correct Billing Assurance through the lineage from issue analysis to the Billing service (recurrences, subscriptions, upsells, etc.);
- **RAID (Revenue Assurance) Tool Operations:** Operate and maintain the RAID (Revenue Assurance Integrity Driller) tool, including running discrepancy analyses and supporting other teams in its use;
- Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

**WHO YOU ARE**

- Experience in Product and Engineering agile environments, including microservices, also directly involved in IT Operations;
- Experience with SQL technology such as PostgreSQL or MySQL;
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, both in Portuguese and English;
- Software quality and test automation mindset;
- Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and pattern recognition;
- Ability to translate complex billing/revenue issues into clear, actionable findings for both technical and non-technical stakeholders;
- Comfortable using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini) to speed up data analysis, documentation, and day-to-day operations;
- Proactive and collaborative team player;
- Knowing the internal Wellhub business workflow is a plus.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in business operations and SQL are mandatory requirements.

**WHAT WE OFFER YOU**

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

**Our benefits include:**

**WELLHUB:** Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

**WELLZ:** A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

**HEALTHCARE:** Health, dental, and life insurance.

**FLEXIBLE WORK:** As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

**FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:** Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

**PAID TIME OFF:** It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

**PAID PARENTAL LEAVE:** Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

**CAREER GROWTH:** Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

**CULTURE:** You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. [Learn more about our shared culture and values here.](https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/our-values/)

**Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on** [**Instagram**](https://www.instagram.com/lifeatwellhub/) **@lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on** [**YouTube**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZgIPiszTVm4) **!**

**Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub**

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Inside most companies, Supabase starts the same way: someone has an idea, creates a project, and builds something useful. The next step is making that momentum company-wide: one platform where anyone can start building, and where IT can see what’s running, who owns it, and what it costs.

You’ll own how companies run Supabase as their internal development platform: approved by IT and easy for anyone in the company to use. You’ll make it possible for people and the agents they work with to start building without waiting on infrastructure, while giving platform, IT, and security teams the controls they need to say yes. The goal is to make the approved path the easiest path, from an early experiment to a production application, with the controls companies need built in.

#### What You’ll Be Responsible For

- Own the product strategy and roadmap for internal innovation, from a company’s first IT-approved rollout to adoption across teams and business units.

- Make getting started self-service, whether someone creates a project in Supabase, through an internal developer portal, or with an agent. Give builders the access and infrastructure they need without a ticket for every project.

- Steer scattered usage into a manageable company-wide platform. Give companies one view of everything they run on Supabase. Shape how ownership, delegated access, and boundaries work so teams can move independently as usage grows.

- Partner closely with platform, IT, security, and finance teams to understand what it takes to approve Supabase and keep it approved. Translate their needs into practical identity, policy, audit, and spend controls that don’t slow builders down.

- Define the path from experiment to production, including project ownership, access, and the guardrails that change as an application becomes important to the business.

- Work with Engineering, Design, Sales, and Customer Success to turn early customer rollouts into a repeatable experience, rather than a new custom integration for every company.

- Define what success looks like, instrument it end to end, and let the data guide what gets built next—from time to first project and self-service adoption to production usage and expansion across the company.


#### You Might Be a Good Fit If You

- Have 7+ years of product management on developer tools, infrastructure, or internal developer platforms.

- Have built self-service products that developers love and platform or IT teams trust. You understand both the person trying to ship an app and the team responsible for how it runs.

- Can reason about identity, permissions, organization boundaries, and usage attribution, and turn those systems into workflows people can actually understand.

- Have a strong point of view on how agents change who can build software inside a company and what an internal development platform needs to make that possible.

- Know your way around controlled experimentation and data analysis, and can connect easier adoption to sustained product use.

- Are biased toward speed and would rather ship, learn, and iterate than perfect a spec.

- Build with what you own and form opinions through first-hand use, from creating a project to configuring the policies around it.

- Use AI tools to compress research, drafting, and feedback synthesis so you can focus on judgment calls.

- Work async by default, making decisions in writing in a fully remote team.


#### **What We Offer**

- **Fully Remote**

  We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- **ESOP**

  Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- **Tech Allowance**

  Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- **Health Benefits**

  Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- **Annual Off-Sites**

  Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- **Flexible Work**

  We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- **Professional Development**

  Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.


#### **About the Team**

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members


We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

### **About Supabase**

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a **Software Engineer, AI Tooling Infrastructure** to join our **AI Tooling team** and help build and run the backend services behind Supabase’s AI products. The Supabase MCP server is one example of what the team runs in production, alongside the services that support agent skills and the dashboard assistant. You’ll work closely with the Platform, SRE, Auth, Billing and Edge Functions teams, and with the engineers on the AI Tooling team who build the product surfaces.

The AI Tooling team runs its own services in production and carries its own on-call. Traffic from AI clients and agents behaves differently from traffic from people: hundreds of calls a minute, retry loops, and no reading of deprecation warnings. This role makes sure the services they use are reliable, correctly authorized and observable. It is a systems and infrastructure role rather than a product AI role, and it is not an SRE role. You will build and operate these systems, not only advise on them.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments, owns what they ship in production, and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

### What You’ll Be Responsible For

In this role, you’ll:

- Build and operate the production backend services behind Supabase’s AI products, including the MCP server: deployment, scaling, configuration and release.

- Take ownership of how those services are structured, including splitting or reshaping a service when that makes it safer to run and easier to change.

- Define, measure and meet reliability targets for the services the team runs. Set SLOs with the SRE team, track error budgets, and use them to decide what to fix first.

- Participate in the AI Tooling team on-call rotation, and be a first responder for incidents in those services. Investigate, fix, coordinate with other teams during incidents, and write the follow-ups and runbooks.

- Work the AI Tooling team support queue alongside on-call, and turn recurring issues into fixes rather than repeated manual answers.

- Own authentication and authorization for AI and agent clients: OAuth apps, scoped tokens, and permissions that make sense for agents as well as humans, including how we change or deprecate a permission without breaking existing integrations.

- Own observability for the services the team runs: metrics, traces, logs, dashboards and alerts, so we find problems before customers do.

- Handle capacity and abuse for agent traffic: rate limits, cost and safety controls, and behavior under load or when a dependency degrades.

- Improve the architecture of the services the team owns as they grow, including splitting or reshaping a service when that makes it safer to run and easier to change.

- Work with the Platform team on shared code, review ownership and release process, and with the SRE team on infrastructure, alerting and incident practice.

- Contribute to the code of the AI Tooling team’s tools, such as the MCP server, where it affects reliability and security, in partnership with the engineers who own the product surface.

jobs.description:
## **About the Role:**

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

09

**About the Role**

The Corporates team in São Paulo delivers independent credit opinions on issuers across the region, combining rigorous financial analysis with market-relevant insights that investors and issuers rely on. The team values analytical excellence, continuous improvement, and the responsible integration of technology into the ratings process. As an Analyst, you will build your credit expertise and contribute to the team's analytical work under the guidance of senior colleagues, in one of the world's leading credit rating organizations.

**What You'll Do**

Impact

In this role, you will support the analytical foundation of S&P Global Ratings' credit opinions for assigned issuers — contributing to macroeconomic research, financial analysis, data quality, and rating committee preparation across one of the most dynamic markets in Latin America - Project Finance, Non-financial corporates national ratings.

Responsibilities

Team Contribution & Capability Building

- Build credit judgment through coaching and established analytical methodologies; share reusable tools, templates, and prompts that support team productivity and reduce rework; support junior colleague development through guidance on analytical routines and quality standards

Core Analytical & Delivery

- Conduct macroeconomic, sector, and company-specific research; prepare first analyses of quarterly results and financial statements; input issuer forecasts into projection models under the direction of senior analysts

- Perform fundamental credit analysis, financial forecasting, and industry analysis at the direction of senior analysts; collect, validate, and reconcile data with strong documentation discipline and early identification of anomalies

Stakeholder & Market Engagement

- Act as primary analyst for a portfolio of credits responsible for rating committee materials, research, and commentaries; translate data and analysis into clear, decision-ready narratives for internal and external audiences; attend rating committee and management meetings

Risk Management and Operating

- Apply governance, confidentiality, and documentation standards consistently; use approved generative AI and large language model (LLM) tools responsibly; support the testing of automation and agentic AI initiatives identified through process improvement efforts

**What We're Looking For**

Required Skills and Experience

- An S&P Global employee at this level would typically have 2–3 years of relevant experience in credit analysis, financial research, or a related analytical field.

- Strong research and data analysis skills, including financial statement proficiency and a foundational understanding of credit and risk concepts

- Practical experience using generative AI or LLM tools to support analysis, research, or drafting, with disciplined and responsible use practices

- Proficiency in spreadsheet tools for financial analysis, with willingness to develop skills in data and automation platforms to supervise and validate outputs

- Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present analysis clearly in a structured format that supports informed decision-making

Preferred or Helpful Experience

- Experience supporting financial modeling or quantitative analysis under senior guidance

- A learning agility mindset with comfort adopting new tools while maintaining quality and accountability

- Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent required. A master's degree or professional certification (such as CFA) is highly valued. We welcome candidates from traditional finance disciplines as well as diverse academic backgrounds that support innovative and critical thinking.

Additional Information

- Employees are required to work from the office a minimum of two days per week.

For more information, visit [www.spglobal.com/ratings](http://www.spglobal.com/ratings)

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

jobs.description:
**Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.**

**GET TO KNOW US**

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

**Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!**

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We are hiring a **Wellbeing Engagement Growth Manager** to our **Revenue** team in **São Paulo**!

You will be the strategic architect behind engagement and adoption programs for Wellhub’s most complex enterprise accounts. This is not a traditional operational marketing or customer support role, you will act as a senior internal consultant and trusted advisor to enterprise HR executives, building Joint Business Plans (JBPs) and deploying custom engagement models tailored to workforce demographics. **About us:** At Remote Talent LATAM, we connect top Latin American talent with leading U.S. marketing agencies. We guide businesses and candidates through every step of the hiring process, ensuring the perfect match in skills, culture, and goals. While we’re not direct employers, we act as a trusted partner, bridging the gap between exceptional talent and growing opportunities **Our Client:**

Our client is an e-commerce business specializing in diesel truck performance parts, automotive upgrades, and accessories. The company focuses on helping customers find the right products through a streamlined shopping experience, backed by knowledgeable customer support and specialized services. They are looking for a proactive paid advertising professional to take ownership of their campaigns, improve performance, and support profitable growth.

**What you will do:**

We’re looking for a hands-on, analytical Paid Ads Specialist to manage and optimize our client’s paid advertising campaigns across multiple platforms. This role is ideal for someone who understands e-commerce performance marketing, takes initiative in identifying opportunities, and can translate campaign data into actionable recommendations that drive business results.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Paid Advertising Management**

- Own and manage paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), and Microsoft Ads (Bing).
- Manage monthly advertising budgets of up to $100,000, ensuring spend is strategically allocated toward the highest-performing channels and campaigns.
- Develop, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns to maximize ROAS, revenue, and profitability.
- Manage Google Shopping, Performance Max, Search, Display, and remarketing campaigns.
- Oversee Meta prospecting, retargeting, catalog, and dynamic product advertising campaigns.
- Identify opportunities to expand advertising efforts into new platforms, including ChatGPT Ads and other emerging AI-driven advertising channels.
- Continuously evaluate campaign structures, bidding strategies, audience targeting, and budget allocation.


**Performance Optimization & Strategy**

- Monitor and optimize key performance indicators, including ROAS, CPA, CPC, CTR, conversion rates, and customer acquisition costs.
- Analyze campaign performance to identify inefficiencies, wasted ad spend, and opportunities for improvement.
- Develop strategies to scale successful campaigns while maintaining profitability.
- Conduct ongoing A/B testing of ad creatives, messaging, audiences, landing pages, and bidding strategies.
- Collaborate with internal marketing and eCommerce teams to align paid advertising efforts with product promotions, inventory availability, seasonal demand, and business objectives.
- Make strategic recommendations based on actual business performance, not just platform-reported metrics.


**Product Feeds & eCommerce Advertising**

- Manage and optimize product feeds within Google Merchant Center, Meta Commerce Manager, and Microsoft Merchant Center.
- Identify opportunities to improve Shopping campaign performance through product titles, descriptions, categorization, and feed segmentation.
- Understand how product margins, inventory availability, and product performance influence advertising strategy.
- Develop product-specific advertising strategies for high-priority brands, product categories, and individual SKUs.
- Work with internal teams to troubleshoot product disapprovals, feed issues, and advertising policy restrictions.

**Reporting & Analytics**

- Provide clear, actionable reporting on advertising spend, revenue, profitability, and campaign performance.
- Utilize GA4, Google Tag Manager, and platform reporting tools to validate campaign performance and conversion tracking.
- Ensure accurate tracking of purchases, revenue, and other key conversion events.
- Identify attribution discrepancies between advertising platforms and actual eCommerce performance.
- Present recommendations for improvements, budget shifts, and growth opportunities.
- Maintain transparency around advertising spend and the business results generated.

jobs.description:

**GET TO KNOW US**

We are revolutionizing corporate well-being. Our platform connects employees around the world with the best partners in physical exercise, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition and sleep routines – all in one subscription. Based in New York with teams in Europe, North America and South America, our mission is to make every company a well-being company.

We believe work should be rewarding, inspiring and balanced. Here, you will find a team that values well-being, collaboration and diverse perspectives, in a place where passion and creativity break boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help build a healthier world, for you and millions of people globally.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We are hiring a **Personnel Department Manager (English Speaker)** to join our **People Operations** team in **São Paulo!**

The People Operations team plays a fundamental role in providing high-quality operational support, ensuring full labor law compliance and continuously improving the employee lifecycle. As Personnel Department Manager, you will oversee end-to-end processes, manage the relationship with outsourced suppliers, lead union relations and lead a direct team.

**YOUR IMPACT**

- **Lead, guide and develop** the direct Personnel Department (People Ops) team, ensuring ongoing operational support, performance alignment and the attraction of new talent to the team.
- **Act in strategic management of suppliers and budget**, monitoring the performance, costs and contracts of partner companies responsible for payroll processing, benefits and time control.
- **Ensure legal compliance and audit readiness**, staying ahead of regional labor laws, guaranteeing data integrity and leading participation in annual audits (ISO, regulatory and internal policies).
- **Conduct union relations and legal representation**, leading collective bargaining agreement negotiations and representing the organization (as *preposto/a*) in hearings at the Labor Court.
- **Partner with the global Payroll and Total Rewards teams** to ensure payroll accuracy through rigorous reviews and approvals (without operational execution), and manage benefits calendars and eligibility.
- **Act as the main HR/PeopleOps advisor** to senior leadership, managing complex processes such as executive hiring and termination with strict alignment to our policies.
- **Optimize and drive end-to-end improvements** in workflows, HR systems and data use, recommending efficiency strategies for the Business Partners (BPs).
- **Live the mission:** inspire and empower others by prioritizing your own well-being and that of your colleagues. Create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves and finding a balance between work and personal life.

**WHO YOU ARE**

- **Have fluency in English (advanced/fluent level),** being able to lead meetings, align with global stakeholders, provide regional support and write documents in the language.
- **Have solid experience** in leadership of Personnel Department/People Operations, with strong involvement in managing the employee lifecycle.
- **Have deep understanding and interest** in working with strategic management and review/audit of payroll partners, without the need to get your hands dirty with closing/processing in the system.
- **Have specialized knowledge** of Brazilian labor legislation, union negotiations, legal representation (*preposto*) and conducting audit processes (e.g., ISO).
- **Have prior experience** with budget management and contract negotiation with outsourced Personnel and benefits suppliers.
- **Be an inspiring leader**, with a proven track record in building, developing and supervising HR operations teams.
- **Be able to act strategically** in process optimization, maintaining high standards of data integrity in HR systems.
- **Hold a completed degree** in Business Administration, Human Resources, Law or related areas.

Even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements for this role, apply! We would be delighted to receive your application and assess your fit with our team. Please just note that prior experience in **Personnel Department/People Operations leadership, management of labor and union relations, and fluent English** are mandatory for this specific role.

**WHAT WE OFFER YOU**

We have created a work environment for you to thrive in every dimension of your life. We do this through well-thought-out benefits, resources for emotional well-being and a culture that empowers each person to truly connect with their role here and take ownership of it, balancing this with their own well-being.

Our flexible benefits program helps you customize them according to your needs!

You can also add up to 3 family members to your plan, ensuring that those who matter most to you have access to well-being.

**WELLZ:** A unique and comprehensive resource for mental well-being. Wellz offers personalized journeys that combine weekly cognitive-behavioral therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

**HEALTH AND CARE:** Health plan, dental plan and life insurance.

**FLEXIBLE WORK:** With a work arrangement that prioritizes flexibility, we offer hybrid and remote positions, so you have the freedom to work in the way that works best for you. The work model for this specific position can be discussed with the recruiter and the leadership. Once you join Wellhub, you can also use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office!

**FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:** Flexibility is not limited to where we work – it also includes being able to shape how and when we work. In partnership with your leaders, people set their schedules to align with different time zones, each team's needs and each personal routine.

**PAID TIME OFF:** Disconnecting and recharging your energy is very important. That is why we offer vacation after 6 months of work + 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year at the company (up to 5 days in total) + 1 day off in your birthday month!

**PAID PARENTAL LEAVE:** Welcoming a new family member is one of the most special moments in life. We want every employee to be truly present and enjoy this time with family. That is why we offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Those who give birth are also entitled to extended leave (Empresa Cidadã) and an adaptation period (ramp-back), during which they may work part-time until they adjust to their new routine.

jobs.description:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at [amplitude.com](http://amplitude.com).

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

**The Opportunity:** We are looking to thoughtfully expand our Enterprise team. As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will act as a strategic partner to our largest prospective clients, helping them solve complex data challenges. You will work closely with leadership (including our VP of Enterprise Sales) to foster long-term relationships and build a sustainable, high-growth territory.

**What You Will Do**

- **Lead a Strategic Territory:** Design and lead a comprehensive strategy, identifying key opportunities to introduce Amplitude to new enterprise businesses.

- **Orchestrate Complex Sales Cycles:** Manage the end-to-end partnership process, navigating various lines of business (Product, Engineering, Marketing) to align stakeholders on a shared vision.

- **Nurture Client Partnerships:** Move beyond transactional selling to become a trusted advisor. You will conduct discovery, present customized solutions, and guide customers toward high-impact outcomes.

- **Collaborate Cross-Functionally:** Work as part of an ecosystem—partnering with Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and Leadership to ensure our customers succeed.

- **Achieve Growth Goals:** Consistently meet and exceed revenue goals by solving real problems for our customers.


**You’ll Be a Great Addition if...**

- **You are experienced at scale:** You have successfully partnered with large, complex organizations (typically **1,500+ employees** and **$50M+ in revenue**) and have a track record of driving significant revenue impact (generating **>$1M in ARR**).

- **You have deep experience in Enterprise SaaS:** You are comfortable managing complex sales cycles and closing significant deals (typically ~5-7+ years of experience).

- **You are a curious learner:** While experience in Big Data, Analytics, or MarTech is a plus, we value the ability to learn complex technical concepts and tell a compelling story with data over niche sector experience.

- **You value consistency:** You have a history of meeting or exceeding your goals and building reliable pipelines.

- **You are a resilient collaborator:** You thrive in a team setting, are adaptable in the face of challenges, and believe that we win together.


**A Note on Confidence:** Research shows that women and underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. If you’re excited about this role and our mission but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, **we encourage you to apply anyway**. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles at Amplitude.

**Why Amplitude?**

- **Culture of Belonging:** We strive to create an environment focused on psychological safety, empathy, and human connection.

- **Holistic Benefits:** We offer comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, along with [generous parental leave, fertility benefits,] and unlimited PTO to support your work-life balance.

- **Growth:** We are a public company (AMPL) with the agility of a startup, offering equity and opportunities to build your career.


Amplitude provides equal employment opportunities (EEO). All applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or sexual orientation.

### Our values:

At Amplitude, our values guide how we show up for one another and for our customers:

- **Humility:** We operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view.

- **Ownership:** We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success.

- **Growth Mindset:** We’re tenacious in the face of challenges and seek feedback in order to grow ourselves and others.

- **Customer Centricity:** We put the customer at the center of everything we do and are deeply committed to their success.


**We care about the well-being of our team:** We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers.

Some of our benefit programs include:

- Excellent ​M​edical, ​D​ental and ​V​ision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee Medical, ​Dental,​ ​​​​​​​​Vision on select plans

- 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually

- Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more

- Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more

- Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support

- Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions

- Employee Stock Purchase Program​ (ESPP)


**Other fun facts about Amplitude:**

- Our customers love us! They've said we're the [#1 product analytics solution](https://www.g2.com/categories/product-analytics/enterprise) for 23 quarters in a row on G2.

- We care a lot about product innovation. We've made significant investments in talent and infrastructure to build the most powerful AI analytics platform on the market.

- We invest in our people. We offer mentorship programs, management training, and wellness initiatives.

- We give back to our communities. We give every Ampliteer a charitable giving grant and paid volunteer time off.

- We were founded in 2012, went public via a direct listing in September 2021, and are now trading under the ticker $AMPL.

- We’re a global and fast-growing team! We have employees around the world and offices in San Francisco (HQ), New York, Vancouver, Amsterdam, London, Paris, Singapore, and Tokyo.

- Our mascot is Data Monster, who loves to chow down on numbers, charts, and graphs. Nom nom.


By applying for this job, you acknowledge that Amplitude processes your personal data in accordance with the [Amplitude Applicant Privacy Notice](https://amplitude.com/job-applicant-privacy-notice).

#### Company description

Experian is a global data and technology company that empowers people and businesses around the world. #### Job description

We are looking for a **Principal Engineer** to join our **GenAI Platform** team, leading the construction of enterprise-scale Generative Artificial Intelligence solutions.

This position will play a key role in defining technical standards, architecture, governance and operational excellence for solutions based on LLMs, working directly with product, engineering and business stakeholder teams to turn complex challenges into high-impact products.

If you combine deep experience in Machine Learning and Generative AI with a practical, results-oriented approach, this is an opportunity to influence the AI strategy of a global organisation.

- Lead the design and implementation of GenAI solutions in corporate and regulated environments.
- Define scalable architectures using LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, guardrails and model routing strategies.
- Establish evaluation, monitoring and governance standards for Generative AI applications.
- Work directly with product and business teams to turn needs into production-ready solutions.
- Develop frameworks, reusable components, templates and best practices that can be adopted by multiple teams.
- Conduct technical reviews, support architectural decisions and act as a technical reference for engineers and data scientists.
- Ensure alignment with Responsible AI requirements, information security, compliance and model risk management.
- Promote knowledge transfer and enablement of the teams responsible for sustaining the solutions.

#### Qualifications

- Mandatory - Advanced/fluent English for work in a global environment.
- Solid experience in Machine Learning Engineering and/or LLM Engineering in production environments.
- Hands-on experience with:
  - Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  - AI Agents
  - Guardrails for GenAI
  - Model Selection & Routing
  - Offline and online model evaluation
  - Regression testing for AI applications
  - Human-in-the-loop validation
  - Model monitoring and observability
- Experience with cloud environments, especially **AWS** and/or **Databricks**.
- Knowledge of model and dataset versioning, experiment tracking and MLOps.
- Ability to influence multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders without formal authority.

Differentiators

- Experience with MLflow and Unity Catalog.
- Knowledge of Databricks Model Serving.
- Experience with Kubernetes, EKS or distributed environments.
- Experience in highly regulated sectors.
- Knowledge of governance and Responsible AI frameworks.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Experimentation Platform
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

### **The Community You Will Join**

The Experimentation team's mission is to provide an insightful, reliable and easy to use experimentation platform (A/B testing and feature rollout) for customers across the company. Thousands of experiments run on our platform each year. Our team is multidisciplinary, owning a vertical stack that includes UIs for setting up and analyzing experiments, data pipelines and libraries for calculating results, and the clients and services that deliver feature flags, product configuration and experiment assignment to applications. You will work closely with data science partners, engineers across infrastructure teams, and the product engineers who use our tools every day.

### **The Difference You Will Make**

You will co-own the client libraries and services that thousands of Airbnb engineers use to roll out features and run experiments, primarily on the JVM, alongside the engineer who owns them today. You will help consolidate our feature flag and product configuration systems onto a single platform and make it easy and safe to set up flags, configuration and experiments in code. Success looks like clients that are fast, reliable and easy to adopt, large cross-team migrations that finish on schedule without breaking consumers, and new assignment capabilities that meet Airbnb's needs.

### **A Typical Day**

- Build and extend the capabilities of our experimentation, feature flagging and product configuration clients and the services behind them.
- Design and lead cross-team migrations: evolving client APIs, deprecating old ones, and moving consuming services over safely.
- Improve the testability, performance and reliability of client libraries that are widely deployed and tightly interconnected.
- Build new allocation and targeting capabilities in partnership with data science, such as holdouts and mutually exclusive experiments, with attention to statistical pitfalls.
- Use AI-assisted development to move faster on migrations, tests and refactors, and help the team set good practice for it.
- Participate in all phases of software development from design through implementation, testing and on-call, and work across the stack, including Python services, when the problem needs it.

### **Your Expertise**

- 5+ years in a hands-on software engineering role, shipping high-quality code to production.
- Strong experience in a JVM language (Java or Kotlin), building libraries or services that other developers depend on, with a deep understanding of OOP and API design, including backward compatibility and versioning.
- Experience driving changes across teams you do not own, such as migrations or deprecations with many consumers, and the communication skills and track record to lead projects that span teams.
- Hands-on fluency with AI-assisted development: you use coding agents and LLM tools day to day and know how to verify what they produce.
- Comfortable working in Python and other layers of the stack, or eager to.
- [Bonus] Experience with feature flagging or product configuration systems, experimentation platforms, or web and mobile clients.
- [Bonus] Experience with latency-sensitive, high-throughput client SDKs.

**Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:**

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: [reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com](mailto:reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com). Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

**Reasonable Accommodations:** We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

**A Note on Recruiting Scams:** Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ [airbnb.com](http://airbnb.com) or @ [ext.airbnb.com](http://ext.airbnb.com) email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (LATAM)
jobs.description:
## **About Savvy Wealth:**

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.

Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.

AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.

The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!

**Recognition:**

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

- Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

- Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)

- Great Place to Work Certified™


### **Responsibilities:**

- Own the end-to-end product development lifecycle of identifying, designing, and shipping large initiatives for clients and advisors.

- Produce high-quality, production-ready, readable, maintainable code

- Work cross-functionally with product leadership, design, and business partners to deliver the best product.


### **Must have:**

- 5-10 years building web applications with experience shipping features in production environments

- Full-stack development skills including web frameworks (Rails preferred), TypeScript, frontend frameworks and libraries (Next.js and React preferred), and SQL databases

- Experience writing automated tests across the stack (unit, integration, and end-to-end, e.g. RSpec, Vitest, Playwright) and treating tests as part of shipping a feature, not a follow-up

- Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) as part of your daily workflow, including reviewing and testing AI-generated code with the same rigor as your own

- Strong collaboration and communication working effectively in cross-functional teams with clear technical communication skills

- Understanding of web application fundamentals including authentication/authorization, caching, background processing, and API design principles (GraphQL preferred)


### **Nice to have:**

- Fintech domain knowledge including financial services, wealth management, regulatory compliance, or financial data integrations

- Modern development ecosystem experience with macOS toolchains, CI/CD pipelines, IaaS providers, and observability platforms (Datadog)


### **Benefits:**

- Competitive salary and equity package

- We offer a generous relocation package to help top talent make the move to our NYC office

- Unlimited PTO + paid company holidays

- Access to holistic medical, dental, and vision plans

- Company 401(k) (including Mega backdoor Roth options), Commuter, and HSA/FSA plans

- NYC office in Union Square

- Lunch and snacks provided in the office, & dinner if you stay late

- Access to virtual mental health care (Spring Health) and health concierge (Rightway) to help you find the right care
