jobs.description:
## Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

*****Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.**

**A day in the life:**

The TikTok Advertising Strategist delivers Power Digital’s SMB TikTok offering: a defined set of onboarding deliverables and recurring working sessions for small and mid-sized brands. They are oriented toward getting clients live and spending on TikTok quickly, then helping them grow. They are self-starters who work within the structure of the offer rather than open-ended account management. The Strategist works hand-in-hand with the program lead to refine the offer and deliver it. They own account setup, the initial build, and the working sessions, and they are excellent at giving clients clear, practical direction in a limited amount of time.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Full ownership of strategy and execution of the SMB offer via TikTok Advertising

  - Account setup and QA, with tracking QA coordinated with internal teams
  - Initial campaign build, including structure, ad copy, and ads built from client creative
  - Lead recurring working sessions covering builds, reporting, and optimizations
  - Move clients to live, spending campaigns on a swift timeline; escalate stalled launches early
  - Sufficient QA that results in no errors that would negatively impact clients

- Effectively own internal communication for the program

  - Keep client status and spend up to date in a shared tracker
  - Flag blockers, scope questions, and client feedback to the program lead
  - Proactively making recommendation to improve efficiency and performance

- Excellent marketing and business strategy acumen

  - Complete understanding of the marketing funnel and how SMB brands succeed on TikTok
  - Full knowledge of the Power Circuit, and use of Power Digital’s Nova ecosystem and tools as they relate to your role
  - Ability to navigate roadblocks and adapt within the structure of the offer

- Ownership of performance reporting during client sessions
- Ability to leverage data to tell a story and articulate results to clients with clear next steps
- Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes

**Role Requirements:**

- 2-3 years of digital marketing experience; 1-2 years in an agency setting
- Minimum 2-3 years of hands-on experience with TikTok Advertising
- Specifically having experience with account setup, campaign and ad group structure, ad copy development, creative testing, and bid and budget optimization
- Hands-on experience with TikTok pixel and Events Manager setup and QA
- Proficiency in Google/Microsoft Office Suite(s)
- Proficiency in Google Analytics
- Strong understanding of full-funnel marketing
- Other skills required:
  - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including running a live working session
  - Strong organizational and project management skills across many clients at different checkpoints
  - Discipline to hold scope and say no to work outside the checkpoints
  - Self-motivated individual with a strong desire to succeed
  - Confident with client-facing presentations and communication
  - Strong work ethic and ability to learn quickly and independently

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

- Managing a full workload indicated by $30K revenue/employee
- Client spend growth on TikTok
- 90% Client Retention, evaluated biannually
- Team Retention (of DRs if applicable): 95%

**Most Important Things (MITs)**

- Excellence in launch execution and account performance, with fast, error-free builds
- Accurate tracking of client status and spend
- Successful cross-team collaboration
- Reliable internal communication

**Benefits & Perks:**

- Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities
- Unlimited Time Off available on day one
- Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
- Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs
- National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year
- Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
- Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)

jobs.title: Commercial Account Executive
jobs.description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

#### **The role, in a nutshell:**

Chainguard is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to expand our footprint within large organizations. You'll own the full sales cycle with enterprise customers — from building pipeline to closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals — and help some of the world's biggest companies build and secure software the right way.

The best candidates run a disciplined sales process, generate their own pipeline, and are comfortable navigating long enterprise buying cycles involving technical, security, and executive stakeholders. You'll partner closely with Sales Engineering, Customer Engineering, and Marketing to drive evaluations forward and win.

#### What You'll Do

- Own the full enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting through close
- Build and manage pipeline across a defined set of enterprise accounts
- Lead discovery, qualification, and deal strategy using frameworks like MEDDPICC
- Communicate Chainguard's value to technical stakeholders, security leaders, and executive buyers
- Partner with Sales Engineering and Customer Engineering to run technical evaluations and validation
- Manage complex sales cycles, including procurement, security review, and negotiation
- Maintain accurate pipeline visibility and forecasting
- Consistently meet or exceed revenue and pipeline targets

#### What We're Looking For

- 3+ years selling complex technical products into enterprise organizations
- Must be bilingual in Portuguese and English
- A track record of building your own pipeline and consistently closing revenue
- Fluency in a disciplined enterprise sales methodology (MEDDPICC or similar)
- Skill identifying customer pain and selling on measurable business value
- Experience navigating multi-stakeholder enterprise buying cycles, from technical teams to executives
- Strong deal management and forecast discipline across complex, concurrent opportunities
- Excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills
- Comfort operating in a fast-growing environment with evolving processes

#### About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

- We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
- We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
- We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
- We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

- **Flexible & Remote-First Culture:** Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.
- **Our Approach to Equity:** Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).
- **100% Covered Health Insurance:** We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.
- **∞ Flexible Time Off:** Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.
- **18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave:** We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Chainguard will process your personal data in accordance with [Chainguard's Global Candidate Privacy Notice](https://www.chainguard.dev/legal/candidate-privacy-notice).

 Senior Dev Ops Engineer (Remote Contractor - Nearshore)

* * *

**Senior Dev Ops Engineer (Remote Contractor, Nearshore)**

**About the Role**

Kuali runs the administrative backbone for roughly 150 colleges and universities. When our infrastructure is unavailable, research proposals miss federal deadlines, financial closes stall, and students cannot register. Reliability is not an internal engineering preference here; it is a contractual and reputational obligation, and it is tested continuously.

Our DevOps team owns the DevOps processes for Kuali's SaaS platform — the cloud infrastructure it runs on, the infrastructure-as-code that defines it, the self-service paths product teams deploy through, and the observability that tells us how it is behaving. That is the job.

**Who are we?**

Kuali builds software solutions for higher education. We help our customers — colleges & universities — focus on providing a fantastic education to students by decreasing their administrative costs. We work in a competitive space, ripe for innovation, with users ready to be delighted.

**Our Culture**

As a company, we are guided by our [cultural values:](https://www.kuali.co/jobs#values)

- Iterate to evolve
- Cultivate openness
- Act with accountability
- Assume the best
- Practice humility
- Deliver amazing experiences

As Kuali Engineers, we learn from and teach each other, we practice transparency and empathy, we delight in delivering value to our customers, and we WIN!

We work remotely and have for years. Distributed work is in our bones, with a history of institutions working together across state lines for more than twenty years. Our employees each work in the environment where they’re happiest, from Pennsylvania to Seattle. We work consciously to create a collaborative and healthy remote work culture, and we travel to meet in person a few times each year.

**About you**

- You have operated production at genuine stakes. You have been the person responsible when something important was down.
- You automate reflexively and treat sustained toil as a defect rather than a fact of life.
- You are calm in incidents. You communicate honestly and keep blame out of the room.
- You work autonomously across a distributed team, and you escalate early when you should.

**What You'll Own:**

Cloud infrastructure & infrastructure-as-code

- Design, build, and operate the AWS infrastructure our SaaS platform runs on, across every customer tenant.
- Define that infrastructure in code — reusable CDK modules in TypeScript — and own the standards other engineers build against.
- Own environment topology, multi-tenant isolation, and disaster recovery design.

Observability

- Build monitoring, logging, and tracing that detects real problems and does not cry wolf.
- Own golden-signal performance monitoring — latency, traffic, errors, saturation — for the services that matter.
- Own audit logging: complete, tamper-evident, and readily produced for audits and customer security reviews.

Performance & scaling

- Keep the platform fast and available as customer count and load grow: capacity planning, scaling strategy, and cost-aware sizing.
- Diagnose and fix production performance problems at the infrastructure layer.
- Participate in on-call for the infrastructure you own, and drive root-cause fixes to completion.

**Required Qualifications**

- 4+ years in DevOps, platform, SRE, or infrastructure engineering.
- Deep, hands-on AWS experience running production workloads — compute, networking, storage, and managed data services.
- Strong infrastructure-as-code experience (CDK or equivalent), building modules others reuse.
- Strong Linux, networking, and database operations experience.
- Proficiency with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic, Open Telemetry, ELK, or comparable).
- Production on-call experience, with a record of driving systemic fixes rather than repeat repairs.
- Clear written English, and working hours overlapping US Mountain Time.

**Required Skills:**

- Experience supporting multi-tenant enterprise SaaS.
- Experience migrating production workloads onto AWS from another platform.
- Experience producing infrastructure evidence for SOC 2 or comparable compliance programs.
- Cloud cost optimization experience.

At Kuali, we value and respect individuals from all backgrounds, recognizing that a rich tapestry of experiences and perspectives fuels our success as a company and enriches our collective human experience.

Apply for this Position

**About the Role**

Kuali's software powers the administrative core of higher education. Our Financials product manages the general ledger, procurement, budgeting, and accounts payable for universities — systems institutions use to move and account for real money under real audit scrutiny. Our platform products manage sponsored research, compliance, curriculum, and degree audit for roughly 150 institutions.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you own a significant subsystem or product domain. You set its technical direction, you make the design decisions that determine whether it stays healthy for the next five years, and you are the engineer other engineers come to. You remain deeply hands-on — this is a building role — while carrying accountability for architecture, quality, and production health well beyond your own commits.

You will work in mature, high-stakes systems where the cost of a defect is measured in an institution's financial close or a stalled research grant, and

where deep domain knowledge compounds into real leverage.

**Who are we?**

Kuali builds software solutions for higher education. We help our customers — colleges & universities — focus on providing a fantastic education to students by decreasing their administrative costs. We work in a competitive space, ripe for innovation, with users ready to be delighted.

**Our Culture**

As a company, we are guided by our [cultural values:](https://www.kuali.co/jobs#values)

- Iterate to evolve
- Cultivate openness
- Act with accountability
- Assume the best
- Practice humility
- Deliver amazing experiences

As Kuali Engineers, we learn from and teach each other, we practice transparency and empathy, we delight in delivering value to our customers, and we WIN!

We work remotely and have for years. Distributed work is in our bones, with a history of institutions working together across state lines for more than twenty years. Our employees each work in the environment where they’re happiest, from Pennsylvania to Seattle. We work consciously to create a collaborative and healthy remote work culture, and we travel to meet in person a few times each year.

**About you**

We’re looking for curious, enthusiastic, empathetic Sr Software Engineers to solve problems, execute on ideas, advocate for the customer, and contribute to a team culture built on trust and mutual respect. As a Sr Software Engineer here, you’ll have a significant impact on what we do and how we do it.

We build and support systems using both Java and Node.js/React. We believe that great developers can always learn new tools. Above any specific tech stack, we’re looking for versatile developers — those who know when to think big and when to act small, and who are comfortable in both greenfield and refactoring projects.

We believe the best results are created by teams who represent a broad range of ideas and perspectives. We value team members with diverse backgrounds and experiences.

**What You'll Own:**

Architectural Ownership

- Own the architecture of a significant product domain: service boundaries, data models, API contracts, performance characteristics, and failure behavior.
- Lead technical discovery for large, ambiguous initiatives and convert them into sequenced, executable plans with credible estimates.
- Make and document consequential design and build-versus-buy trade-offs, and be accountable for the results.
- Drive deliberate remediation of technical debt with a business case leadership can act on.

Hands-On Delivery

- Design, build, and ship the most complex and highest-risk work in your domain.
- Set the quality bar in code review, test strategy, and documentation.
- Lead incremental refactoring and modernization of legacy components while maintaining continuous delivery to customers.

Correctness, Security & Compliance

- Own correctness in a domain where financial accuracy, audit trails, and tenancy isolation are non-negotiable.
- Ensure your domain satisfies FERPA, SOC 2, and applicable state security program requirements.
- Partner with Compliance and Security on assessments, evidence, and remediation.

Production Ownership

- Own your domain in production: SLOs, instrumentation, performance, and cloud cost.
- Lead incident response and command significant incidents; drive systemic remediation afterward, not just the immediate fix.
- Serve as escalation point for the hardest customer-reported issues in your area.

Technical Leadership

- Mentor engineers at all levels and measurably accelerate their growth.
- Partner directly with Product and your Engineering Manager on roadmap feasibility, sequencing, and risk.
- Represent your domain credibly to executives and, when it matters commercially, to customers.
- Contribute to the organization's adoption of AI-assisted development practices as they mature.

**Required Qualifications**

- 6–9 years of professional software engineering experience, including significant ownership of production SaaS or enterprise systems.
- Deep proficiency in one or more of our core stacks: Java and Spring, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js.
- Strong experience with relational databases, data modeling, API design, and distributed system fundamentals.
- Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), CI/CD, and automated testing at scale.
- Demonstrated ownership of production services, including on-call leadership and incident command.
- Track record of mentoring engineers.
- Excellent written and verbal communication.


**Required Skills:**

- Experience with enterprise financial systems, ERP, or other domains with strict correctness and audit requirements.
- Experience leading legacy modernization or migration programs.
- Multi-tenant enterprise SaaS at meaningful scale.
- Experience in regulated environments (FERPA, SOC 2 Type 2, TX-RAMP, HIPAA, or similar).
- Experience with event-driven architectures or message queue technologies.
- Familiarity with higher-education administrative systems.


**We’d be delighted if you bring experience with:**

- Experience supporting multi-tenant enterprise SaaS.
- Experience migrating production workloads onto AWS from another platform.
- Experience producing infrastructure evidence for SOC 2 or comparable compliance programs.
- Cloud cost optimization experience.

**Perks**

- Remote-first and results-driven
- Space to work on self-driven projects during quarterly “hack weeks”

jobs.description:
**Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.**

**GET TO KNOW US**

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

**Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!**

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We are hiring a **Marketing Analytics Engineer (AI)** to our **Marketing** team in **Brazil**!

The Marketing Analytics Engineer (AI) is an embedded analyst position, a hybrid role combining data engineering, marketing data analysis, and applied AI skills. This individual supports the Marketing Analytics team by building and maintaining the data infrastructure that enables business teams to analyze campaigns and overall marketing performance, while also expanding that infrastructure to power AI-driven analytics tools.

You will join the Marketing Analytics team, working alongside an experienced Analytics Engineer who will be your closest technical reference. Responsibilities span data modeling, pipeline management, predictive analysis, and the design of machine-readable business context that makes AI agents accurate and trustworthy. This role collaborates closely with teams across the company (including Martech, Global Analytics, Product Development, and Sales Operations) to ensure data-driven insights effectively drive business growth.

This is a Remote – **Brazil** position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in **Brazil**.

**YOUR IMPACT**

- Build and maintain the marketing data layer, developing pipelines that transform raw marketing sources into dimensional models (following Medallion architecture) and delivering clean, report-ready tables for downstream analytics.
- Maintain and extend BI data models (LookML and/or dbt preferred) enriched with metadata, business context, and structured definitions that make them consumable by AI agents and natural language analytics interfaces.
- Build reusable AI skills, tools, and workflows with guidance from senior engineers, empowering analysts and stakeholders to interact with governed data through natural language interfaces.
- Establish AI quality assurance by running structured test cycles defined with the team to validate AI agent output accuracy, identify regressions, and maintain quality standards as models and data evolve.
- Support the development of statistical and predictive models for marketing funnel metrics, and help maintain and operate the attribution models that measure channel and campaign contribution.
- Ensure data reliability, governance, and documentation through continuous monitoring, data validation, adherence to responsible AI standards, and comprehensive version control in GitHub.
- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including Martech, Global Analytics, Product Development, and Sales Operations—to ensure high-impact data-driven insights drive business growth.
- Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

**WHO YOU ARE**

- An analytics or data engineer with solid experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or a closely adjacent technical role.
- A technical problem solver with solid in-depth knowledge of **Python** and **SQL**, possessing the ability to write clean, production-grade data pipelines rather than one-off scripts.
- An engineer well-versed in modern data architecture, familiar with data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT workflows, orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar), and dimensional modeling.
- A practitioner with hands-on experience in semantic layer tools (Looker/LookML strongly preferred; Tableau, PowerBI, or similar welcome).
- A curious builder with hands-on experience in applied AI, including LLMs and agentic workflows (designing agent context, AI-assisted pipeline development, or LLM-based production tools).
- A clear, collaborative communicator who enjoys working across both technical and non-technical stakeholders and is fluent in English to collaborate within a globally distributed team.
- An analytical thinker with nice-to-have exposure to AI agent context design (glossaries, structured behavioral rules) and marketing analytics domain knowledge (funnels, attribution, CRM, growth).

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in **SQL, Python**, and **hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic workflows** are **mandatory** requirements.

**WHAT WE OFFER YOU**

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

**Our benefits include:**

**WELLHUB:** Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

**WELLZ:** A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

**HEALTHCARE:** Health, dental, and life insurance.

**FLEXIBLE WORK:** As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

**FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:** Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

**PAID TIME OFF:** It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

**PAID PARENTAL LEAVE:** Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

**CAREER GROWTH:** Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

**CULTURE:** You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. [Learn more about our shared culture and values here.](https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/our-values/)

**Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on** [**Instagram**](https://www.instagram.com/lifeatwellhub/) **@lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on** [**YouTube**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZgIPiszTVm4) **!**

**Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub**

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. [Read more about it here.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/wellhub_fairpay-syndio-activity-7407826561531363328-wbN_?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAAzHQWABKsRqcpvxy4QpDCJNe_szRdC4hgY)

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Experimentation Interfaces
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

### **The Community You Will Join**

The Experimentation team's mission is to provide an insightful, reliable and easy to use experimentation platform (A/B testing and feature rollout) for customers across the company. Thousands of experiments run on our platform each year. Our team is multidisciplinary, owning UIs for setting up and analyzing experiments, data pipelines and libraries for calculating results, and clients for assignment and delivery. You will work closely with design and data science partners and with the engineers and analysts across the company who use our tools every day.

### **The Difference You Will Make**

You will co-own the web application where teams set up, manage and analyze experiments and feature configuration, and the AI-assisted workflows that are becoming part of how experiments are designed, validated and read out. You will build features end to end, from the React/TypeScript interface through Python APIs to the data layer, and make our tools intuitive and trustworthy for users with a wide range of statistical backgrounds. Success looks like features that measurably speed up experiment setup and readout, and AI-enabled tools that people adopt because they are reliable.

### **A Typical Day**

- Develop new features across the client (React/TypeScript), APIs (Python/GraphQL) and database, and own them from design through on-call.
- Work with design and key customers to shape intuitive experiences, including how to visualize experiment results so users with minimal statistical training draw good conclusions.
- Build AI-enabled workflows for our users, such as agent tools and skills that help create, validate and analyze experiments, and the interface around them, with evaluations that keep quality high.
- Use AI-assisted development to move faster, and help the team set good practice for it.
- Work with data science partners to bring new methodology into the product.
- Participate in experiment reviews to understand how customers use the platform and where it falls short.

### **Your Expertise**

- 5+ years in a hands-on software engineering role, shipping high-quality code to production, including full-stack web applications on a modern stack.
- Strong front-end skills: React and TypeScript fundamentals, state and data fetching, performance and testing, and a good eye for intuitive interfaces in data-rich or enterprise tools.
- Experience across the stack: backend APIs in Python or a similar language, GraphQL or comparable API design, and relational database storage.
- Hands-on experience with AI: you build with LLMs or agent tooling (tools, skills, evaluations), or you are fluent with AI-assisted development and know how to verify what it produces.
- Experience working directly with customers and design to turn ambiguous needs into shipped, well-designed features, with clear communication.
- [Bonus] Experience with data visualization or data-intensive applications.
- [Bonus] Experience with experimentation platforms.

**Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:**

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: [reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com](mailto:reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com). Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

**Reasonable Accommodations:** We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

**A Note on Recruiting Scams:** Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ [airbnb.com](http://airbnb.com) or @ [ext.airbnb.com](http://ext.airbnb.com) email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

jobs.title: Commodity Associate Program (Spring 2027)
jobs.description:
## **About the Role:**

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

09

**Commodity Associate Program – Spring 2027**

**The** **Role:** The S&P Global Energy Commodity Associate Program is a seven-month rotational development program with intake cohorts in **March and September 2027**. The program begins with one month of structured training, followed by two three-month rotations across different commodity sectors, providing participants with broad exposure to energy and commodity markets before transitioning into a permanent role.

We are seeking candidates who will have completed their undergraduate degree by **February 2027** for the March 2027 intake, or by **August 2027** for the September 2027 intake. Postgraduate students are also encouraged to apply.

**The Location:** Sao Paulo

**The Team/The Business:** You will be part of the Platts price reporting team and will be considered as a specialist in the market(s) you will be working in. We are looking for genuinely curious and motivated graduates that are passionate about the commodities market, reporting and want to develop their career in a dynamic, high performing and diverse team.

**The Impact:**

- Our real-time news, pricing and analytical services help markets operate with transparency and efficiency.
- Be part of a global company with a strong history of growth and a globally diverse workforce with 20 offices spanning six continents.
- Be known as a respected source of essential information and part of a renowned brand.
- Get the best of both worlds: a nimble, highly specialized company and a business casual culture with the benefits and backing of S&P Global – a company that fosters development and growth, as well as work-life balance.
- We are looking for critical thinkers to join our team at S&P Global Energy, the principal provider of commodity price assessment and information to more than 10,000 customers in over 190 countries. The content you generate and the relationships you build are essential to the markets.
- Price reporters provide insightful market commentaries that demonstrate Energy thought leadership in the market, demonstrating our ability to spot key trends that help customers better anticipate market-moving events.


**What’s In It For You** You will be gathering qualitative data and intelligence from market participants as well as conducting price assessments guided by our methodologies. You will also be exposed to a number of market topics including supply and demand, infrastructure issues, geopolitical issues, transportation and regulation, and how these subjects impact respective markets. You will get an opportunity to learn about different aspects of Oil, Power, Natural Gas, LNG, Coal, Petrochemicals, Metals, Agriculture and Shipping markets.

During the programme, you will be fully trained in all the foundational skills and topics needed to succeed in the role of a price reporter. This includes writing market commentaries and news pieces which informs our pricing benchmarks and analytics.

You will receive four weeks of comprehensive training followed by two three-month rotations in different commodity sectors – preparing you to move into a permanent price reporting role in one of our commodity teams.  Should you meet expectations and perform well, you will be offered full time permanent employment at the end of the programme. Rotations and final placements are based on business needs.

You will be entrenched in S&P Global’s truly diverse and inclusive culture where you will have the opportunity to thrive as you bring your true, whole, human self to work.

**Responsibilities**

- Monitor commodity and energy markets to identify key trends, developments, and pricing drivers.
- Gather, validate, and analyze market intelligence from industry participants and public sources.
- Support the creation of market reports, news content, and pricing-related commentary.
- Contribute to the price assessment process by applying established methodologies and editorial standards.
- Build professional relationships with market participants to enhance market coverage and insight gathering.
- Maintain accurate records of market information and support data quality initiatives.
- Collaborate with editorial, analytics, and research teams on market-focused projects and deliverables.
- Complete training programs to build expertise in commodity markets, price reporting, and market analysis.
- Leverage approved AI and digital tools to improve research efficiency, knowledge discovery, and workflow effectiveness.
- Identify opportunities to streamline routine tasks through automation and AI-enabled solutions while maintaining accuracy and compliance.

**What We’re Looking For**

- Students from all academic backgrounds are welcome. Degrees in Journalism, Communications, Business, Economics, English Literature, English Language, Data Analytics, Sciences, Engineering, Energy Studies, Finance, or commodity-related disciplines are particularly valued.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, concise, and accurate market-focused content for a global audience.
- For APAC-based roles, proficiency in Mandarin is required.
- Demonstrated curiosity about energy, commodities, sustainability, and financial markets, with an interest in understanding market fundamentals and price movements.
- Ability to learn quickly, prioritize competing deadlines, and thrive in a fast-paced news and market intelligence environment.
- Strong relationship-building skills, with the confidence to engage professionally with market participants, industry stakeholders, and internal teams.
- Excellent analytical thinking, problem-solving, time management, attention to detail, and organizational abilities to efficiently gather, validate, and interpret market information.
- Comfortable working with data and digital tools, including Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint).
- Ability to assess information critically, identify market trends, and synthesize insights from multiple sources while maintaining high editorial standards and data integrity.
- Familiarity with Generative AI technologies and the ability to leverage AI-powered tools responsibly to enhance research, content creation, workflow efficiency, and process optimization.
- Proactively seeks opportunities to integrate AI-driven solutions into day-to-day processes, improving productivity, data analysis, source management, and content workflows.
- Demonstrates a commitment to accuracy, transparency, independence, and ethical standards that underpin the Platts price reporting and editorial methodology.

**About S&P Global Energy**

At S&P Global Energy, our comprehensive view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make superior decisions and create long-term, sustainable value. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration.

S&P Global Energy is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global enables businesses, governments, and individuals with trusted data, expertise, and technology to make decisions with conviction. We are Advancing Essential Intelligence through world-leading benchmarks, data, and insights that customers need in order to plan confidently, act decisively, and thrive economically in a rapidly changing global landscape. Learn more at [www.spglobal.com/energy](http://www.spglobal.com/energy).

**What’s In It For** **You?**

**Our Mission:**

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

**Our People:**

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

**Our Values:**

**Integrity, Discovery, Partnership**

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

**Benefits:**

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.

Our benefits include:

- Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.

- Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.

- Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.

- Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.

- Family Friendly Perks: It’s not just about you. S&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best-in class benefits for families.

- Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.


For more information on benefits by country visit: [https://spgbenefits.com/benefit-summaries](https://nam11.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fspgbenefits.com%2Fbenefit-summaries&data=05%7C02%7Clauren.washington%40spglobal.com%7C2110bb7975e647763da908dc57fae79d%7C8f3e36ea80394b4081a77dc0599e8645%7C1%7C0%7C638481982335774379%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=MLyuUlul44KSiQWXG3isvYhaT7f6JLL5jLpgtgOcHyE%3D&reserved=0)

**Global Hiring and Opportunity at S&P Global:**

At S&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasize fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain top talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive innovation and power global markets.

If you receive an email from a spglobalind.com domain or any other regionally based domains, it is a scam and should be reported to [reportfraud@spglobal.com](mailto:reportfraud@spglobal.com). S&P Global never requires any candidate to pay money for job applications, interviews, offer letters, “pre-employment training” or for equipment/delivery of equipment. At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

As a Manager in our Global Customer Support team, you will play a crucial role in leading a local team of support specialists committed to fostering strong post-sale technical relationships with our customers. You will ensure your team consistently hits their KPIs, conduct regular 1:1s, deliver actionable feedback, map career development paths, and set and review team OKRs. You will proactively address performance, champion talent growth, and lead hiring and onboarding for the local team.

In this role, you will:

- **People Leadership & Development:** Lead, mentor, and coach a high-performing support team, instilling a growth mindset and driving continuous technical and professional development.

- **Operational & KPI Excellence:** Monitor team performance and operational rigor, ensuring key support metrics (CSAT, CES, first response, and resolution times) meet and exceed target benchmarks.

- **Escalation Management:** Act as a critical escalation point for complex technical customer issues, driving root-cause resolution while keeping internal and external stakeholders aligned.

- **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with global support leaders, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering across multiple regions and time zones to streamline processes and advocate for team standards.

- **Process & Knowledge Sharing:** Drive documentation accuracy, process standardization, and knowledge-centered support (KCS) practices across the regional and global support teams.


**WHO YOU ARE**

- **Leadership Background:** Demonstrated experience managing and mentoring technical support teams, preferably within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Engineer - LATAM
jobs.description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

**The role, in a nutshell:**

You will assess a prospect’s technical requirements and apply extensive knowledge of Chainguard products to illustrate how a deal will satisfy the client’s unmet needs. You will cultivate relationships with decision-makers at all levels of an organization and negotiate the competing needs of multiple stakeholders within an organization. You will secure technical wins using methods such as demos, RFP/RFI responses, lead POVs, partner with engineering for requested features, and participate in conferences and industry events (when applicable).

**What you'll do:**

- Partner with our Sales Team to help customers evaluate and prove the value of our solution
- Focus on acquiring new customer “logos” in addition to growing existing customer base
- Own all technical aspects of sales opportunities and assisting current customers understand the value of Chainguard
- Day to day responsibilities include:
  - Listen to our customers and understand their challenges
  - Conduct product demonstrations and POVs/POCs
  - Actively participate in webinars, meetups, conferences and other marketing initiatives

**What we're looking for:**

- Experience as a Sales Engineer / Pre-Sales Engineer
- Experience with MEDDPICC and or Command of the Message sales frameworks
- Experience selling into Enterprise (3+ years) and Mid Market prospects
- Experience in the following areas:
  - Container technologies (Kubernetes, Serverless, Docker)
  - Cloud technology (AWS, Azure, Google, etc.)
  - Cloud security or containers security
  - App Security
- Startup experience
- Smart and passionate people that can persevere to success.
- People acting as trusted advisors, able to build credibility with customers.
- Strong team players committed to help and mentor their peers.

*Must be located in the São Paulo area*

**OTE RANGE (based on experience/location):**

#### About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

- We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
- We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
- We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
- We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

- **Flexible & Remote-First Culture:** Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.
- **Our Approach to Equity:** Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).
- **100% Covered Health Insurance:** We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.
- **∞ Flexible Time Off:** Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.
- **18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave:** We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Chainguard will process your personal data in accordance with [Chainguard's Global Candidate Privacy Notice](https://www.chainguard.dev/legal/candidate-privacy-notice).

jobs.title: Chief Customer Officer
jobs.description:
### Work from anywhere, impact everywhere

Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.

We’re a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.

Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country.

To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.

We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.

We are committed to changing the way things are done.

Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position

Work from anywhere!

### Position overview

Xapo's product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship.

Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn't yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible.

The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision.

The measure of success is a Customer P&L that grows on what members hold and keep: LTV:CAC improving, approved-to-paid rising, churn falling, and customer contribution the business can plan against.

This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep.

### The mandate

1. **Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional.**

   You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members' balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down.
2. **Grow what members hold with us, through earning products run like a banker would.**

   You own the roadmap for the balance-sheet products: deposits and savings, lending and credit, and trading and structured. Each is led by a mission PM who is a banker, owning a product's contribution and its price on the balance sheet, not a backlog. Requirements go through the gate; the economics are the job. Every item is priced by Finance before it is built, on a shared risk appetite with Risk and Treasury. Good looks like products that scale assets held and member lifetime value at a risk profile the Board actually approved.
3. **Win the right members, efficiently.**

   You own Growth: audience, lifecycle, and content, with one head accountable for the path from approval to paid. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it.
4. **Keep members, and deepen the relationship with the ones who hold balances.**

   Retention is the most efficient growth we have. You own churn, and you own Client Coverage: relationship managers who sell the missions' products to the members who hold balances, and loop demand back into the roadmap. You are accountable for net new AUM flow, covered-book retention, and products per covered member, and for growth that is broad-based rather than concentrated in a few accounts. Good looks like falling churn and AUM growth from members who stay and expand rather than members re-acquired at cost.
5. **Make the value of Xapo visible, and the experience effortless.**

   You own Product Design: one design system and one shell, so that members see the value of what they are earning clearly and early, and find every task simple. You design the proposition in the stream with Finance and partner with Operations, who run onboarding, KYC, support, cards, and payments, to remove friction at the points that affect members most. Good looks like members who understand their return, complete what they set out to do, and stay.
6. **Build one Customer organisation, not four.**

   Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design come together under one operating model: one set of key results read weekly from one source, shared frameworks for discovery and prioritisation, and real career paths for the people in it. Engineering is pulled to a single ranked roadmap, and nobody in your line has engineers of their own. Good looks like fewer hand-offs per outcome and a number for every cell that its owner explains every week.
7. **Bring the regulated-bank and crypto-native lens to every customer call.**

   You understand that a KYC onboarding decision and an AML monitoring decision carry different risk appetites, that a false positive at the gate is a paid-for member lost, and that a proposition built for a crypto-native power user can still fail a first-time bank customer. You can sit in the same room as a CRO, an MLRO, a CFO, and an engineering lead and make a customer case that survives all four conversations.

### How you'll operate

This part matters as much as the mandate. The known failure mode for this role, in any company, is a CCO with a polished customer-insight deck and no ownership of the number. That is disqualifying here.

- **You lead from inside the work.** You sit in on growth reviews, mission PM reviews, client meetings, and member calls, not just steering committees. PMs, designers, and relationship managers three levels down know your name because you've solved problems with them.
- **You move people with the business case, not the whip.** When a priority needs to change, you diagnose the problem, build the case with data and the economics, and show teams why it matters, so they re-prioritise because they're convinced, not because they were told. Your authority comes from being right and being useful, not from your title.
- **You have extreme ownership.** You own the Customer P&L and the member metrics beneath it, not the feature ship date. If a launch didn't move contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, or churn, you don't report "the roadmap item shipped", you change the approach.
- **You have genuine gravitas.** Senior, experienced leaders welcome your input because you've earned the standing to give it. You can challenge any executive's plan, including the CEO's, constructively, with evidence, and be thanked for it, because your challenge makes their work stronger.
- **You diagnose before you prescribe.** You can walk into a leaking funnel, a churning segment, or a product that isn't earning and find the structural cause, then fix the economics, not just the symptom.

### What you'll have done

- 10+ years in senior commercial or customer leadership (CCO, Chief Growth or Commercial Officer, MD or Head of Retail or Wealth, or equivalent) in digital banking, fintech, or payments, including meaningful time in a regulated environment (banking licence, e-money, or equivalent prudential/conduct regime).
- Crypto-native credibility: hands-on experience building and growing customer propositions on or around digital assets, custody, on-chain flows, Bitcoin-backed lending, or similar. You don't need Bitcoin explained to you, and you don't need banking explained to you either.
- Customer P&L ownership: you have owned a customer or product P&L judged on contribution, balances, and margin rather than transaction volume, and you are fluent in NIM, unit economics, customer contribution, and LTV:CAC.
- Growth and lifecycle: a track record of acquiring, activating, and retaining members in a regulated, KYC-heavy environment, improving approved-to-paid and churn while holding CAC to a level that LTV justifies, not just growth-hacking a free consumer app.
- Banking-grade product leadership: you have led product management for balance-sheet products such as savings, lending, or structured products, priced with Finance, with PMs who own a product's economics rather than a backlog. Experience with client coverage or relationship-managed models for high-balance and institutional clients is a strong advantage.
- Commercial and risk fluency: you can build a customer business case that survives scrutiny from Finance, Risk, and Compliance in the same meeting, and you know the difference between growth that's sustainable and growth that's borrowed from tomorrow's risk appetite.
- A track record of outcomes you can narrate: specific LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, AUM, or contribution numbers you owned, bets you killed when the data didn't support them, and outcomes you can prove.

### The first 90 days

**Day 30:** The Customer P&L baseline is documented across retail and institutional: customer contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, net paid-member growth, and assets attracted and kept. You have formed your own independent view of where members are won, lost, and under-served, and shared it with the CEO and Board. **Day 60:** The unified Customer operating model is live: one set of key results across Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design, read weekly from one source. Every mission PM owns a product's contribution and its price, and the roadmap is ranked on what it earns, built with Finance and the line leads. **Day 90:** At least one measurable improvement in LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, or net new AUM flow is live and attributable to a change you made, not a feature ship, an outcome moved. Every cell in your line has defined key results and an owner who explains the number every week.

### What this role is not

- Not a requirements-gathering role. Mission PMs are bankers who own a product's contribution and price, not a backlog. You partner with Technology, Finance, and Operations on execution; you don't run those functions.
- Not a volume role. If your primary output is card spend, transfer volume, or a shipped list rather than assets held and the margin they earn, we have both failed.
- Not a reporting layer. If your primary output is a customer-insight deck or a roadmap deck, we have both failed.
- Not a role that can be done from a distance. Remote-first means distributed, not detached.

### Other requirements

- A dedicated workspace.
- A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area.
- Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles.

### Why work for Xapo?

Impact Globally, Work Remotely.

- **Shape the Future**

Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.

- **Great work-life balance** Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge.

- **Expect Excellence** Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you’ll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.


At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.

jobs.description:
## Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. jobs.title: Container Engineer
jobs.description:
#### **About Supabase**

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. More than 9 million developers and 250,000+ customers now build on Supabase, and the majority of new databases on the platform are created by AI app builders — so the systems underneath have to stay reliable while they grow fast.

#### **About the Role**

Container Engineering (ConEng) owns the internal container platform that runs Supabase's multi-tenant, multi-region services — the managed Kubernetes platform that other engineering teams build and deploy on top of. We own cluster lifecycle and cluster classes, multi-cluster and multi-region topology, capacity, scheduling, isolation and runtime safety, the higher-level platform APIs, the Kubernetes deployment contract and Argo semantics, rollout primitives, and runtime configuration and secret injection.

Your job is to make the platform itself trustworthy, observable, and cheap to operate at scale — and to raise the reliability bar for everyone who depends on it. This is not a gatekeeper role. You'll make the reliable path the easy path: building the automation and platform APIs that let product teams run safely by default, instrumenting what we operate, and making sure that when something breaks we detect it and recover fast.

The work spans three strength areas:

**Tooling & ecosystem** — deep knowledge of the container and orchestration landscape (Kubernetes, containerd/OCI, the CNCF ecosystem) and a clear point of view on how to compose it.

**Software engineering** — designing and building the platform's automation, controllers, and internal tooling as production code, including solutions that don't come pre-shaped by an existing tool.

**Operational / SRE practice** — the discipline (SLOs, error budgets, incident response, ORRs) that runs the platform at scale as a predictable one.

We expect you to be genuinely deep in **at least one** of these, and many of our strongest candidates are deep in **two** (usually leaning toward one). Bringing real strength across **all three** is rare and exceptional — and even then, no one is equally strong in all three at once, so you'd focus where you're most needed at any given time. Different profiles are welcome here; tell us which of these is your center of gravity.

#### **What You'll Be Responsible For**

Regardless of the skill set, all team members carry a share of the team's on-call rota, responding to platform incidents and driving them to resolution and follow-up.

**Platform reliability & operations**

- Define SLIs/SLOs and error budgets for the container platform itself, and build error-budget policies that actually gate platform changes.

- Own the Operational Readiness Review (ORR) process for new platform capabilities and major changes.

- Design and track metrics for platform uptime, and increase observability into the platform by capturing the right metrics, logs, and traces across the platform layers.

- Drive the incident-to-improvement pipeline: facilitate blameless postmortems, connect findings to readiness gaps, spot repeat failure patterns, and push through systemic fixes.


**Software engineering**

- Build and maintain the platform's automation, controllers, operators, and internal tooling — writing production code and shipping it, not just wiring together existing tools.

- Design and implement the platform-side CI/CD and rollout primitives that speed up platform deployments while working within proper change and release management.

- Implement and maintain security automation for the platform: intrusion detection, automated remediation, and patch management.

- Identify and quantify operational toil, and build the automation that removes it rather than just documenting it.

- Contribute to the platform's continual testing automation — the test suites and pipelines that validate platform releases are fit for purpose before they reach tenants.


**Tooling, ecosystem & architecture**

- Act as a platform reliability and architecture expert — contribute to failure-mode analysis, dependency mapping, and resilience design for multi-tenant container workloads.

- Evaluate and evolve the platform's tooling ecosystem (orchestration, runtime, networking, isolation, and observability stack) with a clear, opinionated view on trade-offs.

- Improve system architecture to reduce infrastructure cost while balancing security, reliability, and performance across tenants.

- Guide teams building on the platform to design sustainable on-call practices for their own services: alert quality, escalation paths, runbook coverage, and noise reduction.


#### **You Might Be a Good Fit If You**

- Have 5+ years in platform engineering, container/Kubernetes platform operations, SRE, or production infrastructure, and have operated production systems at scale and carried on-call for them.

- Are genuinely deep in at least one — ideally two — of the three strength areas below (and tell us which is your center of gravity):

- **Tooling & ecosystem** — know the container/orchestration landscape well: Kubernetes, containerd and the OCI/CRI standards, and the surrounding CNCF ecosystem (e.g. Argo CD/Argo Rollouts for GitOps and progressive delivery; Cilium/eBPF networking and the Gateway API; Karpenter/KEDA-style autoscaling; and workload-isolation runtimes such as gVisor or Kata Containers). You reason about trade-offs rather than reaching for defaults.

- **Software engineering** — write real production code (Go and/or a comparable systems language) and can build controllers, operators, and platform APIs — stepping back to the underlying problem and building the right solution when no off-the-shelf tool fits.

- **Operational / SRE practice** — are fluent in SLOs, error budgets, and operational KPIs; have led incident response and blameless postmortems; and have driven down MTTD/MTTR for systems you operated.

- Have worked with large-scale multi-tenant systems and understand isolation as a spectrum — from namespaces, RBAC, network policies, and resource quotas through to stronger primitives such as virtual clusters (e.g. vCluster) or VM-class runtimes.

- Operate confidently on AWS (multiple accounts, IAM, VPC) and are comfortable with infrastructure-as-code (Pulumi preferred; Terraform/CDK also fine) and Kubernetes.

- Script and automate to eliminate toil rather than absorb it.

- Communicate clearly with both infrastructure specialists and product engineers, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams.

- Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and iterating toward better systems over time.


**Nice to Have**

- Experience building and operating a multi-tenant Kubernetes platform that internal teams deploy onto.

- Familiarity with policy engines (Kyverno, or OPA/Gatekeeper) and cost-attribution tooling (OpenCost/Kubecost) for per-tenant chargeback/showback.

- Experience with managed database platforms or Postgres.

- Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, or similar observability tooling.


#### **What We Offer**

- **Fully Remote**

  We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- **ESOP**

  Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- **Tech Allowance**

  Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- **Health Benefits**

  Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- **Annual Off-Sites**

  Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- **Flexible Work**

  We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- **Professional Development**

  Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.


#### **About the Team**

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members


We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.
