jobs.title: Digital Marketing Lead, Programmatic & Media
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

Braze is looking for a programmatic and media buying lead to build and execute our programmatic display and media buying strategy. As a key member of our Global Digital Marketing team, you will work alongside colleagues based in diverse regions. Reporting to the Senior Director of Global Digital Marketing, this role will collaborate with cross-functional marketing teams to develop and execute display and media buys that are part of holistic, multifaceted global campaigns.

The role will be hands-on-keyboard executing programmatic campaigns and managing paid media buys across AMER, LATAM, EMEA, and APAC; you will be responsible for launching, optimizing, and reporting on display and media buy performance. Your primary focus will be generating pipeline and optimizing pipe-to-spend ratios through targeting optimizations, A/B split testing, vendor testings, and landing page optimizations.

The ideal candidate has experience running global programmatic display campaigns and buying global media (including OOH, Content Syndication, Dedicated emails, etc.). You operate with a data-driven mindset and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Responsibilities:

- Plan and purchase multiple types of paid media inventory: content syndication, dedicated emails, Out of Home (OOH), CTV, podcast ads, etc.
- Manage relationships with media partners, including DSPs, SSPs, and publishers. Negotiate favorable terms and stay informed about new opportunities and advertising solutions.
- Manage and optimize programmatic display campaigns efficiently using DV360, including audience targeting, bid strategies, creative assets, and real-time performance analysis to maximize ROI and reach the target audience effectively.
- Develop and manage the advertising strategy for the ABM programmatic display platform, Demandbase, to drive engagement with target accounts.
- Work within Google Tag Manager to efficiently manage and deploy essential tracking tags and ensure accurate data collection.
- Collaborate with the internal brand team on creative briefs for display and paid media deliverables. Collaborate with the content marketing team for new, diverse assets to put into market via paid media.

**WHO YOU ARE**

- Proven track record running global paid media campaigns with an emphasis on media buying and managing programmatic display across AMER, EMEA, LATAM, and APAC. Demonstrated ability to successfully manage localized programmatic display ads in international markets.
- **Publisher & Vendor Management:** Experience negotiating with and managing digital publishers globally.
- **DSP & Platform Expertise:** Experience using DV360, The Trade Desk, 6sense, Demandbase, or other programmatic DSPs.
- **Budget Management:** Experience managing six-figure quarterly budgets and making data-informed decisions on budget allocation based on performance metrics.
- **Creative Operations:** Experience managing creative production for display ads and paid media placements in partnership with brand and content teams.
- **Technical Skills:** Hands-on experience working with Google Tag Manager for tracking tags and data collection.
- **Key Soft Skills:** Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills with strong attention to detail; demonstrated critical thinking and decision-making skills to navigate obstacles and resolve issues quickly.
- B2B SaaS or prior agency experience is preferred.
- **Languages:** English & Portuguese fluency required; strong written and verbal English skills are essential. Spanish fluency is a plus. #LI-Hybrid

**WHAT WE OFFER**

_Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at [here](https://www.braze.com/company/careers/how-we-hire#benefit-section). More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment._

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

- Competitive compensation that may include equity
- Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
- Flexible paid time off
- Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
- Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
- Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
- A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
- Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
- Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
- Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

**ABOUT BRAZE**

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

jobs.title: Team Lead - LATAM
jobs.description:
**Purpose of Position**

The Sales Team Leader – Latam leads, coaches and develops Awin’s new business team across Brazil to deliver sustainable revenue growth. The role combines hands-on people leadership with pipeline oversight, forecasting discipline and sales performance management, while raising the team’s ability to win enterprise accounts and contributing to the regional commercial strategy

**Key Tasks**

- Lead, coach and develop the new business sales team to achieve and exceed revenue targets, embedding clear expectations, strong accountability and consistent performance management.
- Lead recruitment, onboarding and ongoing development of the team, building the capability to sell consultatively and win larger, more complex deals.
- Own team pipeline hygiene and forecasting discipline in Salesforce, ensuring opportunities, next steps, close dates and contracts pending signature are accurate, visible and actively managed.
- Provide regular coaching across the full sales cycle, including prospecting, qualification, discovery, proposal development, commercial negotiation, objection handling and deal closure.
- Monitor sales performance, pipeline health, conversion rates and activity levels, identifying risks, removing blockers and taking timely action to deliver against regional and team targets.
- Support the team in developing insight-led, relationship-driven approaches to prospective merchants across Latam, using market research, competitor intelligence and affiliate activity, and identifying opportunities beyond traditional CPA (e.g. influencer and private network models).
- Partner with Finance, Integrations, Client Services and other internal teams to ensure commercially sound deal structures and a smooth handover from signature through to integration, activation and revenue generation.
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of sales processes, playbooks, reporting standards and best practice, creating consistency in ways of working and supporting scalable growth.
- Act as an escalation point for complex commercial discussions, supporting senior stakeholder engagement, proposal quality, RFI/RFP responses and contractual alignment where required.
- Represent Awin at relevant industry events and external networks, in partnership with Marketing, to identify new commercial opportunities, build market insight and strengthen brand presence across the region

**Skills & Experience**

- Strong experience in commercial sales, new business development or business development roles, ideally within affiliate marketing, digital marketing, ecommerce, B2B marketplace or related technology-led industries.
- Demonstrable track record of achieving or exceeding new business sales targets, with experience managing complex sales cycles and commercially valuable opportunities.
- Prior experience leading, coaching or mentoring sales colleagues, with the ability to drive performance through clear expectations, feedback and structured development.
- Experience managing senior client conversations, commercial negotiations, proposals, RFIs/RFPs and contractual discussions in line with company standards and legal requirements.
- Strong understanding of digital performance channels, affiliate marketing principles and the commercial drivers that influence advertiser growth and network selection.
- Experience working cross-functionally with operational, finance, technical and client-facing teams to take new business from signature to successful launch and revenue generation

**Personal skills:**

- Highly commercial, proactive and target-driven, with the ability to translate strategy into clear team priorities and measurable action.
- Confident people leader with strong coaching skills, sound judgement and the ability to build trust, accountability and motivation within a sales team.
- Excellent communication, presentation and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at different levels of seniority.
- Resilient, organised and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, international environment while maintaining strong attention to detail.
- Collaborative team player who contributes constructively to shared goals, knowledge exchange and continuous improvement across the wider sales function.

**Professional qualifications:**

Relevant sales leadership, coaching, negotiation, digital marketing or affiliate marketing qualifications are advantageous but not essential.

**IT and technical skills:**

- Proficient in Salesforce.com or a comparable CRM and sales pipeline management tool, with the ability to monitor team performance, pipeline quality and forecasting accuracy.
- Advanced Microsoft Office skills, with the ability to prepare clear commercial proposals, pipeline updates, sales reporting and performance insights.
- Comfortable using sales intelligence, research and productivity tools to support prospecting, account planning, coaching and opportunity management.

**Language skills:**

Strong English language skills is required. Additional Spanish is advantageous

**Our Offer**

- **Flexi-Week**: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.

- **Flexi-Office**: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid working model, designed to foster collaboration, trust, and autonomy.

- **Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture**: You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace at home.

- **Meal Vouchers:** we offer you meal vouchers for lunch

- **Public Transportation**: you are entitled to a transportation voucher or card to commute to the office


_In addition, you’ll benefit from our global offering, including health and wellbeing initiatives, learning and development via Awin Academy, and peer-to-peer recognition programmes._

Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.

Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.

Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

Awin is part of the Axel Springer group.Learn more at [axelspringer.com/en/](https://www.axelspringer.com/en/), and explore the Axel Springer Essentials here: [axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why](https://www.axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why)

Apply now to begin the next stage of your career at a progressive company that supports both your professional and personal development.

jobs.description:
## **About the Role:**

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

09

**S&P Global Energy Commercial and CX Graduate Program**

**Role: Associate, Commercial and CX Graduate**

**The Location:** São Paulo

The S&P Global Energy Commercial and CX Graduate Program journey begins with an intensive 5-week onboarding in our London office.

The 3-months thereafter will be part of the EMEA Customer Success Team, focusing on building a foundational knowledge of the commodity markets, developing essential business-related skills while learning about various S&P Global Energy data, research and analytical products. With Customer Success, you would be a primary contact for clients, providing solutions to their requests in a timely, professional and courteous manner and providing training on S&P Global Energy products through virtual and onsite visits.

The program will consist of rotations to customer success, sales, channel management and marketing functions. This will enable each graduate to gain a holistic perspective of the business. Combined with on-the-job learning, graduates must complete and pass certification milestones along with a rigorous evaluation process that will test and stretch their skills and capabilities. As you progress though the program, you will have the opportunity to support the sales team and ultimately generate additional revenue that helps to grow our business.

You will be offered the opportunity to assist S&P Global Energy in achieving its mission of being one of the leading providers of the highest quality price assessments and analytical information to the world’s financial and commodity markets. Our real-time news, pricing and analytical services help markets operate with transparency and efficiency worldwide. As the principal provider of commodity price assessment and information to more than 10,000 customers in 150 countries and with 20 offices spanning five continents, you will form part of a truly globally diverse workforce. You will be part of a rapidly growing organization with an exceptional corporate culture. Our data, analytics, and research help our customers make informed, smarter business decisions and investments.

We are looking for high achievers from a diverse pool of current undergraduates or recent graduates who are passionate about the energy and commodities markets and want to develop their career in a dynamic, high performing and multicultural commercial team. You will be someone who can quickly work out how to make things happen through intellectual curiosity, creativity, exceptional learning agility and problem solving skills as well as effective networking and collaboration skills. Additionally, proficiency in Generative AI technologies and the ability to leverage these tools for innovative solutions will be highly valued.

**What’s in it for you:**

You will join as a member of a cohort of Commercial and CX Associates. Here, you will be introduced to world-class experts in various commodities including former chief economists, traders and risk managers. They will give presentations about how commodity markets work and provide insightful perspectives on global economic, political, technological and legal issues linked to their specializations. You will also be enrolled in an e-learning curriculum, providing foundational knowledge about the technical aspects of various commodities and market.

Within weeks you will have the opportunity to present topics to senior management and to get constructive feedback on your progress. Throughout the program you will learn how to use tools including S&P Global Energy-Platts, CERA and HORIZON products, Excel add-ins and CRM systems.

You will be challenged on a daily basis with a steep learning curve. You will get the opportunity to work with a broad range of clients including governments, investment banks, commodity trading houses, major oil and gas companies, hedge funds and industry and get to be part of a large energetic and international team with fantastic opportunities for growth.

**Career paths after the 18-month initial phase of the program include:**

- Regional Sales
- Specialist Sales
- Customer Success

**Responsibilities:**

- Help clients understand how to navigate and extract useful data from the S&P Global Energy product range.
- Liaise with the content, commercial and technical teams to address any client queries and ensure our data is maintained to the highest standards.
- Proactively reaching out to clients for face-to-face/virtual training (this will apply towards the later stages of development once fully fluent and certified on the product range).
- Conduct research about important issues at the forefront of energy and commodity markets and present this to colleagues.
- Support sales teams with research and proposals.
- Build account overviews and plans to support strategic sales teams.
- Design data-driven models and templates for clients.
- Create marketing materials for commercial culture initiatives and future graduate cohorts.
- Getting involved in special project initiatives where determined necessary by management.

**Requirements:**

- Ability to join a class of new hires in late February 2027
- Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in **Geology, Geophysics, Petroleum Engineering, Energy, or a related discipline**; postgraduate or Master’s degrees are also welcome.
- Academic, internship, research, or early-career exposure to the upstream energy sector, particularly oil and gas, geology, geophysics, exploration, or related areas.
- Recent graduate or early-career professional with up to approximately one year of professional experience.
- Fluent in Portuguese and English, with Spanish fluency strongly preferred for the São Paulo position.
- Genuine interest in energy, commodities, and financial/commodity markets, with an eagerness to build industry knowledge.
- Commercially minded and client-focused, with an interest in developing a career in Customer Success, Sales, or other commercial functions.
- Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence interacting with clients and presenting both virtually and in person.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn quickly, multitask, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
- Comfortable using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and interested in using technology and AI tools to solve business problems.
- Must have the right to work in Brazil.

**About S&P Global Energy**

At S&P Global Energy, our comprehensive view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make superior decisions and create long-term, sustainable value. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration.

S&P Global Energy is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global enables businesses, governments, and individuals with trusted data, expertise, and technology to make decisions with conviction. We are Advancing Essential Intelligence through world-leading benchmarks, data, and insights that customers need in order to plan confidently, act decisively, and thrive economically in a rapidly changing global landscape. Learn more at [www.spglobal.com/energy](http://www.spglobal.com/energy).

**What’s In It For** **You?**

**Our Mission:**

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

**Our People:**

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

**Our Values:**

**Integrity, Discovery, Partnership**

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

This isn't a "jack of all trades" environment. We hire people who are exceptional at what they do, then give them the resources and autonomy to do it well.

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for a Graphic Designer and Video Editor who creates with conversion in mind. You know that a beautiful email that doesn't get clicks isn't finished yet, and that a product page is a sales tool first. This is a hands-on role for someone who has spent real time designing for e-commerce brands — emails, landing pages, website sections, and social/ad creative — and can explain exactly why each design choice was made.

You'll design across a portfolio of e-commerce clients, working closely with our email, CRO, Shopify development, and paid media teams. You'll also use Claude and other AI tools as a real part of your workflow — to move faster on ideation, variations, and production, without sacrificing quality or brand consistency.

**This role starts part-time at 15 hours/week,** with real room to grow as your client roster and responsibilities expand.

#### What You'll Own

**Email & Retention Design**

- Design campaign and automated flow emails (newsletters, welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, etc.) that are on-brand and built to drive clicks and revenue
- Design mobile-first, with clear hierarchy, scannable layouts, and strong calls to action
- Prepare email-ready files and specs (image slicing, live text vs. image text, alt text, dark mode considerations) for clean builds in Klaviyo and other email platforms

**Web Creative & CRO Support**

- Design landing pages, homepage, and collection page sections, product page (PDP) modules, banners, and promotional assets for Shopify stores
- Partner with the CRO team to design test variations based on data, heatmaps, and hypotheses — not just personal taste
- Hand off dev-ready Figma files to our web developers, with desktop and mobile layouts, organized layers, and clear specs

**Social & Ad Creative**

- Design static social and paid ad creative for Meta, TikTok, and other channels
- Create ad variations and iterations to support creative testing
- Video editing for social and ad use (resizing, trimming, captions, simple motion) where needed

**Process & Quality**

- Follow each client's brand guidelines closely, and flag gaps or inconsistencies when guidelines are missing or unclear
- Apply design and e-commerce best practices (accessibility, contrast, legibility, load-friendly assets, platform specs)
- Present work with a clear rationale — why this layout, this hierarchy, this CTA — to internal teams and, when needed, clients
- Take feedback well, turn revisions around quickly, and keep work moving across multiple accounts and deadlines
- Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up concepting, copy-to-layout exploration, asset variations, and repetitive production tasks — while following client confidentiality and our AI use guidelines

#### Who You Are

Skills get you in the door. These are the qualities that make you right for this role:

- **An exceptional designer** with a strong eye for layout, typography, and color — your portfolio speaks for itself
- **Conversion-minded** — you think about what the customer needs to see, feel, and do next, not just what looks good
- **Detail-obsessed** — you catch the misaligned element, the off-brand color, and the typo before anyone else does
- **A clear communicator** who can explain the reasoning behind design choices and keeps the team updated without being chased
- **Excellent at managing your time** — you can juggle multiple clients and deadlines in a remote, async environment without dropping the ball
- **AI-curious and AI-capable** — you already use tools like Claude in your workflow and are excited to find new ways to work smarter
- **Adaptable** — you can shift between very different brand styles and still make each one feel right.

#### What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days:

- You've learned the brand guidelines and design systems for your assigned client accounts
- You're consistently delivering email, web, and social designs on time with minimal revision rounds
- You've handed off at least one web project or CRO test variation to our Shopify dev team with clean, dev-ready files
- You've built AI into your workflow in a way that measurably speeds up production
- Internal teams trust your work and your reasoning, and come to you with ideas, not just requests

jobs.title: Application Support Engineer I
jobs.description:
**Summary**

Are you passionate about customer success? Do you like digging into code, and have a drive to continuously learn and solve problems? Do you want to be part of a global team that provides the best customer service in the industry? If so, come join us at Guidewire!

At Guidewire, we make software that offers Property and Casualty (P&C) Insurance companies the tools to take care of their customers when they need it the most, whether that’s a time of crisis, a natural disaster, an accident, or exposure to cyber risks. We build the core applications that insurance companies use to sell and underwrite policies, settle claims, and bill their customers. We also have a portfolio of innovative products serving the needs of P&C insurance companies in areas such as data management, digital online portals, and predictive analytics. We serve hundreds of insurance providers all over the world, helping them handle billions of dollars of business.

We are proud to be voted a “Top 3” employer on Glassdoor by our own employees and positioned as a market leader by industry experts like Gartner. We have a fun work environment and a culture that lives by our core values of integrity, rationality, and collegiality.

We’re searching for people who are as passionate about working together to deliver quality products and support as we are. Join us and enjoy a career where you can make an impact. You’ll be inspired by those around you, and you’ll be trusted and empowered to go further.

The Application Support team is part of the Guidewire Global Support organization, delivering 24x7 service to customers who are using Guidewire software both in the Guidewire Cloud and on-premise.

As an Application Support Engineer you will learn everything there is to know about Guidewire’s products, and you’ll communicate and share that knowledge with Guidewire’s internal and external customers.

**Job Description**

#### What you’ll do

- Own the end-to-end troubleshooting and resolution of incoming support cases for Guidewire applications, from initial triage through root cause analysis, workaround, and final fix coordination.

- Investigate complex issues in customer cloud environments, including reviewing logs, configuration, integrations, and data, and collaborate with Product Development & Operations, Professional Services, and other experts when deeper changes are required.

- Communicate clearly and regularly with customers, providing accurate status updates, explaining technical concepts in accessible language, and managing expectations while incidents are in progress.

- Execute operational tasks to provision, rebuild, configure, and restore services in Guidewire Cloud environments, following established runbooks and quality, reliability, and security standards that support PDO’s operational excellence goals.

- Create and maintain high-quality knowledge articles, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides that capture learnings from incidents and enable faster self-service resolution for customers and internal teams.

- Monitor and manage incidents against contractual SLAs, ensuring timely escalation, cross-team coordination, and documentation that supports auditability and continuous service improvement.

- Identify patterns and opportunities to reduce incident volume and resolution time, feeding insights back into product, platform, and process enhancements that support PDO’s priorities around reliability, AI and cloud adoption, and measurable customer value.

- At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.


#### What you’ll bring

**Required**

- Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.

- Foundational experience in application or technical support, service operations, or software troubleshooting (this may include internships, academic projects, or equivalent practical experience).

- Solid understanding of web applications and basic concepts such as HTTP, REST APIs, databases, and logs, with the ability to debug issues across multiple layers of a stack.

- Familiarity with at least one scripting or programming language (for example: Java, Python, JavaScript, or similar) and a willingness to deepen your technical skills.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured approach to isolating issues and proposing pragmatic workarounds or solutions.

- Clear written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to translate technical findings into customer-friendly explanations.

- Growth mindset and curiosity to learn Guidewire products, the P&C insurance domain, and modern cloud technologies.

- Reliable teamwork and collaboration skills, including openness to feedback, knowledge sharing, and working across global, cross-functional teams.


**Preferred**

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

- Experience supporting SaaS or cloud-hosted applications (for example, working with AWS, Kubernetes, or similar environments).

- Exposure to IT service management concepts (e.g., incident, problem, and change management) and working with ticketing tools.

- Familiarity with observability or monitoring tools (logs, metrics, traces) and how they are used in incident investigation.

- Experience creating technical documentation, FAQs, or knowledge base content for internal or external audiences.


#### Your Impact

We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first months, you’ll complete a structured onboarding, learn how Guidewire’s cloud platform and core applications support P&C insurers, and shadow experienced engineers on real customer cases to build confidence in our tools, processes, and communication standards.

By six months, you’ll independently handle a portfolio of support cases, consistently meeting SLAs, contributing knowledge articles, and using AI-assisted diagnostics to shorten investigation and resolution times in line with PDO’s goals for operational excellence and GenAI adoption.

Your work will help ensure every customer is successful and referenceable, directly supporting Guidewire’s mission to transform the way insurers operate and enabling our product teams to focus on the next wave of AI-, cloud-, and data-driven innovation.

#### What’s in it for you

The people we employ give their all, and in return, we offer flexibility wherever we can, such as:

- Flexible work environment

- Health and wellness benefits

- Paid time off programs including volunteer time off

- Market-competitive pay and incentive programs

- Continual development and internal career growth opportunities


**About Guidewire**

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC.

Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

Guidewire is proud to be a disability inclusive employer. We are committed to providing individualized accommodations and support to candidates for any part of our hiring process. If you think you may need disability-related accommodations, please email EmployAbility at accommodations-gw@employ-ability.org.uk, our disability partner, or [schedule a call with an EmployAbility expert](https://calendar.app.google/Pz47ZoQHihFTJugX8) (calendar booking slot) for a confidential conversation.

jobs.title: Customer Support Analyst (CX)
jobs.description:
**Your well-being, our mission. Join a company that makes the world healthier.**

**GET TO KNOW US**

We are revolutionizing corporate well-being. Our platform connects employees around the world with the best partners in physical exercise, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition and sleep routines – all in one subscription. Based in New York with teams in Europe, North America and South America, our mission is to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be rewarding, inspiring and balanced. Here, you will find a team that values well-being, collaboration and diverse perspectives, in a place where passion and creativity break barriers to create real impact. Your contributions will help build a healthier world, for you and millions of people globally.

**Why do we have affirmative action positions?**

This is an affirmative action position for **People with Disabilities.**

Because we believe in fostering diversity and nurturing an inclusive work environment, where everyone has access to equitable opportunities and can reach their full potential.

To achieve our mission, it is essential that diverse perspectives exist here and that all people feel welcomed, valued and empowered at Wellhub.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We are hiring a **Customer Support Analyst (CX)** to join our **Customer Experience** team in **São Paulo!**

**YOUR IMPACT**

- Ensure customer satisfaction by managing daily communications across service channels (email, chat, phone).
- Provide accurate and complete solutions to questions and requests, using established tools and processes.
- Build trusting relationships through empathetic, clear and objective communication, researching customer history and data to achieve the best resolution.
- Manage and update records in the system/CRM accurately, promptly categorizing tickets and following up on pending items until final resolution.
- Follow all operational processes and guidelines, proactively escalating recurring or critical issues to leadership.
- Meet individual and team goals on quality and productivity indicators, collaborating with different areas to support operations.
- Handle additional daily operational routines of the area, such as processing requests and day-to-day approvals.
- Maintain a consistent standard of excellence, empathy and courtesy in all contacts.
- Commit to the training and development received to stay up to date on products and processes.
- Live the mission: inspire and empower Wellhubbers by prioritizing your own well-being and that of your colleagues. Be part of a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off and finding a balance between work and personal life.

**WHO YOU ARE**

- Live in São Paulo.
- High school diploma or technical education. Higher education will be considered a plus.
- Prior knowledge of CRM platforms (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce or similar) and familiarity with tracking/metrics tools.
- Excellent written communication, good grammar and ease with digital tools/IT.
- Knowledge of productivity tools (Google Workspace or Microsoft Office) is a plus.
- Prior experience in customer service (CX), multichannel work and text/chat support.
- Native Portuguese. Intermediate or advanced English will be a plus.

Even if you don't meet 100% of the requirements, apply! We would be delighted to receive your application and assess your fit with our team.

**WHAT WE OFFER YOU**

We create a work environment for you to thrive in every dimension of your life. We do this through well-designed benefits, resources for emotional well-being and a culture that empowers each person to truly connect with their role here and take ownership of it, balancing this with their own well-being.

Our flexible benefits program helps you customize them according to your needs!

**Our benefits include:**

**WELLHUB:** Free Gold+ plan, with access to thousands of gyms and studios, digital fitness programs and online resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, sleep routines and more. You can also add up to 3 family members to your plan, ensuring that those who matter most to you have access to well-being.

**WELLZ:** A unique and comprehensive resource for mental well-being. Wellz offers personalized journeys that combine weekly cognitive-behavioral therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

**HEALTH AND CARE:** Health insurance, dental plan and life insurance.

**FLEXIBLE WORK:** With a work arrangement that prioritizes flexibility, we offer hybrid and remote positions so you have the freedom to work the way that suits you best. The work model for this specific position can be discussed with the recruiter and leadership. When you join Wellhub, you can also use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office!

**PAID REST:** Disconnecting and recharging is very important. That's why we offer vacation after 6 months of work + 3 days off per year + 1 day off each year at the company (up to 5 days in total) + 1 day off in the month of your birthday!

**FULLY PAID PARENTAL LEAVE:** Welcoming a new family member is one of life's most special moments. We want every employee to be truly present and enjoy this time with family. That's why we offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Those who give birth are also entitled to extended leave (Citizen Company program) and a ramp-back period, during which they can work part-time until they adjust to the new routine.

**PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT:** Get access to learning platforms (including language learning), take part in interactive sessions and explore our internal opportunities. During your internship, you will also develop a project of your own, based on your area and specialties, and have a mentor to help you during your internship. At Wellhub, we focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your path toward success – both personally and professionally.

**CULTURE:** You will join a team of dedicated people who come together to break barriers, support one another and create lasting impact in corporate well-being. We win together, cultivating relationships of trust through transparent communication and a culture where every perspective matters. [Learn more about our values and culture.](https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/our-values/)

**Want to see what it's really like to work here? Follow us on** [**Instagram**](https://www.instagram.com/lifeatwellhub/) **@lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on** [**YouTube**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZgIPiszTVm4) **!**

**Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging @ Wellhub**

We seek to create a collaborative, welcoming and inclusive environment where everyone feels they belong.

Wellhub is an employer committed to promoting equitable opportunities. All qualified applicants will be considered equally, without discrimination based on race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by applicable law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and compensate our people. We are proud to be a Syndio Fair Pay Certified company, a certification that reflects our ongoing dedication to fair and equitable pay practices across our global team. [Read more here.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/wellhub_fairpay-syndio-activity-7407826561531363328-wbN_?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAAzHQWABKsRqcpvxy4QpDCJNe_szRdC4hgY)

Questions about how we handle your personal data? [Consult our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.](https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/job-applicant-privacy-notice/#:~:text=Aviso%20de%20Privacidade%20para%20Candidatos)

jobs.description:
**Purpose of Position**

AdOps Interns provide operational support to Client Services (CS) teams and are focused on supporting the delivery of our service packages. It is an entry-level position which provides an ideal first step into the affiliate marketing industry. AdOps Interns work across a wide range of sectors and industries by leveraging our award-winning Awin network.

An ideal first step into the industry, the role will help you understand what goes into creating a leading affiliate programme and how Awin helps facilitate that. Awinners will have the opportunity to apply for other departmental roles within the business (if experience, suitability, skillset and location requirements are met).

**Key Tasks**

Work alongside the CS team to provide support to some of the network's largest clients in line with some of the following tasks:

- Upload offers and creates advertisement programs and assists with communicating details to publisher partners.
- Maintain and update internal documentation, operational processes, and support materials to ensure accuracy and consistency.
- Support automation initiatives and contribute to projects focused on improving operational efficiency and scalability.
-  Collaborate with Account Management, Publisher Development, and Client Services teams to support client requests and deliver operational excellence.
-  Assist in reviewing, approving, and rejecting publisher applications within advertiser programs, as well as conducting program audits to ensure compliance with network standards and best practices.
-  Demonstrate ownership and a proactive approach to assigned accounts and responsibilities, identifying potential issues and escalating them appropriately when needed.
-  Build and maintain effective communication with clients, publishers, vendors, and internal stakeholders through email, phone, WhatsApp, Telegram, live chat, and other communication channels.
-  Support day-to-day operational activities while ensuring high levels of accuracy, attention to detail, and adherence to established processes.
-  Contribute to a collaborative team environment by actively sharing knowledge, providing support to colleagues, and continuously seeking opportunities for improvement.

**Skills & Expertise**

- Ability to always be proactive with internal team members with a willingness to help peers and pick up additional tasks to share workload.
- Ability to prioritise workload and meet multiple client deadlines
- Familiarity with MS Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint, is an advantage
- Show impeccable attention to detail for internal and external facing work
- Demonstrate a proactive approach to improving efficiency and quality of work
- Take charge of individual responsibilities and arrange appropriate cover for time off

**Skill Growth & Tools Exposure:**

Gain hands-on experience with leading tools in the corporate and digital industry landscape such as Salesforce, Power BI, Tableau, Power Automate, Asana, Affiliate network. Boosting your technical expertise and staying up-to-date with current market demands.

**Our Offer**

- **Flexi-Week**: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.

- **Flexi-Office**: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid working model, designed to foster collaboration, trust, and autonomy.

- **Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture**: You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace at home.

- **Meal Vouchers:** we offer you meal vouchers for lunch

- **Public Transportation**: you are entitled to a transportation voucher or card to commute to the office


_In addition, you’ll benefit from our global offering, including health and wellbeing initiatives, learning and development via Awin Academy, and peer-to-peer recognition programmes._

Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.

Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.

Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

Awin is part of the Axel Springer group.Learn more at [axelspringer.com/en/](https://www.axelspringer.com/en/), and explore the Axel Springer Essentials here: [axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why](https://www.axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why)

jobs.title: Senior Integrated Campaign Manager
jobs.description:
### **✨ One platform, a whole world of opportunity**

The best jobs have always clustered in a handful of the world's wealthiest cities. But talent is everywhere. Oyster set out to close that gap - building a global employment platform that lets companies hire, pay, and care for brilliant people anywhere.

We're proof that a high-performing culture doesn't need an office. Distributed across 60+ countries since 2020, we've built something the industry keeps noticing:

- Ranked **#10 of 250** on TIME and Statista's 2026 list of [America's Top WorkTech Companies](https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-hr-named-10-of-americas-top-worktech-companies-of-2026-by-time)

- Named one of [America's Greatest Startup Workplaces 2026](https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-2026-newsweek-award) by Newsweek

- A [G2 Spring 2026 Leader](https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-named-best-roi-for-any-global-employment-platform-for-g2-spring-2026) across Employer of Record, Global Employment, Multi-country Payroll, and HR Compliance

- The only **B Corp-certified** global employment platform ~ independently verified since 2023


Two of those rankings measured our business impact from the outside. One measured how our own people feel about working here. They landed in the same place ~ because at Oyster, culture and performance aren't separate conversations. They're the same one.

And we're just getting started. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who care as much as you do, we'd love for you to apply.

### The Role

**Location:** While this position is posted in a specific location, all of Oyster’s positions are fully remote and you can work from home. Forever. To create the best experience for our new hire, this role requires you to be based within UTC−6 to UTC+3.

**Role Summary**

Oyster is hiring an Integrated Campaign Manager to lead the planning and execution of integrated growth campaigns for global prospective customers, turning target accounts into pipeline and accelerating open opportunities. Reporting to the Director of Demand Generation and Growth Marketing, you'll partner closely with our Product Marketing, Brand, Digital, Events, Ops, and Sales teams to deliver one coherent buyer journey across every channel.

This is a role for a marketer who wants their work measured in pipeline, not page views. You’ll own Oyster’s integrated campaigns end to end. Deciding the strategy, the channel mix and the spend, and you’ll see directly how your work drives revenue. You’ll sit at the centre of Marketing and Sales, with the scope to shape how we reach companies hiring across borders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Demand Generation & Campaign Execution**

- Develop, execute and optimize multi-channel demand generation campaigns. Including content syndication, webinars, virtual events, email nurtures, direct mail, referral programs, and demo programs: to drive net-new pipeline and accelerate open opportunities.

- Build quarterly campaign plans that balance always-on programs with high-impact moments for the full prospect lifecycle, modeled backward from pipeline goals to determine program mix and spend.

- Partner with Product Marketing and Brand to turn positioning into campaign messaging, offers, and content that is tested and refined based on results.

- Build campaign enablement (talk tracks, email templates, one-pagers) and align with BDRs on follow-up expectations so campaign interest converts into meetings.

- Manage timelines, budget, and resources to ensure successful campaign delivery with ROI accountability.


**Cross-Functional Partnership & Continuous Improvement**

- Partner closely with stakeholders in marketing, sales, operations and external vendors to ensure consistent, aligned campaign execution across the business.

- Optimize campaigns and refine strategies based on data-driven results, including A/B testing and performance reporting.

- Identify opportunities to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve research, segmentation, personalization, campaign development, content distribution, analysis, and execution.

- Facilitate retrospectives and turn performance findings into optimized campaigns and repeatable playbooks.


**Core Requirements**

- 6+ years in B2B integrated or demand generation marketing, including substantial ownership of demand generation, integrated campaigns, growth marketing, or account-based marketing.

- A track record of building campaigns that tie directly to pipeline coverage and revenue outcomes, not just engagement metrics.

- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Data-driven, with working knowledge of attribution and pipeline measurement.

- Hands-on experience using AI tools for campaign planning, content acceleration, or workflow automation.

- Experience with Salesforce and HubSpot, or equivalent CRM/MAP platforms.

- Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting strategy and results to senior stakeholders.


**You'll also need**

- A reliable home internet connection and fluency in both written and spoken English.


### **How we work together at Oyster**

Our values guide the work we do, the decisions we make, and the culture that makes Oyster what it is. We make it happen—progress is our default setting. We drive change, we build and give trust, and we move as one united team.

Our mission is to create a more equal world of work: helping companies everywhere hire, pay, and care for talent anywhere. Everything we do ladders up to our mission. We embrace asynchronous, collaborative work and share how we operate in the [Oyster Public HQ](https://oysterhr.notion.site/Welcome-to-The-Reef-Oyster-s-Open-Source-Employee-Guide-fc482e3f107c4afd8c85ed217f1d0c1d) so other global teams can learn from us.

### **How YOU work**

With diverse locations, cultures, and needs, we created [How YOU Work;](https://oysterhr.notion.site/How-YOU-work-ac16c1932e314ffd8cb693e332458395) a program supporting your whole human experience at Oyster:

- **Work from anywhere:** Oyster has no borders or HQ. As long as work is timely, your team is supported, and you're authorized to work where you live, you can work from anywhere.

- **Paid time off:** Enjoy 40 days off per year (including holidays and vacation), or more if required by your country.

- **Mental health support:** Access [Plumm](https://oysterhr.notion.site/Plumm-3b5e7e70dec6428e975f68f25972cfb7), our mental well-being service.

- **Wellbeing allowance:** Each month, receive a wellbeing allowance in your ThanksBen wallet to spend on a wide range of options.

- **Flexible parental leave:** All new parents are eligible for at least three months’ paid leave, with job protection for up to 12 months or as required locally.

- **WFH stipend:** Receive a stipend for your laptop and home office equipment to get you set up quickly.


### **✨ The best jobs should be available to everyone**

We embrace diverse perspectives and intentionally build our product and company with an inclusive, global mindset. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every criterion, and are committed to a trust-based, thriving environment.

Oyster is committed to ensuring equal opportunity of employment for qualified persons with disabilities and actively fosters an inclusive work environment. If you require reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process, please email [jobs@oysterhr.com](mailto:jobs@oysterhr.com) with the subject line: Interview Accommodations.

Our available positions are on our careers page. Our team will only contact you from an @ _oysterhr.com_ email, and **we will never ask for money as part of an interview process or job offer.** If you receive a suspicious email about Oyster jobs or are directed to a site other than [www.oysterhr.com/careers](http://www.oysterhr.com/careers), please report it via our [Compliance and Ethics Helpline](https://faceup.com/c/8tpzyyye).

jobs.title: Partner Account Director
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

As Regional Partner Account Director for LATAM, you will own the regional amplification of Braze’s global platinum partner strategy across every platinum-tier partner active in the region (Deloitte, WPP, Publicis, Merkle, and future platinum partners). Reporting to the AVP of Delivery, you will take the global account plan set by each Global Partner Account Director (GPAD) and adapt it locally across LATAM’s markets. You will collaborate closely with GPADs, the AVP of Partner Sales for AMER, and regional Partner Sales Managers.

Key responsibilities:

- **Regional Platinum Coverage:** Serve as the senior Braze relationship owner for every platinum-tier delivery partner operating in LATAM.
- **Amplifying the Global Account Plan:** Translate global partner strategies into execution across LATAM markets (Brazil, Mexico, Southern Cone, and Andean markets), identifying key regional practice leads, market priorities, and local delivery capability gaps.
- **Certification & Delivery Quality:** Work with Partner Services and Global Learning & Enablement to ensure LATAM-based consultants are certified and that Partner-Led Delivery engagements maintain high quality standards.
- **Pipeline Activation:** Partner with the AVP, Partner Sales and Partner Sales Managers to integrate the right platinum partner into regional sales opportunities.
- **Feedback to Global Strategy:** Surface regional market dynamics, delivery friction, and resource needs to GPADs to ensure global account plans accurately reflect LATAM considerations.
- **Regional Escalation Management:** Act as the first line of escalation for platinum partner issues in LATAM, resolving regional matters locally and escalating global decisions appropriately.
- **Pipeline Visibility & Performance Tracking:** Utilize Salesforce, Crossbeam, and Clari to track platinum partner performance across LATAM and contribute to global reporting.

**WHO YOU ARE**

- Proven track record in partner sales, alliances, or SI/agency ecosystem roles in B2B SaaS, with direct experience managing senior relationships with global SIs or agency holding companies (Deloitte, Accenture, WPP, Publicis, Merkle or equivalent) at a regional level.
- **Execution & Regional Judgement:** Comfortable executing global strategies while making critical regional judgement calls tailored to local markets.
- **Enablement & Delivery Standards:** Experience with partner certification, enablement, or practice-quality models, with a clear view of delivery quality and capability.
- **Matrix Collaboration:** Skilled at operating effectively in a matrix environment, collaborating across central Delivery leadership and regional Partner Sales teams.
- **Ecosystem Expertise:** Deep knowledge of MarTech or adjacent SaaS ecosystems, with a strategic view on how composable tech stacks create delivery opportunities for SIs and agencies.
- **Technical & Mapping Tools:** Proficient in using account mapping tools such as Crossbeam or equivalent to track regional partner engagement, as well as CRM/reporting tools (Salesforce, Clari).
- **Languages:** Business-level fluency in English is required; fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is essential for regional execution.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

_Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at [here](https://www.braze.com/company/careers/how-we-hire#benefit-section). More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment._

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

- Competitive compensation that may include equity
- Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
- Flexible paid time off
- Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
- Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
- Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
- A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
- Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
- Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
- Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

**ABOUT BRAZE**

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

**BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

**OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS**

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.

This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

Depending on where you are located, you may have certain rights available to you in relation to Braze’s use of AI:

- To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” at the end of the application form below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application.
- To exercise other types of rights, such as rights to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to request a **retroactive** manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision, please contact us at [talentdata.privacy@braze.com](talentdata.privacy@braze.com).

Please contact us at [talentdata.privacy@braze.com](talentdata.privacy@braze.com) with any questions. To find out more about our hiring process, check out [this page](https://www.braze.com/company/careers/how-we-hire).

**Notice Regarding Automated Employment Decision Tool (NYC Local Law 144)**

Our use of AI during the application review process may include the use of automated employment decision tools. Pursuant to New York City Local Law 144, for roles based in New York City, or if you reside in New York City, you have the right to request an alternative selection process or a reasonable accommodation instead of AI-assisted review.

jobs.title: SDK Engineer - Python
jobs.description:
### **About Supabase**

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

### **About the Role**

We're looking for a **SDK Engineer - Python** to join our **SDK team** and own how developers talk to Supabase from Python. You'll work closely with the rest of the SDK team, our Auth, Realtime, Storage, PostgREST, Functions, CLI and Docs teams, and the open-source community, helping us make the Python SDK a library Python developers genuinely enjoy using.

Python developers reach Supabase from backend services, data pipelines, notebooks, and a growing number of AI agents and agent frameworks. The Python SDK is how all of them talk to the platform: database queries, auth, storage, realtime and edge functions, in both sync and async flavors.

This is a library-authoring role, and the work happens in the open: public repos, public issue trackers, and API decisions whose consequences last for years. If you get satisfaction from a type checker that catches the bug before your users do, from an async client that cleans up after itself, and from an issue tracker that isn't a graveyard, you'll like it here.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

### What You'll Be Responsible For

- **Build and evolve our Python SDK** across database, auth, storage, realtime and functions, with both sync and async APIs that feel natural in Python.

- **Start new things.** Alongside the maintenance work, find what's missing, make the case for it, and build it. Nobody will hand you the list.

- **Work in the open.** Triage inbound issues, review and shepherd outside contributions, keep CI and release automation healthy, and hold a clear, kind line on scope.

- **Own the typing experience.** Make the SDK fully typed and checker-friendly, so autocomplete and static analysis stay correct in real codebases.

- **Keep us honest across environments.** Multiple Python versions, sync and async frameworks, workers, serverless and notebooks — with dependency ranges that don't fight our users' projects. Test it, don't assume it.

- **Work on realtime.** Long-lived websocket connections, reconnection, and subscription and presence semantics.

- **Track the platform.** When auth, realtime, storage, postgrest or edge functions ship a change, make sure the SDK reflects it, and that we say so in the changelog.

- **Design in public.** Write the RFCs, migration guides, release notes and docs. Treat a breaking change as a deprecation path plus a migration story, not a version bump.

- **Make our SDK legible to AI coding agents**, which are now a major consumer of it.


### **You Might Be a Good Fit If You**

- **Know modern Python typing deeply.** You use generics, protocols, overloads and `TypedDict` as design tools, run strict type checking, and fix type errors without reaching for `Any`.

- **Have authored or maintained a published library** with a public API and users outside your own company. You know what it costs to change something people depend on.

- **Know the maintainer side of open source.** Issue triage at volume, reviewing outside PRs, release automation, changelogs and semver, security reports, and saying no to a feature request without losing the person who asked.

- **Are fluent in asyncio** and have opinions on how a library should serve both sync and async callers.

- **Know Python packaging** for libraries: `pyproject.toml`, wheels, modern tooling, version support policy, and why libraries shouldn't pin their dependencies tightly.

- **Test as a habit:** unit, type-level and end-to-end against a real stack. Every fix comes with a regression test.

- **Write well.** Design docs, changelogs and issue replies are a large part of the output here, much of it public, and we're async by default.

- **Have real autonomy:** you find the important work, scope it, ship it, and say what you didn't do.

- Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences

- Have experience in async or globally distributed teams

- Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers

- Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly


**Bonus points if you:** have run a major-version migration for a public package, know your way around JWT/OAuth, have built integrations for AI agent frameworks, or have generated idiomatic clients from a schema.

#### **What We Offer**

- **Fully Remote**

  We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- **ESOP**

  Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- **Tech Allowance**

  Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- **Health Benefits**

  Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- **Annual Off-Sites**

  Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- **Flexible Work**

  We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- **Professional Development**

  Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.


#### **About the Team**

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members


We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer (DST)
jobs.description:
#### About Logos (λ)

[Logos (λ)](https://logos.co/) is a movement of technologists, creatives, strategists, and activists working together to build a sovereign, people-owned technology stack that revitalises civil society and protects digital liberties at scale.

This position is within the IFT Technical Services (IFT-TS) Distributed Systems Testing (DST) Team, a team that primarily supports Logos, while also contributing to other IFT projects.

#### The role

We are seeking an experienced Distributed Systems Evaluation Engineer to join the Institute of Free Technology - Technical Services, on the Distributed Systems Testing (IFT-TS DST) team. This role focuses on rigorously assessing the performance and reliability of IFT projects at scale, where Logos (λ) is one of them.

Logos (λ) technology stack is composed of 3 main components:

- **Logos (λ) Blockchain**: Advanced privacy for a new era of decentralised applications and social institutions.
- **Logos (λ) Messaging**: Private peer‑to‑peer communication that resists surveillance and censorship.
- **Logos (λ) Storage**: Secure decentralised storage enabling fully decentralised apps and file sharing.

We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic DevOps Engineer to join our Distributed Systems Testing (DST) team.

You’ll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive evaluation strategies, leveraging both large-scale lab deployments and protocol behavior modeling scripts. Your expertise will be crucial in analyzing these complex distributed systems, automating intricate test scenarios, and providing in-depth insights into system behaviors.

Working closely with cross-functional teams, you’ll troubleshoot complex issues and translate technical data into actionable recommendations. Proficiency in containerization, cloud technologies, and distributed systems principles is essential.

#### Key responsibilities

- Design, configure, and optimize Kubernetes clusters to support large-scale experiments and benchmarks of P2P technologies.
- Continuously improve cluster scalability and resource utilization, enabling increasingly complex deployments and experiments.
- Set up, maintain, and optimize supporting infrastructure such as monitoring, logging, and observability stacks (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, etc.).
- Collaborate with DST researchers and engineers to streamline experimentation workflows and make analysis easier and more reproducible.
- Automate infrastructure and deployment workflows to increase reliability and reduce overhead.
- Troubleshoot, profile, and tune distributed workloads to ensure accurate and performant benchmarking.
- Identify, reproduce, and debug complex issues in distributed systems, working closely with Logos development teams.

#### You ideally will have

- Strong experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration in production or research environments.
- Hands-on experience with libp2p/gossipsub
- Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure, Linux systems, and networking (especially relevant to distributed/P2P systems).
- Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Grafana, Prometheus, VictoriaLogs, etc.).
- Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible, Helm, etc.).
- Proficiency in at least one scripting/programming language (ideally Python).
- Interest in or experience with distributed systems, P2P networks, or blockchain technologies.
- Experience with networks and systems programming.
- Excellent written and conversational communication skills.
- Alignment with our core values and principles.

#### Bonus points

- Hands-on experience with projects in the Logos collective.
- Background in performance benchmarking, scalability testing, or systems research.
- Contributions to open source projects.
- Experience working for an open-source organization.

#### Interview Process

- Interview with our POps team
- Interview with team member from the IFT-TS DST team
- Pair programming & discussion of results
- Interview with IFT-TS team lead
