jobs.title: Platform Engineer - Compute
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

We are seeking a platform engineer to join our Compute team. This team owns the critical systems that power project provisioning, scaling, and the compute that our users rely on every day.

You’ll work on the core platform that ensures Supabase can seamlessly scale

across multiple regions, handle high-volume workloads, and provide

low-latency, highly available compute services.

You'll design, build, and operate systems that are both robust and highly

automated — enabling us to provision new projects reliably at scale,

optimize resource utilization, and deliver a seamless experience to the

millions of databases which we manage.

#### What You’ll Be Responsible For:

- Help build and maintain the Supabase Cloud offering;

- Design and implement systems to provision, scale, and manage the multi-region compute workloads powering Supabase projects;

- Own the full lifecycle of compute orchestration: project creation, warm pools, autoscaling, resizing, and resource optimization;

- Improve automation and observability across the compute stack to ensure high availability and performance;

- Improve our system architecture to reduce costs while balancing security, reliability, and performance;

- Collaborate cross-functionally with other teams to help leverage compute as a core platform offering;

- Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-incident reviews;

- Resolve escalated support issues, while also identifying and resolving systemic issues across the platform.


#### You Might Be A Good Fit If You:

- Have strong software engineering skills (Go and Typescript required);

- Experience building and operating cloud infrastructure or distributed systems at scale;

- Have 5+ years experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS required, additional experience with GCP and Azure is a plus) - particularly compute, networking, and storage services;

- Have 3+ years experience working with building custom Kubernetes controllers, and operating large-scale (tens-to-hundreds of thousands of pods) clusters;

- Are knowledgable about networking and multi-region infrastructure design;

- Are familiar with Postgres;

- Have experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (Pulumi highly preferred, Terraform/CDK etc acceptable)

- Have experience working with QEMU, KVM, and NAS is a plus;

- Have experience with being part of on-call rotations for large production system;


#### **What We Offer**

- **Fully Remote**

  We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- **ESOP**

  Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- **Tech Allowance**

  Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- **Health Benefits**

  Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- **Annual Off-Sites**

  Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- **Flexible Work**

  We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- **Professional Development**

  Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.


#### **About the Team**

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members


We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

We operate in diverse markets, such as financial services, healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, among others. Experian invests in people and in new advanced technologies to unleash the power of data. We have an incredible team of 25,200 employees in 32 countries.

Our uniqueness is valuing yours. Experian's culture, centered on people, inclusive and driven by purpose, is recognized by various awards — including World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25) and Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries, among others. Check out Experian Life on social media or explore our careers site to understand why. Experian also takes pride in being an employer that promotes equal opportunity and affirmative action.

#### Job Description

- Design, develop, evolve and sustain backend services in Python with a focus on scalability and high availability
- Define the architecture and technical standards for APIs, integrations and internal tools of the credit marketplace

- Solid experience as a backend developer in large-scale production environments

- Advanced experience in designing, developing and consuming REST APIs
- Deep knowledge of relational and non-relational databases, including modeling and query optimization
- Mastery of Git, branching strategies and versioning best practices
- Established experience with automated testing (unit, integration and contract) and TDD
- Autonomy to lead high-complexity demands end to end

- Experience with GitLab CI/CD and pipeline automation

jobs.title: Software Architect, InsuranceSuite Practice
jobs.description:
**Summary**

Guidewire’s Professional Services InsuranceSuite Practice partners with P&C insurers across the Americas to implement our cloud, digital, and core applications so they can modernize, scale, and serve their customers with confidence.

As an Architect in the InsuranceSuite Practice based in LATAM, you will act as a lead technical authority on complex InsuranceSuite implementations, combining deep product expertise with hands-on design and technical leadership across architecture, integration, performance, and cloud delivery. You’ll work closely with customers, partners, and internal teams across LATAM to define implementation patterns, reduce delivery risk and effort, and drive measurable business value from Guidewire’s platform.

**Job Description**

#### What you’ll do

- Lead end-to-end solution and technical architecture for complex Guidewire InsuranceSuite programs (PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, ClaimCenter) in LATAM, from inception through go-live and stabilization.
- Translate customer business requirements into scalable, maintainable implementation designs spanning configuration, integration, data, and cloud operations.
- Own critical design decisions (data model, integration patterns, performance and resiliency approaches, extensibility) and ensure alignment with Guidewire best practices and reference architectures.
- Guide and review detailed technical designs, configuration approaches, and integration specifications produced by project teams and partners, ensuring consistency and quality.
- Provide hands-on technical leadership: troubleshoot complex issues across application, integration, and data layers; perform design and code reviews; mentor consultants.
- Define and champion reusable patterns, accelerators, and implementation best practices that reduce effort and improve quality across InsuranceSuite implementations in the region.
- Collaborate with Product, R&D, and Cloud teams to provide field feedback, influence roadmap, and align customer solutions with Guidewire Cloud Platform capabilities.
- Proactively manage technical risks and non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, resilience, security) throughout the delivery lifecycle.
- Contribute to estimation, scoping, and planning for proposals and delivery engagements, including effort, risk, and dependency assessment.
- Act as a trusted advisor to customer and partner technical leaders, facilitating architecture workshops and clearly documenting decisions and rationale.

#### What you’ll bring

Required

- Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and data-driven insights to improve how you design, build, and troubleshoot complex systems.
- 10+ years of experience in enterprise software implementation or architecture, including several large-scale transformation or core system projects.
- 2+ years of hands-on Guidewire InsuranceSuite implementation experience (PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, ClaimCenter), including configuration and integration is a plus.
- Strong expertise in at least one of: Gosu, Java, or similar object-oriented languages, plus solid understanding of REST/SOAP integrations, messaging, and batch processing.
- Proven experience designing end-to-end architectures covering configuration, integrations, data migration considerations, and non-functional requirements.
- Experience working with cloud platforms (ideally Guidewire Cloud Platform, AWS or Azure), including environments, deployments, and operational concerns.
- Strong understanding of P&C insurance concepts (policy, billing, claims) and how they map into InsuranceSuite.
- Excellent communication and consulting skills: able to lead technical workshops, explain trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, and document decisions clearly.
- Experience working in Agile/Scrum or hybrid delivery environments on distributed teams.
- Advanced English communication skills (written and spoken); ability to collaborate effectively with global stakeholders.
- Based in Brazil with the ability to work remotely and align to LATAM customer time zones; occasional travel for customer or internal workshops as needed.
- Spanish and Portuguese language skills in addition to English.

Preferred

- 4+ years of hands-on Guidewire InsuranceSuite implementation experience (PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, ClaimCenter), including configuration and integration.
- Prior experience in an Architect role on multi-year, multi-vendor core system or large program implementations.
- Guidewire certifications (InsuranceSuite, Integration, Cloud) and/or cloud certifications (AWS, Azure).
- Experience with performance tuning and scalability for InsuranceSuite (profiling, query optimization, batch performance, environment sizing).
- Experience defining and/or building reusable accelerators, frameworks, or tools for Guidewire implementations.
- Experience coaching and mentoring architects/consultants and providing feedback on design quality and implementation approaches.
- Exposure to AI-assisted development, knowledge tools, or automation to accelerate design, analysis, or troubleshooting.

#### Your impact

In your first 6–12 months, you will lead architecture for one or more strategic InsuranceSuite programs in LATAM, de-risking critical design decisions, improving solution quality, and accelerating time-to-value. Over time, your patterns, assets, and mentorship will uplift the broader InsuranceSuite Practice and partner ecosystem, directly supporting Professional Services’ goals of reducing implementation effort, scaling cloud adoption, and delivering measurable value for our customers.

**About Guidewire**

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC.

Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

Guidewire is proud to be a disability inclusive employer. We are committed to providing individualized accommodations and support to candidates for any part of our hiring process. If you think you may need disability-related accommodations, please email EmployAbility at accommodations-gw@employ-ability.org.uk, our disability partner, or [schedule a call with an EmployAbility expert](https://calendar.app.google/Pz47ZoQHihFTJugX8) (calendar booking slot) for a confidential conversation.

Always forward-thinking, this strategist keeps pace with industry trends, continuously integrating innovative tactics to elevate social commerce results.

**Responsibilities:**

- **Autonomous Workflow Capability:** Highly self-motivated and capable of working independently to develop, execute, and manage social media strategies while delivering exceptional results

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Growth
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.

We are a team of 600+ fully remote people in 60+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 250M+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community!

We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team.

##### **About the Role**

As a Senior Product Designer in Connect, you’ll lead the design of high-impact experiences for some of our most important and visible features like Home, Profile, Notifications, Widgets, Friends, Messages, Sharing, and more.

Your work will span cross-functionally where different features meet and overlap and you will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and other Product Designers to craft an engaging and cohesive experience across web, iOS, and Android for millions of players across the world.

You'll identify opportunities beyond the brief, and influence product and design decisions while helping raise the craft quality bar across the team.

##### **About You**

You’re an experienced Product Designer with strong visual craft, product judgment, and the confidence to influence how a product takes shape. You think beyond the feature in front of you, considering how decisions connect across product experiences. You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity and competing perspectives, present your thinking with clarity and composure, and help other designers improve through thoughtful critique.

You’re interested in how people connect and find joy in designing fun and healthy ways for them to build relationships and feel like part of a global community.

##### **What You’ll Do**

- Lead the end-to-end design of high-impact product experiences across Chess.com’s web, iOS, and Android apps, and deliver polished, production-ready UI designs.
- Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and other stakeholders to shape requirements, clarify ambiguity, and influence product and design direction.
- Design how players connect, socialize, and feel like they’re part of a global community on key features like Home, Profile, Friends, Messaging, Notifications, Leaderboards, and more.
- Think horizontally across features and the broader design system, identifying opportunities to improve consistency, usability, and quality across the product.
- Raise the craft bar through strong UI design, thoughtful interactions, and sound product judgment grounded in context, heuristics, and user insight.
- Proactively identify meaningful product opportunities beyond the immediate brief and help move them from idea to well-articulated design direction.
- Present your design proposals and clearly articulate your decisions, navigate differing perspectives, and help cross-functional partners align to reach strong decisions.
- Build and iterate on high-fidelity prototypes using our Design System, using tools like Cursor and Claude, to explore directions and accelerate decision making.
- Contribute to design critiques, provide constructive feedback to other Product Designers, and help strengthen the quality of the team’s work without direct people-management responsibility.
- Maintain design ownership through implementation and help ensure strong design-to-code alignment across platforms.

##### **Skills / Qualifications**

- 5+ years of experience working as a Product Designer on a consumer-facing product or game.
- A portfolio of polished web and mobile UI design work that demonstrates excellent craft, strong product thinking, and accountability.
- Mastery of UI design fundamentals, including typography, color, layout, visual hierarchy, alignment, contrast, interactivity, user experience heuristics.
- Experience using agentic tools like Cursor and Claude to build shareable prototypes and quickly iterate on different ideasDemonstrated experience owning complex product work from early problem definition through implementation.
- Strong Design system fluency, including the ability to use established patterns while thinking across features and identifying opportunities to improve consistency.
- A track record of influencing product and design decisions, presenting proposals clearly, and navigating cross-functional disagreement or competing priorities.
- Familiarity with frontend development and how design translates into code across web and mobile platforms.
- Strong written and verbal communication, proactive remote collaboration, and the judgment to operate effectively with autonomy and ambiguity.

##### **Preferred / Nice to Haves**

- A love for chess and knowledge of Chess.com and its product experience.
- Experience designing social features for mobile games or consumer products.
- Motion design experience, with strong product and UI design craft as the foundation.
- Design engineering or frontend development experience on web, iOS, or Android.

##### **About the Opportunity**

●  This is a full-time position.

●  We are 100% remote (work from anywhere!).

●  This position is open to applicants globally and requires at least 3 hours of overlap with U.S. working hours.

You can learn more about us here:

[Chess is for everyone!](https://www.chess.com/everyone)

[Our values](https://www.chess.com/jobs#values)

We look forward to meeting you!

As the IT Project Manager, you are the CTO's operating partner. You know the status of everything, you chase what's slipping before it becomes a problem, and you make sure nothing falls through the cracks. You work across multiple time zones with a distributed team.

**Responsibilities:**

- Own the Technology portfolio: maintain a single source of truth for all IT, Security and Product initiatives with owners, dates, status, risks and decisions

- Run the operating cadence: leadership meeting agendas and notes, action-item tracking, vendor and contract renewal calendar, salary-cap and budget tracking, and prep for executive reporting

- Take operational work off the CTO's plate: vendor coordination, procurement follow-ups, hiring logistics with Talent, cross-department requests and documentation

- Drive follow-through: chase commitments across teams, surface blockers early, escalate with a recommendation, and close the loop with stakeholders

- Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes

- Other applicable or related duties as assigned

- Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

**Role Requirements:**

- 3+ years in project/program management, chief of staff, or technology operations roles supporting a senior technology leader
- Track record running multi-workstream programs in a work-management tool. Nice to have: Fluency running business operations leveraging modern agentic tools (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Cowork, etc.)
- Strong written English: able to turn messy updates into an executive-ready status report or decision memo
- Working comfort with budgets, vendor contracts, renewals and procurement workflows
- Enough technical literacy to track IT, security and software work credibly and ask the right questions
- Relentless, respectful follow-up; comfortable holding senior stakeholders to commitments
- Advanced spoken and written English (C1+ or higher) and availability during US business hours, and after-hours availability on short notice

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

- Portfolio Visibility – 100% of active Technology initiatives tracked in the portfolio with owner, due date, status and risk, updated weekly (audited monthly by the CTO)

- CTO Operational Footprint – Reduce the CTO's recurring operational meetings and tasks by a defined target within 90 days (e.g., 8+ hours/week reclaimed), measured against a baseline set in the first 30 days

- Follow-Through – 90%+ of action items closed by their due date; 100% of overdue items escalated with a recommendation within 2 business days

- Reporting Cadence – Weekly Technology status report delivered every Friday and monthly executive summary delivered by the 3rd business day; zero missed cycles per quarter

- Vendor & Renewal Management – 100% of contract renewals surfaced to the CTO at least 60 days before term; zero unintended auto-renewals.

- Nothing falls through the cracks: every commitment has an owner, a date and a status

- The CTO's time goes to strategy and leadership, not operational follow-up

- One source of truth for what Technology is working on, why, and where it stands

- Proactive communication: stakeholders hear from you before they have to ask

- Judgment on what to handle directly, what to escalate, and when

jobs.title: Client Partner, Emerging & Scaled
jobs.description:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 


We're looking for a Client Partner to join our Emerging & Scaled Sales team, one of the fastest-growing teams within Spotify Advertising. In this role, you'll own and grow a portfolio of strategic clients, serving as a trusted advisor who understands their business goals and delivers advertising solutions that drive measurable impact. You'll combine strategic thinking, commercial expertise, and relationship management to develop long-term partnerships while helping advertisers unlock the full value of Spotify's advertising platform.
 
If you're passionate about digital advertising, thrive in a consultative sales environment, and enjoy building lasting client relationships, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do
Build and grow strategic relationships with advertisers by understanding their business objectives and delivering consultative, insight-driven recommendations.
Own a portfolio of clients and develop account strategies that drive long-term growth, retention, and revenue expansion.
Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities while expanding existing partnerships across your assigned market and vertical.
Create compelling sales narratives by leveraging market insights, campaign learnings, audience intelligence, and Spotify's advertising solutions.
Meet and exceed advertising revenue goals by developing strategic account plans and proactively identifying opportunities to grow your business.
Analyze campaign performance and client data to develop actionable insights and optimization recommendations that improve business outcomes.
Develop deep expertise in Spotify's advertising products, platform capabilities, and industry trends to position innovative solutions that align with client objectives.
Manage an active sales pipeline, maintain accurate forecasting, and effectively prioritize opportunities across multiple accounts.
Partner closely with cross-functional teams—including Sales Planning, Client Services, Marketing, Product, Measurement, and Data—to deliver exceptional client experiences and maximize campaign success.
Contribute to the ongoing evolution of Spotify Advertising by sharing market insights, client feedback, and best practices across the broader sales organization.

Who You Are
You have 5+ years of experience managing client relationships and driving revenue within a digital advertising, media, or advertising technology organization. Experience in audio advertising is a plus.
You know how to build executive-level relationships and act as a trusted advisor by delivering thoughtful, consultative solutions.
You have a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets while managing a complex portfolio of clients.
You are experienced in developing strategic account plans and identifying opportunities to grow existing business while generating new revenue.
You are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
You communicate clearly and confidently, adapting your approach to influence a variety of internal and external stakeholders.
You enjoy collaborating across cross-functional teams and believe strong partnerships create the best outcomes for clients.
You care about delivering an outstanding customer experience and using data and insights to inform recommendations and drive results.
You approach your work with integrity, curiosity, accountability, and a growth mindset, and you're excited to help shape the future of Spotify Advertising.
English and Portuguese fluency, spoken and written is required.
Please apply with a CV in English.

Where You'll Be
This role is based in São Paulo.
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

jobs.title: Principal Presales Engineer, Product Specialist
jobs.description:
**Who we are**

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to [hundreds of thousands of businesses](https://customers.twilio.com/) and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to [remote-first work](https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work), and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

**Hiring and how we work**

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

**See yourself at Twilio**

Join the team as Twilio’s next Principal Presales Engineer, Product Specialist.

**About the job**

This position is needed to partner closely with sales, solutions engineering, and enterprise strategists to consult on complex, multi-product opportunities. You will scope, design, and validate how complex multi-product solutions fit into the client’s ecosystem and help paint the long-term Twilio vision for our customers. You will be a critical partner cross-functionally, working with product, engineering, and marketing to identify and share technology patterns and shifts from our clients (and prospects) to influence product strategy.

**Responsibilities**

In this role, you’ll:

- Develop your expertise of the Twilio platform, use cases and buyer personas, while keeping up with industry trends in Voice + AI
- Scope, design, and build multi-product solution architecture and compelling presentations to secure the Technical Win
- Support core sales and solutions engineering team members on value-selling strategies and complex solution sales
- Design and validate scalable, secure, multi-product messaging architectures aligned to customer ecosystems and long-term Twilio adoption.
- Partner with Sales, Solutions Engineers, and Enterprise Strategists to drive technical validation and secure the technical win in complex sales cycles.
- Document recent patterns and technology shifts with our clients and prospects to influence Product and R&D strategy and roadmap via GTM interlock and PDLC processes

**Qualifications**

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

***Required:**

-  Hands-on experience designing and validating Conversational AI or LLM-driven architectures (e.g., integrating OpenAI, Dialogflow, or similar models via APIs).
- Experience leading pre-sales or solution architecture engagements, including scoping, design, and technical validation in both Portuguese and English language.
- Strong background in API-based, event-driven systems, with hands-on experience using REST APIs and webhooks.
- Working knowledge of at least one backend language such as Node.js or Python, with prior software development or equivalent experience.
- Demonstrated expertise in messaging platforms, including throughput management, retry strategies, and deliverability optimization.
- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to technical and executive audiences.
- Strong collaboration and influencing skills across sales, engineering, and product stakeholders.

**Desired:**

- Experience working in an overlay or specialist pre-sales capacity.
- Experience collaborating with Product on roadmap or positioning.
- Prior exposure to Twilio products or other CPaaS platforms.
- Business-level proficiency in Spanish.

**Location**

This role will be remote, and based in Brazil.

**Travel**

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 15% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

**What We Offer**

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

**Twilio thinks big. Do you?**

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call [Twilio Magic](https://www.twilio.com/company/values). Additionally, we empower employees to build [positive change in their communities](https://twilio.org/support-and-resources/impact-fund) by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, [please consider other open positions.](https://www.twilio.com/company/jobs#open-positions)

**.**

**Stay alert to recruitment fraud**

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ [twilio.com](http://twilio.com) email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

**Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.** We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

As a Cloud Platform Engineer at Supabase, you’ll join Cloud Engineering, part of Engineering Operations, and shape the foundations that let engineering teams build, ship, and operate infrastructure safely and independently across AWS and GCP.

This is a role spanning cloud governance, platform engineering, and hands-on operations. You’ll work across AWS and GCP account structure, identity and access management, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), reusable platform primitives, security boundaries, and self-service workflows for engineers.

You’ll be joining at a point where many of these foundations are being actively defined or reworked. We’re looking for someone who can take ambiguous, messy, business-critical infrastructure problems and turn them into pragmatic systems, tools, standards, and written guidance that scale with the company and empower teams to go faster.

### What You’ll Be Responsible For

- Designing and implementing cloud governance across AWS and GCP, including identity, account organization, access controls, and guardrails.

- Building reusable infrastructure and building blocks using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), enabling teams to provision and manage infrastructure safely and consistently.

- Creating self-service capabilities that reduce organizational friction and let engineers move more quickly within sensible boundaries.

- Owning resource governance and visibility: management tagging, a trustworthy inventory of what exists and who owns it, and consistent cross-account billing data.

- Developing reusable security primitives, including secrets storage, KMS, certificate management, token vending, direct service-to-service authentication, mTLS, and related platform services.

- Owning cloud-level network and operational primitives: IP address management, DNS, and health signals such as service-limit and quota alerting.

- Combining software engineering with hands-on operations and total ownership: building, deploying, monitoring, troubleshooting, and improving what you own.

- Establishing and sharing cloud engineering best practices through documentation, internal tooling, examples, and enablement.


### **You Might Be a Good Fit If You**

- Have 5+ years of experience in cloud governance, platform engineering, and/or operations, have operated production systems at scale, and carried on-call for them.

- Have previously undertaken a significant migration, e.g. rearchitected an AWS account topology, introduced IaC for existing infrastructure, centralized identity/SSO, or brought a second cloud under governance.

- Enjoy building internal platform and self-service experiences for other engineers.

- Are genuinely deep in at least one—ideally two—of the three strength areas below (and tell us which is your center of gravity):

  - **Tooling & ecosystem:** You’re intimately familiar with the breadth of AWS services in general, and IAM/SSO in particular. You know their Well-Architected Framework, and when to reach outside. You have working knowledge of GCP. You use IaC routinely and have run it in production, whichever tool. You’ve probably collaborated with auditors on meeting compliance requirements.

  - **Software engineering:** You write real production code (Go, Rust, or a comparable systems language), and can build reliable, maintainable services. You thrive across all stages of the SDLC, set technical direction, know how to de-risk projects, and produce written artifacts such as RFCs.

  - **Operations:** You’ve run production infrastructure yourself: carried the pager, written the alerts and runbooks, used SLOs or similar to decide what to fix first, and made shared systems less risky over time. You like owning systems, simplifying complex infrastructure problems, and turning best practices into reusable building blocks.
- Are comfortable treating infrastructure as software and have relevant experience with IaC and automation.

- Communicate clearly, work with a wide range of stakeholders, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams.

- Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and iterating toward better systems over time.


#### **What We Offer**

- **Fully Remote**

  We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- **ESOP**

  Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- **Tech Allowance**

  Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- **Health Benefits**

  Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- **Annual Off-Sites**

  Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- **Flexible Work**

  We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- **Professional Development**

  Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.


#### **About the Team**

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members


We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: Performance, MIS & Customer Insights Manager (Customer Experience)
jobs.description:
#### Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company that creates opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate in many markets, such as financial services, healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, among others. Experian invests in people and in new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 employees in 32 countries.

Our uniqueness is that we value yours. Experian's culture, centered on people, inclusive and purpose-driven, is recognized by several awards, including World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25) and Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries, among others. Check out Experian Life on social media or explore our careers site to understand why. Experian is also proud to be an employer that promotes equal opportunities and affirmative action.

#### Job Description

**Performance, MIS & Customer Insights Manager (Customer Experience)**

We are looking for a leader to integrate Performance, MIS, Analytics and Customer Insights within the Customer Experience structure, connecting operational data, business indicators and the voice of the customer to support strategic decisions and drive the continuous evolution of the experience. This person will be responsible for transforming data, surveys and customer feedback into actionable insights, ensuring an integrated view of operational performance and the customer journey. This role will work cross-functionally with different areas of the company, supporting leaders in identifying opportunities, prioritizing initiatives and building data-driven action plans. A leader responsible for connecting the voice of the customer to business performance, transforming operational and experience data into insights, decisions and actions that raise efficiency, satisfaction and results.

Main responsibilities:

- Lead the teams and areas of Performance, MIS, Business Analytics and Customer Insights, promoting integration between operational performance and customer experience.
- Define and evolve the Customer Experience KPI strategy, connecting operational, financial, business and customer perception indicators.
- Ensure the governance, integrity, quality and availability of the data used to monitor operations and support decision-making.
- Structure dashboards and executive views that allow tracking of trends, risks, opportunities and business performance.
- Monitor indicators such as SLA, Service Level, ASA, TMA/AHT, FCR, CSAT, NPS, CES, quality, productivity, occupancy, absenteeism, adherence, backlog, operational efficiency, costs and contract profitability.
- Lead the Customer Insights and Voice of Customer (VoC) strategy, consolidating information from surveys, service channels, journeys and other touchpoints.
- Develop and monitor experience surveys and indicators, turning results into recommendations and action plans.
- Identify patterns, trends and root causes that impact customer experience and operational efficiency.
- Develop analyses and models that anticipate risks, behaviors and opportunities and support strategic decisions.
- Translate complex data into executive narratives and clear recommendations, influencing different levels of the organization.
- Act as a strategic partner to the Operations, WFM, Quality, Training, Commercial, Product, Marketing, Finance and Technology areas.
- Participate in governance forums with internal and external clients, presenting results, diagnoses and improvement plans.
- Support contract renewals, RFPs and business opportunities through analyses of capacity, performance and experience.
- Lead transformation, automation and continuous improvement initiatives, seeking efficiency gains, scalability and evolution of the customer experience.
- Develop and engage the team, setting objectives, monitoring results and strengthening a data-driven and customer-centric culture.

#### Qualifications

What we look for in you:

- Professional with solid experience in Customer Experience, Performance, Analytics, MIS, Customer Insights or related areas, with the ability to move between an analytical view and strategic business action.
- Experience in team leadership and management of different work fronts.
- Strong analytical capability and experience building and managing performance and experience indicators.
- Knowledge of Customer Experience and Voice of Customer methodologies and metrics, such as NPS, CSAT and CES.
- Experience with surveys, customer behavior analysis and transforming qualitative and quantitative data into insights.
- Knowledge of Power BI or similar data visualization and analysis tools.
- Ability to structure dashboards, executive analyses and recommendations for decision-making.
- Experience in continuous improvement, process transformation, automation and operational efficiency.
- Strong communication, influence and relationship skills with different stakeholders and hierarchical levels.
- Business vision and ability to connect customer experience, operational performance and financial results.
- Advanced English
- Will be considered a plus: knowledge of VoC and Customer Insights tools and methodologies, research and analysis platforms, CRM, automation, AI applied to data/CX, and methodologies such as Lean and Six Sigma.

#### Additional Information

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people-first, inclusive and purpose-driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why. Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

Experian Careers - Creating a better tomorrow together

[Find out what its like to work for Experian by clicking here](https://www.experian.com/careers/)

jobs.title: CX Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

**Role Overview:**

As a CX Operations Analyst, you will play a vital role in enhancing the operational efficiency of the CX Operations team at Braze. Reporting to the Manager, CX Operations, you will be responsible for providing essential support in day-to-day operations, ensuring the accuracy of Customer and Customer Success CRM data, and supporting several strategic business initiatives. Your strong analytical capabilities and executive presence will be crucial in translating complex data into actionable leadership insights, automating workflows, and maintaining scalable operations. The ideal candidate is a high-performing self-starter who possesses exceptional communication skills, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is passionate about leveraging data and technology to optimize customer engagement and retention.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- **Internal Operational Support:** Provide timely and effective day-to-day operational support required to drive value to both internal and external customers of CX Operations.
- **Territory Strategy & Org Migrations:** Partner with CX Operations team and CS Leadership to design equitable account territories, conduct weekly data audits to fix discrepancies, and execute hierarchy changes in the CRM within the SLA timeframe to ensure zero reporting downtime.
- **Process Adherence and Improvement:** Independently audit and identify opportunities for process improvements, system automation, and operational efficiency within existing CX & renewals workflows.
- **Reporting & Insights:** Translate CRM Account data into clear reports and dashboards for CX Management to highlight visibility for strategic decision-making.
- **Maintain CX Data Hygiene:** Take full ownership of the accuracy and completeness of CRM and CSP data, establishing standards and records needed for scalable, auditable processes.
- **Operational AI Optimization:** Identify opportunities to integrate AI tools such as Gemini and Claude into daily operations to automate routine tasks, accelerate data analysis, and maximize productivity.
- **Documentation Creation:** Lead the creation of clear process documentation and drive enablement programs to train internal CX & Operations teams on business-critical workflows and tool adoption.

**WHAT YOU HAVE**

Competencies:

- **Attention to Detail:** High level of accuracy in managing platform configurations and customer data. With a vigilance in ensuring compliance with customer contracts and internal policies.
- **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders clearly and concisely.
- **Collaboration:** Ability to work effectively within a team and across departments across different initiatives and incentives.
- **Time Management:** Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
- **Operational Efficiency:** Strong organizational skills to handle various requests and platform configurations against competing urgencies and timeframes.
- **AI Literacy:** Proficient in leveraging AI tools (Gemini, Claude, etc) to enhance personal productivity and accelerate problem solving while maintaining high standards for output accuracy.
- **Adaptability:** Flexibility to adapt to changing customer requirements and platform updates with the ability to learn new tools and technologies quickly.
- **Ethical Standards:** Commitment to maintaining high ethical standards in managing customer data and platform access. Ensuring compliance with company policies and industry regulations.
- **Problem Solving:** Strong analytical skills to identify and resolve issues efficiently. Ability to think critically and provide innovative solutions to improve processes.
- **Data Management:** Ability to maintain accurate records and documentation of customer instances and feature access while understanding data privacy and security best practices.

Qualifications:

- Demonstrated experience in customer operations, support, sales operations, revenue operations, or business operations, preferably within a SaaS or tech environment.
- Hands-on proficiency with CRM platforms, with Salesforce strongly preferred.
- Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel (including pivot tables, vlookups, and data manipulation).
- Experience leveraging Generative AI tools to build operational efficiencies, automate workflows, and optimize personal productivity.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex operational and technical concepts clearly.
- Ability to work independently with high autonomy while collaborating effectively with global teams.
- Familiarity with Customer Engagement platforms or the Braze platform is a plus.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

_Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at [here](https://www.braze.com/company/careers/how-we-hire#benefit-section). More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment._

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

- Competitive compensation that may include equity
- Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
- Flexible paid time off
- Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
- Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
- Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
- A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
- Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
- Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
- Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

**ABOUT BRAZE**

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

**BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

**OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS**

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.

This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

Depending on where you are located, you may have certain rights available to you in relation to Braze’s use of AI:

- To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” at the end of the application form below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application.
- To exercise other types of rights, such as rights to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to request a **retroactive** manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision, please contact us at [talentdata.privacy@braze.com](talentdata.privacy@braze.com).

Please contact us at [talentdata.privacy@braze.com](talentdata.privacy@braze.com) with any questions. To find out more about our hiring process, check out [this page](https://www.braze.com/company/careers/how-we-hire).

To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” button below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application. Please submit any other request to our Talent Acquisition team at .

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Advisory Solution Consultant
jobs.description:
#### Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

#### Job Description

We are seeking a Solution Consultant to partner with Sales and help enterprise customers address complex security, identity, access, asset visibility, exposure management, and risk challenges.

In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical and business advisor, leading discovery, solution design, product demonstrations, proof-of-value engagements, and customer validation activities. ### **✨ One platform, a whole world of opportunity**

The best jobs have always clustered in a handful of the world's wealthiest cities. But talent is everywhere. Oyster set out to close that gap - building a global employment platform that lets companies hire, pay, and care for brilliant people anywhere.

We're proof that a high-performing culture doesn't need an office. Distributed across 60+ countries since 2020, we've built something the industry keeps noticing:

- Ranked **#10 of 250** on TIME and Statista's 2026 list of [America's Top WorkTech Companies](https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-hr-named-10-of-americas-top-worktech-companies-of-2026-by-time)

- Named one of [America's Greatest Startup Workplaces 2026](https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-2026-newsweek-award) by Newsweek

- A [G2 Spring 2026 Leader](https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-named-best-roi-for-any-global-employment-platform-for-g2-spring-2026) across Employer of Record, Global Employment, Multi-country Payroll, and HR Compliance

- The only **B Corp-certified** global employment platform ~ independently verified since 2023


Two of those rankings measured our business impact from the outside. One measured how our own people feel about working here. They landed in the same place ~ because at Oyster, culture and performance aren't separate conversations. They're the same one.

And we're just getting started. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who care as much as you do, we'd love for you to apply.

**The Role**

**Location:** While this position is posted in a specific location, all of Oyster’s positions are fully remote and you can work from home. Forever.To create the best experience for our new hire, this role requires you to be based within -3 / - 8 UTC.

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Accountant to own day-to-day accounting, monthly reporting, and ERP activities for Oyster entities around the world, with a focus on LATAM coverage. You will combine rigorous accounting judgment with proactive stakeholder management, lead close and audit activities, investigate complex discrepancies, and improve the systems and processes that keep a distributed finance function accurate and scalable.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Manage full-cycle accounting and intercompany transactions for global subsidiaries.

- Prepare and review financial statements and balance-sheet reconciliations across multiple entities.

- Lead month-end and year-end close activities, maintaining clear checklists and documentation.

- Coordinate monthly, quarterly, and annual local statutory filings and provide complete support packages.

- Oversee local statutory audits and resolve auditor questions and adjustments.

- Reconcile local statutory records to the ERP

- Conduct financial analysis, identify trends or discrepancies, and present decision-useful insights.

- Own assigned ERP activities and improve accounting standards, controls, documentation, and automation.

- Proactively coordinate dependencies across Finance, Payroll, Tax, Legal, and external partners.

- Execute ad hoc financial projects and support junior teammates with practical guidance.


**Core Requirements**

- At least 5 years of accounting experience, including at least 1 year operating at senior-accountant scope.

- CPA (or part-qualified) or an equivalent professional accounting qualification.

- Strong knowledge of multi-entity accounting, intercompany transactions, financial reporting, reconciliations, close, and audit support.

- Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables and manipulation of large datasets.

- Meticulous attention to detail and a logical, evidence-based approach to problem solving.

- Ability to prioritize competing deadlines and maintain quality across several entities.

- Strong written and spoken English, with effective stakeholder management in an asynchronous environment.

- Proactive follow-through, sound judgment, and a continuous-improvement and automation mindset.


**Bonus / Nice-to-Have Experience**

- NetSuite or a comparable ERP.

- Payroll accounting or SaaS experience.

- High-growth startup or rapidly changing international environment.

- Accounting across LATAM jurisdictions, including local statutory reporting and local-to-group reconciliation.


**This might not be right for you if...**

- You prefer a narrowly scoped, single-entity role with limited stakeholder contact.

- You are uncomfortable investigating ambiguous discrepancies or making evidence-based accounting recommendations.

- You need close supervision to manage deadlines, follow up with stakeholders, or keep work documented.

- You prefer manual routines and have little interest in improving controls, systems, or automation.


**You'll also need**

- A reliable home internet connection and fluency in both written and spoken English.


### **How we work together at Oyster**

Our values guide the work we do, the decisions we make, and the culture that makes Oyster what it is. We make it happen—progress is our default setting. We drive change, we build and give trust, and we move as one united team.

Our mission is to create a more equal world of work: helping companies everywhere hire, pay, and care for talent anywhere. Everything we do ladders up to our mission. We embrace asynchronous, collaborative work and share how we operate in the [Oyster Public HQ](https://oysterhr.notion.site/Welcome-to-The-Reef-Oyster-s-Open-Source-Employee-Guide-fc482e3f107c4afd8c85ed217f1d0c1d) so other global teams can learn from us.

### **How YOU work**

With diverse locations, cultures, and needs, we created [How YOU Work;](https://oysterhr.notion.site/How-YOU-work-ac16c1932e314ffd8cb693e332458395) a program supporting your whole human experience at Oyster:

- **Work from anywhere:** Oyster has no borders or HQ. As long as work is timely, your team is supported, and you're authorized to work where you live, you can work from anywhere.

- **Paid time off:** Enjoy 40 days off per year (including holidays and vacation), or more if required by your country.

- **Mental health support:** Access [Plumm](https://oysterhr.notion.site/Plumm-3b5e7e70dec6428e975f68f25972cfb7), our mental well-being service.

- **Wellbeing allowance:** Each month, receive a wellbeing allowance in your ThanksBen wallet to spend on a wide range of options.

- **Flexible parental leave:** All new parents are eligible for at least three months’ paid leave, with job protection for up to 12 months or as required locally.

- **WFH stipend:** Receive a stipend for your laptop and home office equipment to get you set up quickly.


### **✨ The best jobs should be available to everyone**

We embrace diverse perspectives and intentionally build our product and company with an inclusive, global mindset. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every criterion, and are committed to a trust-based, thriving environment.

Oyster is committed to ensuring equal opportunity of employment for qualified persons with disabilities and actively fosters an inclusive work environment. If you require reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process, please email [jobs@oysterhr.com](mailto:jobs@oysterhr.com) with the subject line: Interview Accommodations.

Our available positions are on our careers page. Our team will only contact you from an @ _oysterhr.com_ email, and **we will never ask for money as part of an interview process or job offer.** If you receive a suspicious email about Oyster jobs or are directed to a site other than [www.oysterhr.com/careers](http://www.oysterhr.com/careers), please report it via our [Compliance and Ethics Helpline](https://faceup.com/c/8tpzyyye).

jobs.description:
### **About Supabase**

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

**About the Role**

We're hiring a Product Manager for [Supabase Realtime](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/realtime). You'll own the surface area developers use to build live, collaborative and event-driven apps on Supabase: [Broadcast](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/realtime/broadcast), [Presence](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/realtime/presence), [Postgres Changes](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/realtime/postgres-changes), and the capabilities we build next.

You'll work closely with the Realtime Engineering team and with partners across Product Management, Design and GTM.

This role is ideal for someone who's excited about building tools for millions of developers and who has a passion for the types of user experiences unlocked by simple, scalable real-time channels. You should have a nuanced understanding of full-stack application development, including _existing and emerging_ real-time and sync patterns.

### What You’ll Be Responsible For

- **You'll collaborate with customers of all sizes and expertise levels:** from an indie developer adding live updates to a side project, to startups building collaborative SaaS, to enterprise teams streaming live data to dashboards.

- **You'll own the problem statements and solution rationale behind the Realtime roadmap.** This means working with Engineering and Design to shape _how_ Supabase crafts the developer experience for the problems you’ve prioritized solving.

- **You'll shape how Realtime evolves to enable future application experiences**, including its role in AI apps and alongside other Supabase products.

- **You'll own Realtime packaging and pricing**, working with Pricing, Finance and Billing.

- **You'll use data to understand how Supabase developers are using Realtime features**: where they succeed, where they get stuck, and what to tackle first.

- **You'll keep Engineering, Design and GTM aligned.** You'll own the plan of record for what's coming, why, and in what order.


### **You Might Be a Good Fit If You**

#### **Must have**

- **5+ years of Product Management experience on developer tools, or are an ex-founder with equivalent depth.** You're comfortable commenting on an architecture doc, following a design discussion, and advocating for the user when trade-offs are required.

- **Have owned an app development platform, feature or framework where real-time was core to the developer experience.**

- **Get your own answers from data.** You know what you care about in terms of product instrumentation and are comfortable querying and cleaning your own findings.

- **Are comfortable with Postgres and familiar with logical replication.**

- **Work async by default.** Supabase is fully remote. You make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings.


#### Strong signal

- You have an existing audience among developers, through social media, open source or developer advocacy.

- Worked on a sync engine, local-first or live-query product.

- Worked with gaming, AR or collaborative-tool customers.

- Shipped something using Supabase.


#### **What We Offer**

- **Fully Remote**

  We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- **ESOP**

  Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- **Tech Allowance**

  Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- **Health Benefits**

  Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- **Annual Off-Sites**

  Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- **Flexible Work**

  We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- **Professional Development**

  Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.


#### **About the Team**

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members


We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.description:
#### Description

BlueTuskr is a full-service e-commerce growth agency built exclusively for e-commerce brands. We combine paid media, owned media, creative, and analytics to help our clients scale profitably. Our team is made up of specialists who are deeply invested in their craft — and in the success of the brands they serve.

This isn't a "jack of all trades" environment. We hire people who are exceptional at what they do, then give them the resources and autonomy to do it well.

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for a Graphic Designer and Video Editor who creates with conversion in mind. You know that a beautiful email that doesn't get clicks isn't finished yet, and that a product page is a sales tool first. This is a hands-on role for someone who has spent real time designing for e-commerce brands — emails, landing pages, website sections, and social/ad creative — and can explain exactly why each design choice was made.

You'll design across a portfolio of e-commerce clients, working closely with our email, CRO, Shopify development, and paid media teams. You'll also use Claude and other AI tools as a real part of your workflow — to move faster on ideation, variations, and production, without sacrificing quality or brand consistency.

**This role starts part-time at 15 hours/week,** with real room to grow as your client roster and responsibilities expand.

#### What You'll Own

**Email & Retention Design**

- Design campaign and automated flow emails (newsletters, welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, etc.) that are on-brand and built to drive clicks and revenue
- Design mobile-first, with clear hierarchy, scannable layouts, and strong calls to action
- Prepare email-ready files and specs (image slicing, live text vs. image text, alt text, dark mode considerations) for clean builds in Klaviyo and other email platforms

**Web Creative & CRO Support**

- Design landing pages, homepage, and collection page sections, product page (PDP) modules, banners, and promotional assets for Shopify stores
- Partner with the CRO team to design test variations based on data, heatmaps, and hypotheses — not just personal taste
- Hand off dev-ready Figma files to our web developers, with desktop and mobile layouts, organized layers, and clear specs

**Social & Ad Creative**

- Design static social and paid ad creative for Meta, TikTok, and other channels
- Create ad variations and iterations to support creative testing
- Video editing for social and ad use (resizing, trimming, captions, simple motion) where needed

**Process & Quality**

- Follow each client's brand guidelines closely, and flag gaps or inconsistencies when guidelines are missing or unclear
- Apply design and e-commerce best practices (accessibility, contrast, legibility, load-friendly assets, platform specs)
- Present work with a clear rationale — why this layout, this hierarchy, this CTA — to internal teams and, when needed, clients
- Take feedback well, turn revisions around quickly, and keep work moving across multiple accounts and deadlines
- Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up concepting, copy-to-layout exploration, asset variations, and repetitive production tasks — while following client confidentiality and our AI use guidelines

#### Who You Are

Skills get you in the door. These are the qualities that make you right for this role:

- **An exceptional designer** with a strong eye for layout, typography, and color — your portfolio speaks for itself
- **Conversion-minded** — you think about what the customer needs to see, feel, and do next, not just what looks good
- **Detail-obsessed** — you catch the misaligned element, the off-brand color, and the typo before anyone else does
- **A clear communicator** who can explain the reasoning behind design choices and keeps the team updated without being chased
- **Excellent at managing your time** — you can juggle multiple clients and deadlines in a remote, async environment without dropping the ball
- **AI-curious and AI-capable** — you already use tools like Claude in your workflow and are excited to find new ways to work smarter
- **Adaptable** — you can shift between very different brand styles and still make each one feel right.

#### What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days:

- You've learned the brand guidelines and design systems for your assigned client accounts
- You're consistently delivering email, web, and social designs on time with minimal revision rounds
- You've handed off at least one web project or CRO test variation to our Shopify dev team with clean, dev-ready files
- You've built AI into your workflow in a way that measurably speeds up production
- Internal teams trust your work and your reasoning, and come to you with ideas, not just requests
